In confirmation of this, according to the Viceroy's statement, an order was issued by the government of India to the Viceroy that all the people of India who are under the authority of the Viceroy's government must refrain from any kind of efforts and actions, and in this regard, act according to the order of the Viceroy's government for any kind of progress. If anyone violates the order of the Viceroy's government, then severe punishments will be given to them by the Viceroy. In response to this order, a petition was also sent to the Viceroy by a number of people from India, in which they demanded their rights before the Viceroy's government, and in this petition, it was requested from the Viceroy that to solve the problems of the people of India, the Viceroy's government should open a path for negotiations with the people of India, and as a result of these negotiations, seek solutions to the problems of India.

729.right:
Beginning

Owners!

This is a repetition of a part that was already published in previous issues. Although it is not about this month's topic, it is important for unity among Afghans. It should be noted by everyone. This is essentially a summary of a Jirga by Khan Sahib, which was formed to strengthen unity and brotherhood among the people. In his speech, Khan Sahib expressed sadness over the conflicts and disagreements among the people and stated that this is the biggest obstacle to our progress. He encouraged people to resolve their differences through the Jirga and to choose love and brotherhood instead of enmity among themselves. According to him, if we unite, no force can stop us. At the end of this Jirga, many people promised that from now on they would give up their internal differences and work for a common goal. This was an important step taken for positive change in the society of that time. Khan Sahib's speech had a deep impact on people's hearts, and many people promised to implement it. The demand of this Jirga was that all Afghans should consider their national interests higher than personal interests and work together for the development of the country.
729.left: In this regard, I must say that this speech by Khan Sahib came at a time when the country's situation was very tense. People were grappling with various problems, and the need for unity was felt very strongly. In his speech, Khan Sahib emphasized the importance of unity and said that the secret of our success lies only in unity. He added that to thwart the conspiracies of our enemies, we must stand as one. The participants of the Jirga felt happy upon hearing Khan Sahib's words and unanimously supported his proposals. We will publish more information about the results of this Jirga in the next issue. We hope that by reading this article, our esteemed readers will understand the value of their unity and fulfill their responsibility in this path. Every individual in the country is responsible for this national mission to raise their voice for unity and stop those who sow division. In the end, we pray that God Almighty grants our countrymen the grace of unity and brotherhood and leads our country toward progress and prosperity. Amen.

738.right:
A few days ago, almost the entire system of education during the era of subjugation and slavery was under the complete control of the British through their teachers; education, universities, high schools, schools, and others referred to by the name of education were used under this pretext to lower the level of knowledge of the people of India, especially the people of the Pashtun regions. This education was part of a plan by the British of that time, which they used to tighten the chains of their slavery and to create a system for them that, along with creating a sense of slavery among the people of India, would also play a very important role in changing their minds. This education was, in reality, an organized way to kill their culture, history, and the spirit of their independence, which was being placed in their minds by the British with great precision.

The educational system of the British era not only brought changes to people's learning but also created deep changes in their social structure. By including the English language and Western sciences in the curriculum of schools and universities, their main goal was to sever the connection of the people of India with their ancient sciences and historical achievements and to create a sense of the greatness of their masters (the British) in their hearts. For this purpose, they established institutions in every corner of India where education would be conducted in the light of British thought and perspective.

In all these circumstances, the British policy regarding the educational level of the people of Pashtunkhwa was very cruel. Their effort was to keep the Pashtuns away from modern sciences and to keep them in a state where they would not have the ability to raise their voices for their rights. This is the reason why, during that period, the level of knowledge of the people was very low due to the lack of educational facilities in the regions of Pashtunkhwa.

747.right: In these past events, many reports were published by this famous newspaper of the British, which now exists in India under the name "Akhbar-e-Watan," as well as by other Indian newspapers, regarding the British aggression and atrocities in India. In these publications, it was made clear that the British colonial policies had caused the destruction and ruin of the people in India. Likewise, in this newspaper, mentions were also made regarding the sacrifices and devotion of the Afghans, describing how they had stood against the British for the freedom of their homeland and had struggled for their independence. In the issues of this newspaper, the hatred and anger of the people regarding the injustices of the British and the actions of their colonial government in India were expressed.
747.left: In the series "Struggle for Freedom," this newspaper commemorated the sacrifices of the Afghans and wrote: "This is a great sign of the awakening of the people of India, who are demanding freedom against the colonial power of the British. In the course of this struggle, Afghans have presented examples of their sacrifice and struggle that will remain forever in the pages of history." In this text, a deep analysis of the atrocities of the British and the aspirations of the people of India for freedom has been presented. This text is a clear example of the stance of the newspapers of that time regarding the Indian independence movement, which played an important role in awakening the people to end colonialism. The writers of this newspaper had raised their voices with great courage against the atrocities of the British government.

Regarding the resumption of the "Pashtun" publication

In 1928, in the history of India and the Frontier, the banning of the "Pashtun" newspaper by the Indian government was a very significant event and a major example of the government's hostility toward the progress of the Pashto language.

When the "Pashtun" newspaper was banned by the British government in 1928, it was shocking news for everyone in India, because "Pashtun" was a major obstacle for the enemies of its country and nation, and very important articles were written in this newspaper to awaken the Pashtun nation, which was intolerable for the government.

When the "Pashtun" newspaper was banned, the work of awakening the Pashtun nation came to a standstill, and there were many people who were saddened and wondered when this newspaper would start again, because "Pashtun" had played a very important role in the unity of the Pashtun nation.

In the end, with much effort and the grace of God, the news of the resumption of the "Pashtun" newspaper was a message of joy for the Pashtun nation, and the restarting of the "Pashtun" newspaper was a matter of despair for the enemies of the Pashtun nation.

When the "Pashtun" newspaper restarted in 1930, it was a very important step for the unity of the Pashtun nation, and with the resumption of the "Pashtun" newspaper, hope for freedom was once again born in the hearts of the Pashtun nation.

The "Pashtun" newspaper requests its readers to assist the newspaper and remove obstacles in the way of its publication, because "Pashtun" is a very important weapon for the freedom of the Pashtun nation, and in order for the "Pashtun" newspaper to continue its work, it requests help from all classes of the Pashtun nation, and with their help, the work of the Pashtun nation's freedom will soon be successful.

Khudai Khidmatgar

I often explain in detail to my Khudai Khidmatgar brothers in every meeting and village regarding this: who can be a Khudai Khidmatgar, and what are his principles and tasks?
But since I cannot reach every place and every region, for this reason, I want to explain about the Khudai Khidmatgar through this "Pashtun Magazine" for their service:-
O brothers! Merely "wearing red clothes" is not Khudai Khidmatgari.
Rather, a Khudai Khidmatgar can be a person who does not steal, does not gamble, does not drink, does not quarrel, does not hold grudges or enmity, and does not file unjust lawsuits.
He does good to his enemy, performs good deeds, loves and has affection for his nation, and helps the sinner, the sick, the orphan, the destitute, the poor, and the oppressed as much as he can until death.

I often speak in detail in every meeting and village to my Khudai Khidmatgars regarding this. Who can be a Khudai Khidmatgar, and what are his principles and what is his work?
However, since I cannot reach every place and every region, for this reason, through the "Pashtun Magazine," I want to explain to them about the Khudai Khidmatgar:
O brothers! Just wearing the uniform is not "Khudai Khidmatgari." Rather, a Khudai Khidmatgar can be a person who does not gamble, does not drink, does not commit theft, does not hold grudges. Does not engage in feuds and enmities. Does not file unjust lawsuits.

The language and harm of the afterlife

This is the great trial of my life, that these two things are in my life and every day they are in conflict with each other, and over this, my intellect and wisdom are in conflict with the enemy, the devil. One is that my intellect and wisdom tell me to take a step in the path of God in this life and to accept God's command instead of the rule of the world, and the other is that the devil puts temptations into my mind at every moment for things that are the causes of destroying my religion and faith.

The devil tries to diminish my faith through my own authority and my own idols, and from the friends of Allah and all kinds of dangers in His path. The devil is very skilled in this; he always takes advantage of the weakness of the human heart, he enters the human heart at every moment and sows the seeds of doubt and suspicion in every action. Although it is God's promise that the devil is always unsuccessful in such ways, due to human weakness and frailty, he sometimes gets caught in these sins and, by straying from His guidance, follows the devil.
804.left:
On this path, man's greatest enmity is with his own carnal desires and the whispers of Satan. In order for man to find salvation from the whispers of Satan, he must strengthen his faith by keeping himself occupied in the remembrance of God, by implementing the guidance of the Holy Quran, and by sitting and associating with people who serve the religion of Allah.

This battle with Satan is not for one day or one hour, but rather it is a continuous struggle for the entire life. Man must understand that Satan tries to divert him from his path until the end of his life, therefore it is necessary for every Muslim to pray in the court of his Lord for the protection of his soul and to seek refuge in God from the evil of Satan.

For the enmity with Satan, the unity of Muslims and remaining steadfast on the path of religion is an essential condition. When a Muslim gets caught in the whispers of Satan, he should immediately return to the presence of God through the path of repentance and take steps to correct his mistake, because God is with those who repent and He has provided guidance to His servants for salvation from the evil of Satan.

Whoever does not believe in God's law for the regulation of life's affairs is, in reality, committing a great betrayal against himself and his nation. If the pages of history are turned, it will become clear that many nations of the world have adopted the path of rebellion and revolution against the oppression and unjust actions of their masters. 812.right:
Introduction
Adabi Press is an Islamic center for the organization of Muslim unity and for the attainment of freedom. It is used to unite Muslims for the propagation of Islam and to seek liberation from all forms of oppression. For those who believe in this, there is no better opportunity than this to strive for the propagation of the religion. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said in a Hadith: "Help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or oppressed." In this Hadith, the meaning of oppression is that the hand of the oppressor should be held back and his oppression prevented, and the meaning of the oppressed is that he should be supported and his rights should be given to him. In Islam, oppression is considered the worst of all deeds, and it is mandatory for Muslims to rise up in opposition to oppression.
The holy religion of Islam is a religion of justice and fairness. In it, all Muslims are equal without any kind of distinction or discrimination. For the purpose that Muslims may understand each other's troubles and work for their resolution, the efforts of Adabi Press cannot be denied. The news published in it is for the awakening of Muslims and the defense of their rights.
812.left:
Furthermore, a major conference has been called in Kabul these days, the purpose of which is to organize the unity and agreement of Muslims. People from all sides are gathering for this conference, and they are offering their advice for the progress of Islam and the unity of Muslims. It is a matter of happiness for every Muslim that such a task is being carried out under the patronage of an Islamic government. There is no doubt that such conferences play a very major role in the awakening of Muslims.
Everyone who believes in this purpose does not spare their efforts for it. This is an opportunity for Muslims to gather in one place and pave the way for solving their problems. The support of all Muslims is necessary for the success of this conference, and it is the duty of every individual to play their role in this path.

816.right:
Sincere thoughts of the landowners to the government
Nowadays, the condition of the landowners is known to everyone. The big landowners of our country, who hold a large share of the state's distribution, are in great distress. The arrangements previously made by the government for the protection of their lands, other assets, and their lives and property are no longer sufficient for them in any way. It is a clear fact that everyone has their own share in the state. Just as people pay taxes for the work of the state, it is also the duty of the state to make full arrangements for their security for their peace. But nowadays it does not seem so; on the contrary, it seems that their troubles are increasing from all sides. At every stage, they are facing very strict restrictions from the government. There is no such facility for them to pay their taxes easily in this situation. Likewise, there is no special arrangement for their security. It is their right from the state, and there is no doubt that they should be provided with full security and facilities. They want the government to take special steps to protect their lands, because they are making many efforts to maintain their lands, but unfortunately, they are facing many hardships from government agencies. They believe that if the government takes appropriate action to remove their troubles, they will remain loyal to this state for a long time.
816.left: In this message, they have been facing such problems for a long time, and the lack of any special attention from the government to protect their lives and property has created signs of hopelessness in their hearts. They want the government to hear their voice and help them solve their problems. They believe that if the government fulfills its responsibility in this regard properly, the way to solve their problems will become easier. They are playing their part for peace and security in this country and want to work for the development of their country. They demand justice from the government to ensure their rights. They are of the opinion that they should work together with the government for the progress of the country and for peace and security. They are fully cooperating with the government in a legal way to obtain their rights and are looking for a solution to their demands that will be beneficial for both the government and the landowners. In this way, they want to get rid of this problem and want to create a safe environment for their lives.

Identification

This long tradition and ancient strategy for identifying the enemies of the homeland is such that every nation has found a way to identify the enemy in the pages of its history. If a nation wants not to fail in identifying the enemies of its homeland and people, then it should read the following lines carefully. These lines have been written with great heroism and zeal, which every member of our nation must understand and act upon. This identification of the enemy is extremely necessary for the survival and progress of our nation, because the enemies of the nation often enter among the people in the guise of friends and fulfill their impure goals. In these lines, there are very important instructions for identifying enemies, which set a path of action for every individual of the nation. Our nation has always mentioned the names of the following persons for the purpose of identifying enemies for their actions:
(1) Fazal Ahmad Sahib (2) Nasrullah Sahib (3) Maulana Obaidullah Sahib (4) Haji Sahib. Along with this, the names of other people have also been mentioned, and it is necessary for others to pay full attention to one another in order to identify the homeland, so that harm to the homeland can be prevented.
821.left:
Introduction

In identifying the enemies of the nation, it is necessary for every citizen, especially the youth, to be aware of the enemies' intentions of all kinds, to join hands with one another for the sake of the country's protection, and to be fully prepared to thwart any conspiracies of the enemy. In this path, the role of every individual, especially writers and those who wield the pen, is very significant in awakening the consciousness of the people of the country and informing them of the dangers posed by the enemies.

822.right:
August 1920

Regarding the publication of articles

We are writing a few words for our readers regarding the publication of articles in the Pashtun weekly magazine, addressed to the officials of the Pashtun weekly magazine. The purpose of publishing our magazine and printing these writings is to foster a culture of reading and a spirit of awareness regarding scientific and social issues among the Pashtun nation. The door of our publication is open to every Pashtun brother who wishes well for his nation and people and strives through the pen for the progress of Pashto literature and Pashtunkhwa. We request all those respected individuals to write their articles in standard Pashto and avoid unnecessary and inappropriate remarks. As the editor of the magazine, our duty is to carefully consider the content of the writings and not publish anything that is against religion or the unity of the nation. We respect the opinions of our readers and welcome any writing that serves the benefit of the Pashtun nation. For the further improvement of the publication, we call upon all our Pashtun brothers to participate in this national media outlet and send us their scientific, literary, and historical writings so that work can be done for the enrichment of the Pashto language and the awakening of the Pashtun nation. This magazine is yours, and with your support, it will achieve its goals.
822.left:
Pashtun

Regarding the publication of articles

First of all, in the path of publishing a new and advanced magazine like the Pashtun weekly, with the purpose of safeguarding the interests of all the Pashtun people, from the very first day, this effort has been made to start a scientific and reformative movement among the people through the pen for the service of our language and culture. Although as a new magazine publication we are facing some difficulties, by the grace of God and the support of the people, we hope that as a strong magazine, it will be an effective step for the demand of rights and progress of the Pashtun nation. In this regard, we hope from all Pashtun writers and lovers of the Pashto language to help strengthen this magazine by publishing their writings and work as a common goal for the development of the Pashto language. This magazine is a voice for the awakening of the Pashtun nation's consciousness and a shield for the defense of the rights of every Pashtun brother and sister. With every piece of writing that reaches us, we consider it thoroughly and strive to publish it for the general public to read for a noble purpose. In the end, we thank all those who have raised their voices in support of this national magazine of ours.

828.right:
Letter from Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru
(Translated from English)
To my dear brother Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan Sahib

Through this letter, I submit to your service that you convey my greetings to our brave brothers (Khudai Khidmatgars) on behalf of the Hindustani Seva Dal and the volunteers. We have all been secret partners for some time in achieving a supreme goal, but we are now becoming much closer to each other and are in a state [of unity]. On this occasion, I send my heartfelt greetings to those brave soldiers of freedom.

The Khudai Khidmatgars have established their own reputation, and they have shown bravery and courage during such a difficult time.
A difficult time of hope and despair is before us, in which all of us will be tested. In the coming struggle, it is hoped that we will all remain united and will endure this hardship with patience until we achieve victory.

In the end, I pray to God Almighty that He may liberate us in return for our sacrifices. Wassalam, your sincere brother,
Jawaharlal Nehru - from Allahabad

859.right: In the past year (1920), for the awakening of the people and the knowledge of their rights, a publication named "Afghan," which was an important element of the national liberation movement, was circulated among the country's intellectuals. In the course of this publication's goals, it was clear that the nation must participate in determining its own destiny and unite against the conspiracies of colonialism. As stated in the text, to improve the country's situation, it is necessary to increase the level of public unity and political awareness, because illiteracy and slavery to foreigners lead to the decline of a nation. We must learn lessons from the past history of our ancestors and lay a strong foundation for the future, so that future generations may have a life of pride. The path of knowledge and light is the only way to progress through which we can lead our country out of this crisis. The slogan of unity and brotherhood must be in the heart of every Afghan, because through division, the enemies' goals are fulfilled and our country becomes prey to others. Therefore, it is necessary to work together for national interests and, under the guidance of our leaders, contribute to building a free and independent Afghanistan.

Pashtun 29 September 1921

A message to the common people from the Khudai Khidmatgars of Peshawar, which has been published for their salvation from the atrocities of the time and the actions of the oppressors - although there was a lot of noise among the people regarding the order of the Khudai Khidmatgar meeting - yet, as soon as the speech of a great leader of the Khudai Khidmatgars, Maulvi Sahib, began - the fear of God was created in the hearts of the people and the people became silent to listen to this matter - Maulvi Sahib said that there are many people among the public who claim true love for Allah Almighty - and act according to this noble verse of the Holy Quran (Indeed, Allah is with the patient) - but in practice, they become impatient - this is absolutely a sign of hypocrisy - and these people are busy deceiving people in the name of religion - while their actions are not in accordance with the teachings of Islam - they want to sow discord among the people - and use religion for their own benefit - I do not want you to be deceived by the words of such people - if you truly want to become a friend of God, then struggle against your own self and be prepared to endure every kind of hardship on the path of truth - if you fall for the words of such people, then your repentance and faith have no value - save yourselves from the deception of such people and seek the pleasure of God Almighty - and prove that the worker who has come out into the field of action is not for the sake of religion, but for the liberation from slavery.

On the eighth (8th) of July, a meeting of the Pashto Society was held, in which, according to the decision of Mr. Khan Sahib, an agreement was reached on the compilation of a magnificent book in the Pashto language and the preparation of its manuscript. To carry out this task, a committee of four prominent Pashto language writers was formed based on Mr. Khan Sahib's opinion, and it was decided that the work of writing this book would be carried out in consultation with the members of this committee. This committee will hold meetings from time to time and will assist in the preparation of the manuscript of this book with great care. In the list of the members of this committee, the name of Ghulam Muhammad Khan Sahib was also presented by Khan Sahib with great enthusiasm and passion, and during this meeting, it was decided with great respect and unanimous agreement of the people in favor of Ghulam Muhammad Khan Sahib that this book would be written under the supervision and management of Ghulam Muhammad Khan Sahib and would hold a high position in the Pashto language. At the end of the meeting, the courage and efforts of all the members for the success of this important work were praised by Khan Sahib, and a prayer was made that may Allah Almighty accomplish this work in the best possible way.
868.left:
And also in this way, the work of translating and writing many other useful books into this Pashto language for this book will be carried out with great care in the church itself. In this meeting, it was also made clear that this book is very important not only for the Pashto language, but also for Pashto linguistics and literature, because it will be a new and comprehensive book for the teaching and learning of the Pashto language.

In the end, the participants of the meeting promised their full support and cooperation for the writing of this book, and they parted ways with great happiness, hoping to see each other again.

The final result of the meeting:
In this meeting, a full consensus was reached by all members of the Pashto Association regarding the compilation of the book and providing full assurance about it, and regarding the completion of this important work, that efforts will be continued for the success of this work in the future.

In the end, an announcement was made by a few individuals to form a committee for women's education, the purpose of which would be to hold meetings from time to time for the education of the women of the society and to work for its progress.

The Oppressed's Good Day

(From Honorable Maulana Karimli Sahib Noshahrawi)

The Day of the Oppressed, according to this blessed Hadith ("Fear the prayer of the oppressed, for there is no veil between it and Allah"), is a day to punish the oppressor for his oppression on the day of the oppressed's suffering. On this day, the oppressor must realize that his force, excess, and oppression will not remain unanswered before God Almighty. This day is for accounting for the crimes of those oppressors who have trampled on people's rights and have not returned rights to their rightful owners. On this day, the oppressed are given the opportunity to speak their hearts and raise their voices against the oppressor's crimes. In Islam, great importance is given to the rights of the oppressed, and in the light of Islamic Sharia, punishing the oppressor is a necessary step for the reform of society.

Regarding the homeland, England, which is under British occupation, on this day we want to create a spirit of freedom-seeking that is in the heart of every human being and to fight for the truth, for the whole world is not for sale.
871.left:
In return for this, against British colonialism, every Afghan, every Pashtun, and every human being must raise their voice in unison on this day for their freedom and independence, so that the skirt of this oppressive system may be gathered up and the flag of truth and justice may be raised. On this day, our collective demand is that the era of force and oppression should come to an end and human rights should be respected.

On this day, we bow our heads in support of those oppressed people who live under tyranny and despotism. We must realize that as long as one oppressed person exists on this earth, this chain of the oppressor's atrocities will continue. So let us join hands in unity on this day and prepare for the sacred struggle on the path of truth.

The message of this day is that demanding truth, fighting against oppression, and supporting the oppressed is the duty of each one of us, and any sacrifice made on this path is a guarantee of the success of our future.

(Fifth, 34, September 1921)

In our previous issue, there was a mistake on the front page of "Pashtun" where the word "Muslim" was misspelled, which caused pain to the hearts of many esteemed Muslims, and some even expressed deep resentment. Our apology regarding this error is as follows: During the proofreading of the first page of "Pashtun," we noticed the word "Mulsaman" instead of "Muslim," and we gave the printing press instructions to correct it. However, due to the negligence of the printing press staff or machine errors, this mistake remained, and it is not due to our negligence, but rather the result of an incorrect technical error by the printing press. We apologize to our esteemed readers for this and are making every effort to prevent the repetition of this error. On behalf of the editorial board of "Pashtun."

In the previous issue of "Pashtun," the word "Mulsaman" was printed instead of "Muslim" in the headline, and because of this error, we sincerely apologize to our esteemed Muslims from the bottom of our hearts, and we hope that they will forgive us for this minor mistake. This mistake was not intentional; rather, it was a technical error during printing. The "Pashtun" administration will clearly state this by correcting the error in its next issue.

It is worth noting by the editor of "Pashtun" that from the next issue onwards, we will be even more precise in our proofreading tasks so that such errors are not repeated.

895.right:
There is no doubt that much has been written about the first issue of "Islah" magazine, which was published in Kabul. The role this magazine could play in promoting a new culture and raising public awareness is a discussion that holds great importance in the history of journalism itself.

The following points regarding "Islah" magazine are noteworthy:
1. Addressing social issues: This magazine attempts to shed light on the shortcomings of society.
2. Promoting education: In this magazine, an attempt has been made to encourage people to learn by looking at the importance of education.
3. Literary and historical value: Such publications are considered a good mirror of the development of language and literature of that time.

Since this magazine is an important page in the history of Afghanistan's press, its preservation and study is a matter of pride for every Afghan.
895.left:
Reformative issues

I consider this magazine (Islah), belonging to my dear friend Mr. Faiz Mohammad Khan, who has dedicated his entire life to the progress of Afghans, as a new light. This magazine is not only a fulfiller of the demands of the time, but it is also a guide for those who are in search of the prosperity of the homeland.

In my opinion, Islah is not just a collection of lines on sheets of paper, but the birth of a new thought that must be read with care. I personally wish for the further success of this magazine and respect all those who work for this goal.

With God's farewell,
(Rayan Hamadshah)

The Pashtun villagers, through the blessed Kalima of Islam, took a new step forward to prove this true brotherhood by practicing the commandments of this great and sacred religion of Islam. In the same way, to begin this series of brotherhood, they started the work of building a new village, in which many excellent examples of everyone's participation and brotherhood were witnessed. In the process of building a new village in the wilderness away from their village, the people of this village set such new stages for mutual help and cooperation that they created a new example of pride and brotherhood for other Pashtun villagers. This series of brotherhood among the village people started at a time when no specific place had been designated for settlement in this area, nor was there any special project, but with the love and brotherhood of these people, this new village indicates the beginning of a new and developed society for them.

This step of brotherhood that the people of the village took among themselves is recognized as the beginning of a new civilization and a new life for other Pashtun villagers. This act of brotherhood and unity of these villagers, which they started in the light of the holy religion of Islam, opened a new path for new changes in their lives for the future, and these villagers succeeded in building a new society.

In this column, the opinions of some individuals regarding broadcasts have been discussed, some of which are as follows:

Opinions of some regarding New Year broadcasts:
Some people have expressed the opinion that regarding broadcasts, something should be said that is useful for the progress of society. These individuals add that it is necessary for broadcasts to publish material that increases people's knowledge and awareness. They emphasize that through broadcasts, people should be made aware of themselves, their rights, and their responsibilities. According to these individuals, if broadcasts are limited to only a specific circle, then expecting the mental development of the public is difficult, because the public must be provided with comprehensive information.

Opinions of some regarding theft:
Some other individuals have expressed the opinion regarding theft that theft is a bad act and a major obstacle in the path of society's progress. They say that to prevent theft, in addition to implementing the law, work must also be done on the moral training of the people. According to them, as long as work is not done to strengthen religious and moral feelings in people, this problem cannot be solved by punishment alone. These individuals emphasize the importance of education and training and say that through broadcasts, this evil phenomenon should also be fought against and people should be informed of its consequences.
897.left:
Some opinions regarding the doctor's services:
Some other people have expressed their opinion regarding the doctor's services by saying that a doctor should work with sincerity in the path of service and observe the demands of their duty while treating patients. According to them, a doctor should treat patients while considering their economic situation and adopt a kind and sympathetic attitude towards them. These people have placed great emphasis on the doctor's ethical conduct and say that a doctor is not only a possessor of knowledge but also a representative of philanthropy and benevolence. They add that if a doctor works with this spirit of service, it will not only be beneficial for the patient, but can also play a major role in the health of society. These opinions emphasize that the medical profession is a sacred profession and in it, the goal of saving human life should be prioritized over material benefits, because human life is more valuable than anything else.

900.right: When religion enters into life, the actions it takes for the improvement of human life are as follows: First, it instills the belief in the oneness of God Almighty in the human mind in such a way that there is no room for doubt or suspicion, and it is this very belief that prepares a path for the human soul and self that is free from the whispers of Satan and occupied with the pleasure of God. And then, it teaches the lesson of living according to the way of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), which is the path of salvation for humanity, in which there is a great wisdom, and this very wisdom becomes the cause of a great revolution in human life. And this is a truth that illuminates the face of every wise person, and shows them that the path taught in this book is a great path for every human being that cleanses them of their sins and sets them on the path of righteousness. And this is also the path that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) spread among his followers and planted the seed of faith in their hearts, and that seed then turned into a great tree whose shade became a cause of mercy for the entire world.
900.left:
Summary of the religion
Discussion: The life of Muslims during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was so brilliant through this book that they were free from all kinds of evil and corruption, and this life is a great example for today's Muslims. If Muslims today want to find a position of honor and prosperity in their lives, then it is necessary for them to follow the path of their Prophet's Sunnah and the guidance of the Quran, because the secret of success in this world and the hereafter lies in this. In this current era, where Muslims are facing all kinds of difficulties, their only way is to hold firmly to this religion and to fully act upon the commands of Allah Almighty, so that the help of Allah may come to them.

901.right: Suppose a person completes the recitation of the entire Quran, would he not be aware of what is in practice? Just like a man who was recommended by someone in the market to recite a new book, so he started reciting it with great love, just as someone reads a new book for knowledge, but there are many sins in this; however, when he was asked what this book is for and what is written in it, he was unaware. This means that there must be knowledge in religion and what is written in it; if we understand this, it will be for the reform of our lives, because the Holy Quran is a book of guidance, not just that we recite it and remain involved in our sins. We must protect ourselves from this and reflect on it; the commandments of Allah Almighty are present in it, so the knowledge of this is necessary for every Muslim, and all this is in this book, so it is necessary for us to understand the meaning of the Holy Quran and implement it in our actions.
901.left: Likewise, if a person borrows something from someone and gives nothing in return, this act is against Sharia, and it is a major sin; therefore, in return for this, one must seek forgiveness from Allah Almighty and remain very firm in repentance, because Allah Almighty is merciful to His servants and accepts their repentance, provided that they are remorseful for their sins and do not repeat that sin again, and in the future, they walk on the path of Allah Almighty, and align all the affairs of their life for the pleasure of Allah Almighty, and strive for the happiness of Allah Almighty with their own self and wealth, and do not consume the rights of other people and do not break anyone's heart; so by doing this, Insha'Allah, Allah Almighty will cover all his sins and grant him forgiveness, so it is necessary for every Muslim to strive in this path and make an effort for the reformation of his life.

902.right: In issue 15, we mentioned that certain matters regarding the essence and attributes of Allah Almighty, which are beyond the comprehension of human reason, must be believed in. This point is especially for those who wish to measure everything by the scale of reason. It is necessary for them to understand that reason is a limited thing. Just as there are many things in this universe that human reason cannot grasp, similarly, applying reason to the essence of Allah Almighty is futile. Such people who want to determine everything through reason are unaware of the Quran and Sunnah. Whereas, in many places in the Holy Quran, matters of the unseen are mentioned, and believing in them is mandatory for believers. The attribute of believers is precisely that they believe in the unseen and know that the knowledge of Allah Almighty is above all else. Accordingly, they do not ask questions about matters that are beyond reason, but rather believe in them blindly. Such behavior causes the strengthening of a person's faith and keeps their heart pure from other sins and doubts. In conclusion, we must say that reflecting on the attributes of Allah Almighty is a way to recognize His greatness, but delving into the nature of His essence is useless and a sign of the weakness of human reason. Therefore, it is necessary for every Muslim to have firm faith in this and to acknowledge the limitations of their own reason.
902.left: It is not the case that everything is measured by the scale of reason; for example, the reality of the soul, the nature of Hell and Paradise, and the various circumstances of the events of the Day of Judgment are all matters that do not fall within the scope of our reason. If someone wants to weigh all of these on the scale of reason, they will fail in the process. For this purpose, Allah Almighty has sent prophets to inform people about these truths. The word of the prophets is the word of Allah Almighty, and accepting it is obligatory for everyone. Besides this, the commandments of Allah Almighty are sometimes such that human reason cannot fully grasp their wisdom, but the duty of a believer is to accept them. For example, in acts of worship, there are some matters whose apparent wisdom is not known, but the essence of servitude lies in performing them. Therefore, based on this, using reason in matters of religion is necessary to help in fulfilling the commandments, not to criticize them. Every Muslim should align their life according to the guidance of the Quran and the Prophetic Sunnah and protect themselves from all kinds of doubts and temptations.

903.right:
The truth is that the human mind is affected by what people hear and see, and by such words that cause a change in the human heart. Therefore, in the context of explaining the effect of reciting the Holy Quran, Allah Almighty has stated: "And when the Quran is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy." In light of this noble verse, to educate people, we also present some points regarding the etiquette of reciting and listening to the Holy Quran. First, the etiquette of reciting the Holy Quran is: First, purity of heart and sincerity of intention are very necessary for recitation. It is necessary for a person, when reciting the Holy Quran, to empty their heart of all worldly thoughts and recite only for the pleasure of Allah Almighty, because Allah Almighty has stated that the deeds of servants depend on their intentions. Second, that the recitation of the Holy Quran should be done with great politeness and respect; during recitation, there should be a feeling of the greatness and majesty of Allah Almighty in the person's heart, and they should recite with great peace and dignity. Third, that during recitation, one should ponder and reflect on the meanings of the Holy Quran so that the message of the Holy Quran can be properly understood and one can align their life in its light, because the Holy Quran is not only for recitation but also for action.

Likewise, the etiquette of listening to the Holy Quran is also very important: First, during listening, one should pay heartfelt attention toward the Holy Quran and keep oneself away from other conversations and distractions, because the Holy Quran is the word of Allah Almighty and listening to it is at the level of worship. Second, that during listening, one should sit in an atmosphere of politeness and respect and listen with great focus, because the word of Allah Almighty is worthy of greatness and value. Third, that by listening, one should act upon the commandments of the Holy Quran, because the benefit of listening lies in the fact that a person acts upon the commandments of Allah Almighty.

910.right:
Editorial
On the guest of the new year
With this current issue, the seventh year of publication for the 1339 Hijri year is completed. With the fresh flowers of the new year, the publication series of "Pashtun" takes on a new form before the people of Pashtunkhwa. This publication is a mirror of the efforts of the fighters, servants of education, and seekers of independence of Pashtunkhwa. In our publications of the past years, an attempt has been made to present a clear picture of the pains, hopes, and future of this nation. Our goal is to find ways for the unity of Pashtuns, for education, and for the progress of the country. In this path, we have seen many problems and obstacles, but our determination is stronger than before. We want to further accelerate our efforts for the awakening of the Pashtun nation and the raising of their national consciousness. The new year is a year of new resolve and new light for the Pashtuns. We call upon the Pashtuns not to withhold their pens and written cooperation for the further strengthening of this national publication, because the life of publications depends on the support of the people.
910.left: The new year is a new opportunity for Pashtuns to take steps toward unity and solidarity. In past years, we have seen the problems the Pashtun nation has faced due to disunity, so it is necessary to work for unity in this new year. The struggle to spread education, maintain independence, and strengthen social justice is the duty of every Pashtun. The pages of our publication will, as always, be open to speaking the truth. We hope that the coming year will witness the progress and prosperity of the Pashtun nation. We thank all the patriots who have worked for the progress of this publication in past years. May God make this new year a year of success and happiness for all Pashtuns, and may an atmosphere of unity and brotherhood be established in their homeland. Finally, we request all readers and colleagues to contribute to enriching this national publication.

913.right:
Clarifications on the Day of New Intercession:
Question: Does intercession exist?
Answer: Yes, intercession exists and is proven by the consensus of the scholars of the Ummah. According to the Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah, the intercession of the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) for sinners is a truth, and this intercession is for those who have died in a state of faith and have not repented for their sins. Allah Almighty, by His grace, grants His Prophet (PBUH) permission to intercede so that he may intercede for his Ummah.
Question: Who is intercession needed for on the Day of Judgment?
Answer: According to the belief of the Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah, intercession is for those believers who obeyed Allah (SWT) and His Messenger (PBUH) in this world, and who would be deserving of punishment on the Day of Judgment due to their sins; Allah Almighty removes their punishment through the intercessors.
Question: Is intercession performed for all people?
Answer: No, it is stated in the Holy Quran that for the oppressors there will be no friend or intercessor whose word will be accepted; this means that disbelievers and polytheists are not eligible for intercession. Intercession is only for those who have died upon the word of Tawhid (monotheism).
913.left:
In conclusion, we must say that intercession (Shafa'at) is a matter that we must believe in; it is a sign of Allah Almighty's mercy that He has ordained for the forgiveness of His servants. However, we must remember that intercession cannot replace a person's deeds. Every human being must attain the pleasure of Allah Almighty by performing good deeds in this world, and the hope of intercession should be for those who have observed the commandments of Allah (SWT) in their lives.
Question: Will the intercession of the Prophet (PBUH) be for all sinners?
Answer: The intercession of the Prophet (PBUH) is for the major sinners of his Ummah who have died in a state of faith. This intercession is for those who are in punishment due to their sins; by the blessing of this intercession, Allah Almighty will save them from punishment and admit them into Paradise. This is an important part of the Islamic creed that we must believe in.
Question: What prevents intercession?
Answer: Disbelief (Kufr), polytheism (Shirk), and having doubt or skepticism regarding the commandments of religion are obstacles to intercession. Allah Almighty has stated in the Quran that He does not grant intercession to those with whom He (SWT) is not pleased. Therefore, we must arrange our lives in such a way that we become worthy of Allah Almighty's pleasure, so that we may be deserving of intercession on the Day of Judgment.

918.right:
Name
A 50-year-old British popular government
(Series continued from the previous issue)
In the context of the formation of the new law, the Act, from Britain, including the current situation, its progress, the level of public awareness in Britain, its development, and the formation of the new republic, which was presented by the British government on June 28, 1918, in the form of reforms and new laws under the name of the new republic, we will discuss the importance of this law in detail as follows.
This law, known as the British Republic Act, came into being as a result of the demands and struggle of the people of India that had been initiated by the people of India over the past few years. This law was considered an important step toward fulfilling those demands of the people of India.
There were many parts in this law that were very beneficial for the people of India, and in particular, they held great value for the education and progress of the people of India. With the implementation of this law, the people of India were allowed to participate in the development of their country's affairs and share their opinions with the government.
With the implementation of this law, a new spirit of political consciousness and the demand for their rights emerged among the people of India, which was very important for the future of India. This law was a great victory for the people of India and opened new doors for its progress.
918.left:
Regarding this new reform law of India, the opinion of many people was that it is a very important and progressive law and will be the cause of great benefit for the people of India. This law was considered an important step for the unity and progress of the people of India and created a spirit of trust and confidence among the people of India.
Although different political groups and people from various sections of society had their own opinions about this law, on the whole, it was a law that opened new paths of progress for the people of India and marked the beginning of a new phase for the political future of India.
Despite the hopes and expectations of many people regarding this law, there were also some doubts and questions among some people in India about this law, which is a natural thing; the existence of doubts and questions in any innovation is necessary for its maturity and improvement.

In the history of Islamic civilization, we see that whenever Muslims achieved excellence in the field of morality, they also remained world leaders in the fields of science and art. However, today, due to this weakness, our life is moving on a path whose result appears only in the form of discord and chaos. Therefore, it is necessary to think seriously about this and take specific steps for moral education. Merely mentioning Islamic civilization in words is not enough; rather, by putting it into practice, this change must be brought about in the life of every Muslim so that the true face of Islamic civilization may shine once again on the face of the world.

924.right:
Circumstances
Every nation needs a distinct way to preserve its history so that the causes of its progress and decline can be determined. Although the history of Islam begins with the advent of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), Allah Almighty has made such arrangements through heavenly books for the circumstances of his blessed life that there is no more reliable information about anyone else. This path is the Prophetic Sunnah, in which every word and action of his life is preserved. If we consider both these paths of history and Sunnah, we realize that at the beginning of every era of Islam, Allah Almighty has created individuals who have worked for the protection of the religion and the reformation of the people.
If we study the history of India, from Akbar to Aurangzeb, and after him, from the decline of Islam to the beginning of the new era, many such events come to light that are a place of reflection for every Muslim. The 'Din-i-Ilahi' that was created during Akbar's time, and the many events that occurred after that until the era of Aurangzeb, brought a very great change in the lives of Muslims. In this regard, the achievements of Shah Waliullah Dehlawi are worth mentioning, for the path he adopted to end the corruption of his time and his efforts to breathe a new spirit into the hearts of Muslims.
924.left:
The new era and our responsibilities
This is a fact that no one can turn a blind eye to. If we look at the book of past history, it becomes clear to us that in every era of Islam, Muslims faced a challenge that was a time of testing for their faith and the teachings of Islam. The era we live in today is an era of knowledge and scientific advancement. The demand of this new era is that we find answers to the problems of today in the light of the principles of our religion.
It is a great responsibility for us to take lessons from our past history and pave a way for the future in which there is a balance between Islamic ethics and modern sciences. In this regard, it is the duty of scholars and intellectuals to present a roadmap for Muslims that ensures success for them in both this world and the hereafter. If we learn from our past history, it will be a very big step for the glory of Islam.

These were the incidents that held a place in the pure heart of Aisha (RA) amidst the warmth of faith. Whenever revelation would descend, the sound of her body trembling would reach the ears of those close to her. In such states, her life would pass in a strange and unseen quality. When she would speak about the word of Allah Almighty, there was such power and light of truth in her speech that it would find its way into everyone's heart. This was a time when, in the early days of the call to Islam, her role appeared as a guide, and her insight and knowledge held the status of a strong pillar in the propagation of the religion. In her heart, there was no room for anything other than the pleasure of Allah Almighty, and she had dedicated her life to this very path.
939.left: It is necessary to mention a few important points regarding economics. Economics is not just the name of material gain, but a fundamental necessity for the order of human society and the improvement of life's affairs. In ancient times, with the growth of trade, the need for the science of economics also arose. With the emergence of money, the methods of transaction between people changed. Economists believe that for the progress of every nation, its resources must be utilized properly. If we want to be owners of a strong economy, then we must seek new ways and means in the light of science and knowledge. Maintaining a balance between industry and agriculture is a condition for the flourishing of the economy. Furthermore, raising the standard of living of the common people and establishing a fair distribution system to eradicate poverty is the duty of every government.

940.right:
Issues of Nikah (Marriage)

The rights of a woman that have been ordained by Allah (SWT) are as follows:
First: The right to Mahr (dowry). Nikah is concluded with Mahr, and it is incumbent upon the husband to give Mahr to his wife.
Second: If Mahr is determined in the Nikah and then the husband lives separately for a period or is unable to pay the Mahr, then according to Islamic Sharia, it is the woman's right to receive her Mahr. If the husband dies, the woman's Mahr is paid first from his remaining estate.
Third: In the husband's absence, the wife's maintenance and the upbringing of the children are the husband's responsibility. If the husband is traveling or missing from home, the expenses for the wife and children must be paid from his assets.
Fourth: Protecting the honor and dignity of the wife is the husband's duty. It is necessary for the husband to live with his wife in kindness and fulfill her rights completely.
Fifth: The woman's right to inheritance, which is established in the Book of Allah (SWT), no one has the permission to trample upon this right. If the husband passes away, the wife has her fixed share in his remaining inheritance.
Sixth: If there is a dispute between the husband and wife, then according to Sharia, a decision must be made between them with justice and fairness.
940.left:
Seventh: If a wife requests a divorce from her husband, then her rights must be considered and her dowry (Mahr) must be paid in full.
Eighth: The upbringing and care of children is not solely the wife's duty; rather, the husband is also responsible for this. Joint effort by the husband and wife is necessary for the proper upbringing of children.
Ninth: Witnesses must be present at the time of marriage so that they may bear witness to the marriage contract and protect each other's rights.
Tenth: The wife's family rights, which are rooted in Pashtun culture and Islamic principles, must be respected by the husband, and he should not commit injustice against her.
In conclusion, we must say that the purpose of an Islamic marriage is to build a pure society in which love, sympathy, and respect for each other's rights exist.

What the Almighty has said: (If you do not do so, then be warned of a war from Allah and His Messenger), meaning if you do not abandon interest, then prepare for war from Allah and His Messenger. This verse is very strong regarding the prohibition of interest. If someone is engaged in the business of interest and has not repented, they are prepared for war from Allah and His Messenger. This is a very great and dangerous war. May the Almighty God protect us from this great sin and may He grant us repentance from interest. Amen.

Ninety-five points of benefit:
When Islam views interest with prohibition, it has a great wisdom. Interest is in conflict with the philosophy of Islam that strengthens the spirit of brotherhood and cooperation among the members of society. Interest causes the concentration of wealth and leads to further poverty for the poor. It hinders the progress of humanity and divides society into two parts: one of those who possess all the wealth, and the other of those who do not even have the basic necessities of life. One of the goals of the system of Zakat and charity in Islamic Sharia is that the circulation of wealth should be among all classes of society.
941.left: And instead of interest, (Qard-e-Hasana) and such methods of trade have been taught in which there is benefit for the society. Interest is an important cause of destroying the foundations of the economic system, because in the interest-based system, labor and hard work are not valued; rather, money is obtained in exchange for money, which is an act against social justice. If we want to have a successful society, then we must save ourselves from the evil system of interest and promote our transactions in the light of the Islamic economic system. For this, it is necessary to acquire knowledge of Islamic moral and economic laws and to resolve to save ourselves from the curse of interest for the sake of Allah Almighty's pleasure in our daily affairs. May Allah Almighty's grace be with us so that we may be successful in performing this duty.

The second stage of Pashtun's journey

Thanks be to Allah that after six and a half years of separation and the patience-testing wait of the great mother of Rome, "Pashtun" once again has the honor of reaching the hands of its dear readers. This was not the first stage of Pashtun's separation; rather, as is known to many of our readers, once before the cruelty of time had come between us and Pashtun, because of Pashtun's immortal voice of truth and honesty. The forces of falsehood, arrogant as always, had shown themselves in the field of opposition. This time, too, the dark and terrifying forces of tyranny, like the sun's rays on the blue sky of time, have shone—Pashtun was first published nearly ten years ago in April 1928 as a monthly magazine—it had traveled for two years and one month on the sea of politics with its scientific, reformist, and political ship—when the storm of revolution brought a ban upon it and it was forced into a hiatus. Peace was established between the government and the public. Fakhr-e-Afghan Sahib and other political prisoners were released. "Pashtun" also resumed its journey after a month and a half, following the peace. The world knows that in its first era, Pashtun had brought a global revolution to the mind of the Pashtun public. So, in the second instance, it took a greater part in the Khudai Khidmatgar organization. Eight months of imprisonment had passed in that state. Finally, in December and January, the manuscript was sent to the printing press, but then a conflict and rift occurred between the public and the government; Fakhr-e-Afghan Sahib and all other political workers were arrested, so "Pashtun" was forced to leave the field of journalism again and the printing was stopped. For almost six years, Fakhr-e-Afghan Sahib was imprisoned and detained in other provinces of India, far from his beloved homeland. Here, there were strict restrictions on printing presses and newspapers, and "Pashtun" could not be published. Finally, in the last months of last year, Fakhr-e-Afghan Sahib received permission to return to his homeland. And along with that, the authority of the provincial government also came into the hands of the national ministry. So, once again, the opportunity arose for "Pashtun" to enter the field of action and continue its service.
Although the effort to resume "Pashtun" had started six months ago, every task that the bureaucratic government considers its own, it does not easily grant permission for. So, a lot of time passed in obtaining the permission. Finally, this stage was also passed. Now, the issue of "Pashtun" is presented to the nation in the form of a ten-day newspaper instead of a monthly magazine.
The question arises, what will "Pashtun" do? What is its policy? Regarding others, it will be enough to say this - that "Pashtun" does not have commercial interests in mind, nor is any financial gain its objective. Its first [goal] was also the nation's betterment, the country's progress.

The Khudai Khidmatgar Movement and its affairs
(From Fakhr-e-Afghan Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan)

Dear Pashtun brothers! I have always explained the main objectives of the Khudai Khidmatgar movement to you in clear words in my speeches. Nothing is hidden or secret. However, it may happen that there are some of my brothers who have not had the opportunity to hear my speeches, or perhaps they have heard the speeches but have not understood their meaning, or perhaps they have understood them but, upon hearing the words of others, doubts have arisen in their hearts. So today, through my newspaper "Pashtun," I want to speak once again in clear, plain words about the goal of the Khudai Khidmatgar movement I have started. And through these words, I want to explain to you all: for what purpose was this movement started? What will be its result? And who will benefit from it?

Dear brothers! God Almighty has a system, and His power is based on a complete law. From the time He created the world and spread the children of Adam (peace be upon him) across the world, He has made the world famous as different nations for different statuses and inhabitants, and He has given each nation a portion of the earth or a country.
957.left: is. And for the cultivation of this land or country, for the preservation of the independence of this country, and for the peace of the people of this country, they have created a law for themselves. God Almighty has created all these nations in the world so that they may help one another in their comfort. Not that one should see happiness for oneself in destroying another and in enslaving another. So when this is the state of the nations of the world, then why are the Pashtuns separate from these nations of the world? And why was the need for the Khudai Khidmatgar movement felt among the Pashtuns? Listen to this matter carefully, that in the past, a time had come upon the Pashtuns when the independence of the Pashtuns had ended. The Pashtuns were bound in the chains of slavery. And other powerful nations of the world had divided the land of the Pashtuns among themselves. The Pashtuns were themselves under the feet of foreigners in their own home country. From the Pashtuns, their honor, their wealth, their children, and their God were lost in this slavery. A state had emerged among the Pashtuns where unity and brotherhood among them had ended. One Pashtun had become a means of destruction for another. To end this slavery and bad state, this thought arose in my heart that the Pashtuns must free themselves from this bad state of theirs. And regain their God-given freedom. So that is why I started the Khudai Khidmatgar movement. And the purpose of this movement of mine was only that Pashtuns should share in each other's grief and take each other's hand and free themselves from these chains of slavery and regain the freedom of their homeland. So my dear ones! This is the main purpose of the Khudai Khidmatgar movement, that Pashtuns must once again recognize themselves and make sacrifices for the freedom of their homeland.

Death in life is the reason why a person's honor, dignity, and prestige remain in the eyes of others, because in his absence, things are said about his life's work that he would not have had the patience to hear while alive. There are different types of death, and every person's reaction to death is also different. Various opinions have also been expressed by scholars and researchers regarding death. Death is that eternal and unchangeable truth of life from which no one can escape; every human being thinks about the fear of death or this reality during their life.

Death is such an event in a human's life that all things of his existence are suddenly lost in the mouth of death, yet human opinions about death are different. Some humans view death as a liberation, while others consider death the end of life and fear it. In reality, death is such a point in a human's life that it causes all of a person's affairs to come to an end, and their entire life story concludes with death.

When we discuss the thoughts and opinions of scholars regarding this, we realize that humans have never remained of one opinion regarding death. Human views on life have changed at different times, but the reality of death has never changed. In the same way, by studying the opinions of scholars regarding the fear of death or any kind of thought about it, we reach the conclusion that humans think a lot about life in the face of the fear of death.

Although these efforts to spread education were limited and were carried out under very difficult and complex circumstances, they created a love for education and knowledge in a specific group of Pashtuns, which resulted in the feeling of its necessity becoming so strong among the Pashtuns that it was later used as a powerful weapon in the course of the nation's progress and political efforts.

1021.right: In the first (Q), it is written in the course of Maulana Sahib's response that the Maulana Sahib of the British era spent his entire life in great hardship and out of expediency, and at a time when he made many efforts for unity with his people and for patriotism, but now he has faced such deprivation that people express regret because of his actions. In this era, those who strive in their homelands for the progress of the country are greatly tormented by taunts and bad words; this is the situation that Maulana Sahib mentions as a great test for himself, and with God's help, he has chosen patience.
1021.left: (R) In this response of Maulana Sahib, it is written: That I do not care about any kind of fatigue or blame upon myself, and I view my duty to the homeland as a sacred trust. If, due to my reformative efforts, I become a victim of some people's suspicion and distrust, then this is the strength of my conviction. The goal of my path is to raise the awareness of the people and protect the interests of the homeland. If I were to give up my efforts because of people's bad words and taunts, then this would be an act of disloyalty toward my independence and my love for the homeland. My efforts are for all those who work with a sincere heart for the progress of the country and the improvement of education and training; my path is the path of truth, and I will remain on this path until the very end.

1110.left:
Prejudice and Fanaticism
By Mr. Syed Ali Jeka Shah Khan Khakwani
Principles of the subjects:-
(1) A group of people who are the children of one ancestor is called a "family" (khandan).
(2) A collection of these families is called a "tribe" (qabila).
(3) The status of a collection of families is called a "group" (jamaat).
(4) Whenever groups come together, it is termed a "nation" (qawm).
(5) When a nation lives in one homeland, speaks one language, shares one religion, and shares in solitude, then such a nation is a nation in the true sense.
(6) It is necessary that in every nation, there are individual, familial, tribal, and group differences, provided that national unity remains intact, and the binding force of this unity is a sentiment which in Arabic is called "asabiyyah" (fanaticism), and in Pashto it is called "rawi-wal" (solidarity/loyalty).
(7) When this sentiment becomes excessive, it is called prejudice and Pashtun chauvinism, but if one nation holds prejudice against another nation, despite this, they do not call it a defect of the nation, but rather consider it a virtue and take pride in it.
(8) Of course, if this defect of prejudice exists within families, tribes, or groups, then this is a bad thing, and it is called sectarianism.

1122.right:
A twenty-year history
Afghan diplomatic representation (embassy) by the free people of Kabul (1919 AD)
In accordance with this historical demand by the people of Kabul and the subsequent declaration of independence, an Afghan government delegation was appointed for diplomatic representation. This delegation, consisting of the following three parts, began its work with full courage and determination:
(1) The goal of this delegation was to officially present the independence of the Afghan state to other countries of the world and to be recognized among them as an independent and free nation.
(2) In cooperation with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to create policies to strengthen Afghanistan's political position at the international level and to establish relations with neighboring countries based on brotherhood and equality.
(3) Considering regional conditions and the political complexities of the time, to adopt a procedure for defending the rights of the Afghan nation that would safeguard the country's national interests and prevent any kind of foreign interference.
In line with the Afghan government's objectives, this diplomatic delegation presented its demands in various meetings with other countries in the region and their leaders, and expressed the will of the Afghans to them. To implement these tasks, a special procedure was established, which was divided into the following parts:
A - Establishing a permanent commission for strengthening diplomatic relations to cooperate directly with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the sake of protecting the country's national interests.
B - Signing agreements with foreign countries in which Afghanistan's independence and territorial integrity are officially recognized.
C - Arranging a regular schedule for meetings with those foreign ambassadors and representatives who wish to establish official relations with the Afghan government and discuss matters of mutual interest.
1122.left:
Journal page 29
This diplomatic delegation faced some challenges early in its work, because the colonial powers of the region were trying to protect their interests regarding Afghanistan, but the Afghan delegation, thanks to its determination and national unity, succeeded in overcoming these obstacles. While presenting their demands, they took a stance as representatives of the Afghan nation that showed the world that Afghanistan is a historical and civilized country that fights to the end for its freedom. Another important part of this delegation's activities was related to promoting the legitimacy of Afghanistan's independence through the media, through which they were able to gain significant support from the people of the world. Besides this, the participation of Afghan representatives in various international meetings caused the voice of the Afghan government to reach the ears of the countries of the world and demand justice regarding their rights. This historical action is considered the beginning of a new era in the history of Afghan diplomacy, which laid the foundation for the future progress and prosperity of the country. In this process, the individuals appointed by the government also performed their duties with honesty and did not spare any effort in the way of fulfilling the hopes of their people.

1147.right:
Two years ago

With the intention of perfuming the minds of its readers with the fragrance of the flowers of this flourishing garden of "Pashtun" newspaper, and in the series of printing its opening pages, to celebrate the one-year anniversary of the publication of the first issue of "Pashtun", and in the series of printing and publishing the special edition of the first issue of the second year of "Pashtun", it offers heartfelt congratulations to the fans of "Pashtun". This is the beginning of the first issue of the second year of "Pashtun", which is another step for the full recognition of the results of the comprehensive efforts and endeavors of the first year of printing and publishing, and for celebrating the historical and national role of "Pashtun" in the promotion of the Pashto language and the spread of unity and brotherhood among Pashtuns, and for the encouragement of the proud and heroic Pashtuns of Pashtunkhwa and the further strengthening of the national uprising.

We hope that this second year of "Pashtun" will be as colorful as its flowers and, thanks to the pens of its writers, will shine like a bright torch in the path of the flourishing of the Pashto language and literature and the national unity of the Pashtuns, and will keep the spirit of Pashtunwali even more alive in the hearts of its fans.
1147.left: Regarding this special issue of the first edition of the second year of "Pashtun," I must say that I thank all my friends and contributors for printing this issue, who have worked shoulder to shoulder with me in this endeavor and have spared no effort for the beauty and vibrancy of this issue. This issue is an example of the creative works of young and new writers of Pashtunkhwa and the enrichment of Pashto language literature, which is considered an important step for the national unity of the Pashtuns and the pride of the Pashtuns.

Pashtun heroes
Many such people have passed through this country who have served God's creation with their swords, but Shah Wali Khan's services are distinguished and separate from all of them. Shah Wali Khan was the person who, with great indifference, served the homeland at the cost of his own life. He was among those people who, with great bravery, put his life at risk to protect the honor and dignity of this country. He stood firm like a mountain against the tyrants of the time and never bowed his head before anyone. This was a sign of his courage and zeal that he would stand as a leader in every difficulty of the homeland.

It is the work of God Almighty that death comes to every human being, but those who dedicate their lives to their homeland, their names remain forever. Shah Wali Khan was one of those people who had taken a place in the hearts of the people through his character and actions. His memory will always be alive in the hearts of Afghans.

The Situation in Palestine

Author: Hazrat Maulana Syed Muhammad Yaqub Sahib

I know that cries of oppression are heard everywhere from every corner of the world, but there is no doubt that among the oppressed of the current world, the cries of the oppressed Muslims of Palestine are heard with such burning from the heart that they create a storm of grief and pain in the heart of every Muslim that is beyond the bounds of restraint and patience. In terms of world geography, Palestine is that part which has remained the center of the invitations of the Prophets (peace be upon them) from every side; from Hazrat Ibrahim (peace be upon him) to Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (peace be upon him), Allah Almighty has maintained a special connection with this blessed land. This is the land that, when it became filled with the oppressions and transgressions of the Bani Israel, Allah Almighty took this blessing away from them, and with the advent of Islam, this land came under the control of the Muslims as their eternal property and their first Qibla.

Permanent peace for the people of today lies in a few points.
