Letter response

11 June 1920 AD

This is a translation of an article from the May issue of the Peshawar newspaper - in which the article by the subject Malalai, titled "Who does not know you," was interesting - more than a month has passed since we published this article - during this month, a large number of letters arrived - in which they attributed this article to Dr. Khalil of Charbagh - and they claim that this article is not actually written by him - and he has no information about it - and this is while we had attributed these letters to the writer - who had started this series of publishing their writings by publishing this article in that issue of the Peshawar newspaper - and this is while people also say that these letters were written by people who have no connection with the publication of this newspaper - and this matter is surprising to us that people talk like this about it - this is a baseless accusation that people have attached to this newspaper - we are presenting all this information before the people so that people may understand what the truth is - we examined all these letters and the people's talk with great care and we reached the conclusion that this is nothing but the ill-will of the people.
2250.left: We presented all these letters to the public so that people could understand the truth of this matter and offer their opinions regarding the entire situation - Through our newspaper, we are placing all this information before the public to show that all these things being said about the newspaper are baseless - We fully believe that this newspaper of ours is for spreading the path of truth, and we will never abandon this path - We hope that all people will assist us in the process of publishing this newspaper so that we can present the truth to the people - We thank all those who are helping us in this regard and sending us their opinions through their writings - We will strive to keep this series continuing in the same way and present the truth to the people -

In Pashtun Illustrated 11 June 1920:

When the Pashtuns gathered in Kandahar from the land of Iran, they unanimously took the command of the army away from Noor Muhammad Khan Alizai. This was because he had been appointed as an employee of the King by Nader Shah, and they did not consider it appropriate to accept working under an employee of a foreign king. After this, a grand jirga of all the regions of Kandahar, which included Abdalis, Ghiljis, Balochs, Hazaras, and Qizilbash, was assembled. They deliberated on how to regain their freedom. They all agreed that in any case, they must pursue a confrontation with the Iranian government, because Iran and the Pashtuns could not rule over one another. Then they decided that it was necessary to select a king of their own, in whose hands both administrative and military powers would rest. Selecting a king from among so many tribes was not an easy task for the Pashtuns. Each tribe presented its own rights to obtain the throne. Much debate and discussion took place; historians say that nearly three jirgas were held to decide this matter, but no decision was reached. Ahmad Khan Sadozai, all the past on Herat

2269.right:
For the students of the educational high school

In 1920, in the process of obtaining scholarships for the students of the educational high school, the decision to grant a scholarship for them is ongoing in the course of obtaining educational high school scholarships for the students.

In order to obtain a scholarship for this high school, in addition to the following conditions, it is necessary to follow the conditions below in the course of implementing an easy procedure:

(1) A certificate from the school teacher regarding the student's education, knowledge, morals, and the level of their knowledge, in which details about the student's knowledge, education, abilities, and morals are recorded.
(2) Obtaining a certificate from the school officials regarding the improvement of the student's knowledge and education, and the verification of the school officials' seal on it.
(3) The process of submitting the student's educational documents in the course of conducting a special evaluation for the student's level of knowledge, educational capability, and the status of their education.
(4) Submitting relevant documents regarding the financial status of the student's family in the process of obtaining a scholarship for each student.
(5) For all students who wish to be selected by a special committee in the process of obtaining a scholarship, it is mandatory to act in accordance with the following instructions in the process of submitting all necessary documents for receiving the scholarship.

A special appeal for volumes
The fire that has been ignited in Pashtunkhwa in the form of non-payment of taxes has been ignited at a time when an endless series of hardships and calamities is spread across the entire homeland. The people are heavily indebted to the government; in such circumstances where the people do not have the ability to stand on their own feet, the government is exerting such pressure to collect its debts that it has set everyone's heart on fire. This decision of non-payment of taxes has come into practice once again not just from one region of the Pashtuns, but as a national movement. Due to the implementation of this decision, it has attained a national status that is a great example of the emergence of a national consciousness in the hearts of the people, due to a new spirit and a new understanding. This Pashtunkhwa, which is striving to breathe the air of independence in every part, has created a new hope through the unity of this decision, the need for which is the great demand of the time. As a new expression of a new national movement on the lips of the people, this is an example of such a struggle of the Pashtun that is a great proof of their unity.

Pashtun Laghazi
16

First: General News

In the series of monthly news under the veil of the First World War, these news items were printed one after another in the first part itself, but in the Peshawar news bulletin of June 21, they have been printed in the following manner:

1- In the course of this news, it was discovered that the Prime Minister of France visited Peshawar; when the time was up, this matter was kept secret by the British government. For this very reason, the British government announced that Peshawar is a very important place for the war, and declared it as a secret location for the war. Because of this war, the British government took steps to establish a new, large, and strong system for the war in Peshawar, and the British government built a new military center in Peshawar for the war.

2- These news items, which were announced by the British government, are such that steps have been taken to build a very large center for the war in Peshawar, and for the construction of this system, the British government has placed a very heavy burden on the people of Peshawar, which has caused signs of sadness and anger to appear among the people due to this burden. Because of this situation, the people in Peshawar have become very distressed and have presented their protests to the British government.

3- In the course of this news, it is also stated that due to the British government building a new system for the war in Peshawar, signs of high unemployment and famine have appeared among the people, which has made the lives of the people very difficult.

4- Among the people of Peshawar, because of this war, they have become victims of great poverty and difficulties, which has made living very hard for them. It was necessary for the British government to solve this problem of the people, but the British government did not take any steps in this direction.

5- In the course of this news, regarding the publication of news about the conditions of the people of Peshawar, it is said that the people in Peshawar have formed a great alliance among themselves, have raised their voices against the British government, and are demanding their rights.

2290.right:
A new path for Pashto

Regarding the new writing style of the Pashto language, looking at the services of the reformers, although in the series of suggestions by a number of Pashto scholars regarding this issue, recently a step was taken in Peshawar by a number of writers and authors for the development of this language, during which we are facing many difficulties in writing some letters of the Pashto language, because many Pashto letters are similar in writing and cause errors in reading, to solve these problems, some suggestions have recently been brought forward by a number of Pashto writers, that some changes should be made in the style of writing the letters of the Pashto language.
2290.left: In this series, suggestions have been made by a number of scholars regarding the introduction of new forms for certain specific letters such as "ځ", "څ", and others, and the efforts made by a number of writers to take measures in the field of the Pashto language are very commendable, although our writers still face some challenges in writing these letters in the new form in their writings, and voices of opposition regarding this new style are also being heard from a number of other writers. Although this is a major step for the enrichment of the language, this work faces some difficulties in the beginning, even though there are still differences among writers regarding language reform in Pashto.

2291.right: In the past, regarding the Pashto alphabet, on the first page of the first issue, some necessary points were made about the Pashto alphabet. In the course of the series of various opinions and views regarding the formation of Pashto letters and the Pashto alphabet through the press, it is also worth noting that Pashto letters are more numerous than Arabic letters, such as (څ, ځ, ښ, ږ, ړ, ډ, ڼ), and there are many disagreements among Pashto language readers and scholars in this regard, because no common and fixed law has been established for the orthography of these letters, so everyone has written them in different ways according to their own taste and preference, which has become a major obstacle for Pashto education and Pashto readers. This problem has caused a kind of disagreement among scholars and writers in writing and printing Pashto books, and everyone chooses a style for themselves, so it is necessary that a comprehensive and acceptable law be established for the orthography of the Pashto alphabet letters and a unified and standard writing system be created for the development of the Pashto language.
2291.left: In order to resolve the differences regarding Pashto letters, it is necessary to appoint a scientific committee that, while considering the opinions of Pashto scholars and the historical and literary values of the Pashto language, creates a unified and definitive law for the orthography of the alphabet. In the light of this law, Pashto books will be printed in a standardized format and will be understandable for readers. Pashto is a historical and ancient language, and for the preservation and development of this language, it is the duty of every Pashtun to take action to protect their linguistic and cultural heritage. It is hoped that this series, which has now begun, will be a new step for Pashto literature and education and will play an important role in the path of standardizing the Pashto language. In conclusion, we can say that the continuation of these discussions regarding the unification of the Pashto alphabet is the duty of every Pashtun, and we welcome all kinds of opinions on this subject, because the exchange of scientific discussions and ideas is necessary for the development of the language.

2293.right:
Pashtun girls

There is no doubt that for the education of the Pashtun girl, it is necessary to make efforts for education and progress with great force from every aspect against old-fashioned and ignorant people, and it must be said with full confidence that the Pashtun girl also has full aptitude for every kind of education that is within the framework of our country and our religion, and she can learn it very well. However, one thing that is worthy of much consideration and thought is that a very big defect in our current education is that our current education is not for the life of the Pashtun girl, it is not such an education that would be useful to her in the affairs of life, but rather our education is a step towards foreign morals for our society. Therefore, in order for our Pashtun girl to be educated and also remain firm in her morals and her religious and national affairs, education must be consistent with her life in all areas. So, for this purpose, in the education curriculum, books and education should be arranged regarding the affairs of Pashtun life, the rights of the Pashtun sister, and the management of the family, so that it creates love in her heart for her home, her village, and her nation, and creates in her a sense of working for her society.
2293.left:
Pashtun girls

Now it is necessary that we align our education with the life of a Pashtun woman, otherwise this education will become a cause of misfortune instead of prosperity for our homes, because our society can never move towards improvement by imitating the morals of others. Therefore, it is necessary that we popularize an education that is a strong foundation for the personality of a Pashtun girl in the light of Pashtunwali, and that creates in her the spirit of service to religion and the homeland, not that it separates her from her roots and colors her in the colors of strangers.
(Editorial)

Pashtun Doctor
How did Ahmad Shah take the path of movement with his forces? Ahmad Shah Abdali laid the foundation of a government for the unity and freedom of the Afghans, in which he bravely accepted all kinds of problems and challenges. In his lifetime, Ahmad Shah laid a foundation for uniting the fragmented regions of Afghanistan, through which he created a powerful government including Afghanistan, eastern regions, and parts of India. One of the important parts of the structure of Ahmad Shah Abdali's government was his special attention to strengthening his army and military power and reforming the administrative system of the government. Ahmad Shah is remembered in the history of Afghanistan as a king who made tireless efforts for the unity of his people. During his reign, the sense of brotherhood and unity among Afghans was strengthened, and he was able to build a system for the defense of the country that was an example for other countries in the region at that time. From the writings of historians about Ahmad Shah Abdali, it is clear that he was a just king and a committed leader for the well-being of the Afghan people.

Important News

The important news of this week regarding the European war is that France has signed
a temporary peace treaty with Germany and the war in the French
territories has ended. The terms of the peace treaty are as follows: -
(1) All of France's western coast and the entire northern coastal region
will be under German occupation. And the expenses of the occupation, including the costs
of protecting those places, will be paid by France.
(2) The French armed forces will be demobilized. However, in the part of France
that is not under German occupation, there will be a military force,
but no army shall cross the northern border of Germany.
(3) Germany demands all of France's joint artillery, telephones,
airplanes, and other weapons in any condition
(meaning whether broken or unusable).
(4) No French soldier shall leave their territory.
(5) No aid can be given from France to Britain.
(6) No French ship shall leave a French port.
(7) And any ships that are not French will be sunk.
(8) All such equipment must be handed over to Germany in any condition.
These principles will apply to the blockade, fortifications, naval ships, all
factories, railway lines, and all communications that are currently operating.

On the deathbed
An Egyptian scholar, "Ustad Tahir," has written a book titled "Ala Farash al-Mawt" (On the Deathbed). In this truly interesting book, the author writes the names of the kings, scholars, brave men, and other authors of his time; this article has been taken from that book.
Sheikh Muhammad Abduh, who was a student of our Pashtun mentor Sayyid Jamal al-Din al-Afghani, spent his life in prison like Abul Kalam Azad and Bacha Khan, or in exile like Maulana Mansoor and Maulana Ubaidullah Sindhi, and in the end, he became the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Egypt. This article relates to the time of pain and sorrow.
Muhammad Abduh on the deathbed
First diagnosis: The Sheikh's health has deteriorated.
Second diagnosis: It is not that, but rather he has stomach cancer.
Third diagnosis: You cannot do this work; this is a disease that is seen in every scholar and mujahid dedicated to national work, which comes after many severe sorrows and hardships. The only cure for this is to rest and cast aside sorrows.
Muhammad Abduh: Brothers, this is a real disease, which [is caused by] the pain of the homeland at the hands of enemies and ignorant, jealous people of the homeland.

2399.right:
Account and Pashtun (6)
14 Rajab 1338 AH corresponding to 15 August 1920 AD

From the lines of the Pashtun (newspaper) of our late departed friends.

There are many friends who write many messages in the newspaper for the enjoyment of our newspaper and the continuous enjoyment of the Pashtun of our late departed friends, and in their letters, they express heartfelt love and feelings of sacrifice for Pashto and Pashtunwali. Some friends are such that by reading every issue of our newspaper, new feelings of Pashtunwali are generated in them, and new love for the service of the homeland is created, for which they write many messages in their letters and say that these lines of the Pashtun newspaper are like a lamp for Pashtuns these days, showing the way like light in darkness. For all these scholars and friends, we express our sincere gratitude. There is space in this newspaper for the solution of all kinds of moral and national issues for them, and we will always try to do for our friends what will be beneficial for Pashtuns from a moral and national perspective and will be a harbinger of new light and a new life for Pashtuns.
2399.left:
For the Pashtun students to fulfill their rights

In this newspaper, we strive greatly for the rights and moral duties of Pashtun students, and this newspaper is a platform for Pashtun students where they can fulfill all their academic and moral needs, and in their writings, they say that through this newspaper, they find new paths for learning for Pashtunwali.

The following conditions of Pashtun newspaper for fulfilling duty are:

1) It is necessary for Pashtun students that in their writings, with the spirit of Pashtunwali, they write sincerely for the service of their country and nation.
2) It is necessary for Pashtun students that they make every effort for the progress of the Pashto language.
3) It is necessary for Pashtun students that they act according to the guidance of the Pashtun newspaper for their morals and academic excellence.
4) It is necessary for Pashtun students that through their writings, they also pave the way for academic and moral lessons for other Pashtuns.

For all these objectives, the management of the Pashtun newspaper provides such facilities for its students that they can easily publish their writings through the newspaper and become capable of serving their nation.

2401.right:
Pashtun editorial

31 August 1920

What is happening in the land of Pashtun Khwa against the Pashtun nation as part of a systematic conspiracy is not only a great challenge for the poor and oppressed people of one part of the country, but in reality, it is all a chain of actions by those enemies who are working to end the unity and independence of the Pashtuns. The plans of these enemies of Afghans are not just partisan and short-term, but it is a long-term colonial and dictatorial policy that is used to belittle the national identity and history of the Pashtun nation. These people want to sow discord among Pashtuns under various names and create obstacles to their unity. But history has proven that whenever such conspiracies have been hatched against the Pashtun nation, they have become even more united among themselves and have foiled such evil attempts by their enemies. We must understand that the enemies of our land are afraid of the national unity of Pashtuns and want to sacrifice this unity for their own interests. Today, every individual of our nation has a duty not to remain silent in the face of such adversities and to raise the voice of unity for the rights of our nation.

2404.right:
21 August 1920

In the path of the welfare of the poor and destitute

Waziristan is located in the polar region of India - this region has been famous since ancient times for that example of independence which has always bravely resisted foreign and domestic rule. The British government has always considered this region a threat to its neighbors, especially the people of India, in order to extend its colonialism. Due to its geographical location, this region has remained the center of failure for all those British plans that they wanted to implement for their colonial interests. The British have always tried to sow division and disunity among the people of Waziristan, but the people of Waziristan, with their special knowledge and national consciousness, have foiled all kinds of British conspiracies and, under the guidance of their leaders, have fought for their freedom. The people of Waziristan believe that the only way for the progress of their country and salvation from the evil of foreigners is unity among them and the preservation of religious and national values.
2404.left: The well-being of all our countrymen is the desire for good in our country. Today, as our country is entangled in the web of foreign politics, it is essential that we take a step towards unity and brotherhood. The main reason for the poverty and destitution of our people is that we have remained far from the blessing of knowledge and wisdom. It is necessary that we strive for the education and upbringing of our children and struggle to build a society in which there is justice and advocacy for truth. On this path, we must stand against all those who sow division among the people to maintain their rule. May God show our countrymen the path of truth and solve their problems.

Since the circumstances have now changed, our action was also in accordance with the needs of the time.
May God grant good, but we know that this action will be viewed with many doubts and suspicions among the people, and perhaps many people will become suspicious of us because of it, but we know that the purpose of this action was solely the intention to serve our homeland and people, not any other hidden dealings with anyone else. This was an action that was necessary considering the circumstances of that time.
2405.left: Considering that this decision was made based on the demands of the situation, we hope our friends will not doubt our intentions. We have always worked for the benefit of the country and the people, and we will continue to follow this path in the future. Taking such steps is a part of politics, and sometimes it is necessary to accept some small decisions for the sake of greater interests. We are fully committed to serving our nation with complete faith and do not care about the propaganda of our enemies.

2412.right:

Pashtun Special

We went to the train near the camp, we arrived there, many people from that place were talking amongst themselves, when we looked at them, they were busy talking amongst themselves in a certain way, we also turned towards them, from their conversation it seemed that they were talking about the events that have recently occurred, and from their conversation it was evident that they were very sad about these events and the pain in their hearts was evident in their conversations.

At this time, one person from that place in the camp, who from his conversation seemed to be an intelligent and experienced man, came towards us and with great respect began to talk with us and said that regarding these events that have recently occurred, from their perspective it seems that these events have been carried out by some special people, and from their conversation it was also clear that they see the hand of some people in these events and have many doubts about these events, and they are trying to identify the real perpetrators of these events and obtain accurate information about them.
2412.left:
21 August 1920 AD

From these discussions at the camp, it became clear that there are many people in this place who are involved in these events and know a lot about them. However, there was something in their words that showed they were afraid of some people and did not want to speak openly about it, because they knew that if they said anything about it, they would be harmed and their lives would be in danger.

In the end, we took leave of them and left the camp, and we were thinking about what was hidden in their words, and we realized that there were very big hands behind these events, and we became very sad about their fear and terror in which they live, and we thought a lot about their situation.

2427.right:
Regarding the celebration of independence in the country

Many people have written to express their views on the celebration of independence in the country, regarding efforts and activities in the path of celebrating independence. From these writings, it appears that many people have made a series of suggestions regarding efforts and activities in the path of celebrating independence to recognize the benefits and values of independence, a few of which are as follows:

First, a commission should be formed to arrange and organize a series of programs for the celebration of independence.

Second, there is a need to organize a series of seminars and conferences for the celebration of independence.

Third, it is essential to inform and educate the public through the media to raise the level of people's knowledge for the celebration of independence.

Fourth, action should be taken to organize competitions at the level of schools and universities for the celebration of independence.

Fifth, to increase people's participation in the celebration of independence, public awareness programs should be launched at the village and district level.
2427.left:
Regarding the celebration of independence in the country (continued)

Sixth, steps should be taken to print and publish books to narrate the achievements of national heroes and freedom fighters of the country for the celebration of independence.

Seventh, attention should be paid to organizing a series of special ceremonies at the national level on the day of independence celebration.

Eighth, there is a need to organize a series of artistic and cultural programs for the celebration of independence.

Ninth, steps should be taken to organize a series of sports games and competitions at the national level for the celebration of independence.

Tenth, organizing a series of joint gatherings is essential to strengthen the unity and solidarity of the people for the celebration of independence.

The opinions of the people regarding the celebration of independence are valuable, and it is hoped that the country's officials will take necessary measures in this regard.

Wishing a happy Independence Day to all the Afghan nation and patriotic countrymen.

Maulana Abdul Qadir set such examples among the servants of his path of freedom that paved the way for the struggle for the rights of the people throughout India. He is that shining star of life that will forever remain in the hearts of the people of Pashtunkhwa. When Maulana Abdul Qadir raised his voice for the rights of the people of Pashtunkhwa, there were many atrocities of British colonialism at that time, and wherever one looked, it was very difficult for the people to obtain their rights to life. But Maulana Abdul Qadir used his courage and bravery and raised such a voice against the British that it shook their palaces. In that era, the people of Pashtunkhwa were in a state of illiteracy and helplessness, but Maulana knew that education is the most important means for the progress of the nation, and for this, he opened the doors of education for the people in very difficult circumstances. These are the greatest achievements of Maulana's life that are still a guiding light for our nation today.
2435.left: Besides this, Maulana Abdul Qadir faced many difficulties in his life. He was not even afraid of imprisonment by the British, but rather with full courage, he continued to raise his voice for the rights of his people. This man was a torch for his people that is still alive in their hearts today, and serves as a beacon of freedom for them. In the end, we can say that from the life of Maulana Abdul Qadir, we learn the lesson that sacrificing for one's people is an act of happiness for a Muslim and a Pashtun, and we must follow his path and work for the progress of our homeland and people.

2441.right:
19 August 1920 AD

May Almighty God turn this freedom celebration into a new era of prosperity and happiness for our nation. By the grace of Almighty God, after many years of efforts and due to the quenching of the thirst for independence, today this freedom celebration is being celebrated with full glory and splendor in the land of India by the people of Pashtunkhwa. It is a matter of joy that the children of our nation understood the value of independence and started a series of sacrifices to gain it. On this occasion, representatives of the people of Punjab also participated with great enthusiasm and fervor in the freedom celebration in Kabul, and on the occasion of this freedom celebration, they pledged assistance and support to the Pashtun nation in the path of achieving independence. The participation of the representatives of the people of Punjab in this celebration indicates that a new phase of unity and progress has begun between the Pashtun and Punjabi nations. On this occasion, during the speech of the representatives of Punjab, the heroism and bravery of the Pashtun nation were praised, and it was mentioned that if the atmosphere of brotherhood and unity between these two nations becomes even stronger, then a new history will be made in the path of breaking the chains of colonial oppression. In addition to this, the government officials of Kabul also, during the welcome of the arrival of the representatives of the people of Punjab, appreciated their good wishes and thanked them for their cooperation regarding the further strengthening of brotherhood and solidarity between both sides. Finally, the participants of this celebration once again pledged the continuation of their sacrifices for preserving freedom, and with this hope, they concluded the celebration ceremonies, wishing that the rays of Pashtunkhwa's freedom become a guiding light for all oppressed nations and that this series of freedom remains alive forever.

2473.right:
Lashkar of Pashtunkhwa

14 August 1921 AD

The dominance of foreigners in one's own land

Once again, whispers of a new calamity are being heard for the people of Pashtunkhwa. From the intentions of the British government, it appears that they are planning to start another hostile act to create fear and terror in the hearts of the people of this region. This hostility is not new for the people of Pashtunkhwa; rather, from the time of the British government's rule over this land, it has been clear from the objectives of their every step that they want to prevent the awakening of the people to maintain their dominance over this land.

The excuses being made for this hostility of the British government are not acceptable to the honorable nation of Pashtunkhwa. They say that these steps are necessary for the peace and security of the region, but from the hidden and apparent motives behind this, it is known that their real goal is only to maintain their rule in this region and prevent the unity and solidarity of the Pashtuns. The people of Pashtunkhwa, who have been struggling for independence for centuries, will never accept this yoke of foreign slavery around their necks, nor will they abandon the honor and bravery of their forefathers.
2473.left:
The people of Pashtunkhwa need to inform themselves of these circumstances and rise for a unity that can prevent all kinds of enemy conspiracies. At this time, when world conditions are moving towards change, this is a golden chance for the Pashtuns to obtain their rights and become the masters of their own land. No matter how many sacrifices are made in this path, it is a small step for the freedom of this homeland.

These tactics of the British government, instead of weakening the resolve of the Pashtuns, will cause their spirits to become even stronger. The people of Pashtunkhwa are always ready to defend their religion and homeland. It is written on every page of our history that a Pashtun has never bowed his head before oppression, nor will he ever bow it.

Regarding how we can defend our homeland, it is the duty of every Pashtun to set up tents of unity among themselves. Becoming united against the conspiracies of outsiders is the greatest need of our time today. If we stand against the enemy with one voice, then these walls of the British government's oppression will collapse on their own.

Let us work for the freedom of our homeland with a new resolve and show the world that the Pashtun is ready for any kind of sacrifice for independence.

Muslims are prepared to offer all their sacrifices to prevent the British from disrespecting the Khilafat. The Muslims of India have also stated that any actions taken by the British against this movement of theirs will not deter them from their goals, and they will remain firm in their position for the protection of their Khilafat and will exercise patience and steadfastness in the face of any kind of oppression and tyranny by the British.

From an incident of a murder in Kabul.

Those individuals who were killed in the city of Kabul on February 21, 1921, as a result of a series of events, among whom were some well-known members of the government. This incident happened in such a way that on August 20, 1920, some announcements were posted in public places in Kabul, which caused a strong reaction among the people. In these announcements, the government was accused of restricting the freedom of the people, and it had called for severe demonstrations by the people, and anti-government slogans were also written in them.
2501.left: Then these demonstrations slowly took the form of an organized anti-government movement, as a result of which the government was forced to start negotiations with these people, but the negotiations failed and clashes occurred between the government and the protesters, in which some government personnel, including many Kabul residents, were killed, due to which the situation in Kabul city was chaotic for some time and the government was forced to declare a state of emergency in the city and restrict the freedom of movement of the people, and also a number of people were arrested and placed under strict restrictions by the government.

2542.right:
Pashtun Awareness

New English Fresh Decision

(Editorial)

As announced, the British government has declared a new decision regarding the demands of the people of India for India's freedom. This decision, which is considered a major obstacle to India's freedom, was officially announced by the British government in a declaration on July 25, 1920 AD. In this declaration, the British government stated that the people of India are not worthy of freedom, nor do they have the right to participate in the government of India. They say that the participation of the people of India in the affairs of the Indian government is not in the best interest of India, and this action will cause insecurity in India. This declaration by the British government is a major blow to all those in India who are fighting for freedom. They have made it clear in this declaration that the British government will continue its colonial rule in India and will not grant any kind of freedom. The reaction of the people of India to this British decision was very severe; they consider this decision an insult to the people of India, and anti-British demonstrations have begun throughout India.
2542.left: This decision by the British is a major challenge for those seeking India's independence. They believe that the British government is only thinking of its own interests and does not respect the will of the Indian people. As a result of this decision, the independence movement in India has become even stronger, and the people have united against British oppression. This is an important moment in history that will determine the fate of the Indian people.

However, the government has imposed such restrictions on the freedom of the press that it has gagged the people. If we look at the history of press freedom, many sacrifices have been made for the freedom of the press in India. Previously, there was no law for the press in India, but when the British set foot here, they imposed restrictions on the freedom of the press for their own interests and made government permits mandatory for every newspaper and magazine. This is not the freedom of the press by law, but rather the silencing of the press.

In the presence of a free press, a bridge is built between the government and the people, which is beneficial for both. It is necessary to understand that freedom of the press is not the name of unbridled speech, but rather it is a means to speak the truth and justice.

Letter from Yad Shah Khan

Dear Khaliq Sahib!
Peace be upon you, and the mercy of God and His blessings! Yesterday I was informed that the day before yesterday, on such and such a date, you were arrested by some people in Kohat. Upon hearing this news, my heart was deeply pained. Who can protect themselves from these waves of calamity that are upon the head of the Pashtun nation for the sake of the Pashtun's salvation and the freedom of their homeland? For everyone, making sacrifices for the freedom of the Pashtun is a primary duty of a Pashtun. And in fulfilling this duty, the Pashtun youth is ready for every kind of sacrifice, and must be. From the bottom of my heart, I pray that God may release you safely. And may God protect you from the evil of your enemies. I am certain that God is using this sacrifice of yours for the benefit of the Pashtun nation, and these days of your imprisonment will be of great benefit in the work of awakening the Pashtun nation.

Do not be sad; by the grace of God, everything will turn out well, and your days of imprisonment will end very soon.

You have no concern about someone committing injustice against you in your own homeland. Because the history of Pashtun sacrifice goes back a long way. And you have much more work left to do for the sympathy of the Pashtun nation and for the freedom of the Pashtun.

I ask God to bring you back to your homeland and your home in good health and well-being. And may God shame your enemies through their own actions. And all your companions and friends are ready for every kind of effort for your release and will continue to strive.

I am sending these few sentences through the hand of your companion so that you may know that we all stand with you in this difficult time, and in the hearts of all your companions, there is much sorrow for you, and we are with you in our prayers.

May God bring you safely back to your homeland and your people.

Your friend
A companion of Pashtun freedom

2589.right:
Mullah Muhammad Din and the Shamla Jirga
Mullah Muhammad Din was lying in a corner of Shamla, working with love and sincerity to meet the needs of the village people. It is said that when the cruel hands of the British reached the people of India and the border, a voice rose in the village asking what should be done for freedom. Mullah Muhammad Din stood up and said to the people in a courageous voice: "O lovers of my homeland's soil, British slavery is full of shame for us; we must raise the flag of freedom against them."
The people responded to his words with enthusiasm. Mullah Muhammad Din set off towards the mountain with his rifle in his arm and the pride of the Shamla on his head. With his steps, the thirst for freedom in the hearts of the people increased even more. In the darkness of the night, they began attacking British outposts. Every time they participated in battle, Mullah Muhammad Din had a prayer for God's victory on his lips and the sword of the homeland's freedom in his hand.
Once, when the British army became very large and their supplies were cut off, his companions said to him: "Mullah Sahib, now is the time to return." Mullah Muhammad Din said with a smile: "Death on the path of freedom is the door to paradise; we will not return until the enemy's feet have left this land."
2589.left:
At the end of the battle, Mullah Muhammad Din was martyred among his Mujahideen in front of the enemy's cannons. People say that his blood was sown into the soil of the homeland like the seed of freedom. With his martyrdom, the spirit of freedom among the people of the region became even stronger, and the path for the British to leave was paved.
Mullah Muhammad Din is remembered in the history of the Shamla Jirga as a hero who, by the strength of his faith and honor, gave his blood to break the chains of colonialism. Even today, the stories of Mullah Muhammad Din's sacrifice are whispered in every valley of the Shamla mountains.
It is worth noting that as a result of this Jirga's struggle, a new era of education and awakening began in this region, the effects of which are still seen today.

2652.right:
Daily Events

It has been nearly five years since the government promised the people of India reassurance in this regard. However, instead of fulfilling its own promises and commitments, the government has tightened such severe restrictions on the people of India over these five years that no example of it can be seen in past times. This was the time when, as a result of the help and sacrifices of the people of India on the battlefield, the British raised the flags of victory. At that time, Indians were ready to provide all kinds of assistance to the British because of such promises and announcements made by the British, who were promising them their rights at that time. In those promises, they clearly declared that with the end of the war, full independence and freedom would be granted to India. But with the end of the war, all the promises and agreements of the British vanished into thin air like a dream. This breach of promises by the British ignited a fire of hatred in the hearts of the people of India, which resulted in a deep gap between the people of India and the government.
2652.left: When the people of India saw that the government had failed in all stages of its promises, they were forced to choose the path of an organized struggle to obtain their rights. During this struggle, many negotiations took place between the leaders of the Indian people and the government. However, the government did not want to take even one step back from its powers. For this reason, the atmosphere of mistrust between the two sides increased even further. Because of this hardline stance of the government, the spirit of the freedom movement among the people of India became even stronger. They realized that as long as they did not stand against the government in an organized manner, they would never be able to enjoy their rights. In this sequence, the Congress and other political groups started a series of protests and demonstrations against the government's policies, which brought the entire nation of India into one rank to shake the foundations of the government. The leaders of the Congress stated that we will speak to the British in their own language so that they understand the importance of our demands. Signs of the government's anxiety and panic were evident in the face of this uprising by the people of India, but they still remained firm in their coercive policies.

Regarding the history of Afghanistan's status and the declaration of its independence, it was officially announced by the royal government that recently the government of India has not taken any action regarding the recognition of Afghanistan's right to independence that would cause a denial of this right to independence, and likewise, the government of India has not interfered in any way in the internal affairs of Afghanistan, nor has it hindered the affairs of Afghanistan's sovereign independence. Rather, the government of India has always strived to take steps for the strengthening of Afghanistan's independence and for the well-being and progress of the Afghan people in all areas, and to further expand friendly relations between the two countries. According to it, the government of India has always respected Afghanistan's independence and will remain committed to its promises as a neighboring country in the future as well, and will continue its efforts for the strengthening of Afghanistan's independence.
2653.left: In this way, by publishing this declaration regarding Afghanistan's independence, doubts and speculations regarding the relations between Afghanistan and India were prevented, and the friendly atmosphere between the two countries was further strengthened in all areas. The Afghan government also accelerated its efforts to consolidate its independence and progress in all sectors, and gained the support of the people in organizing government affairs to ensure security and order in all regions of the country. Furthermore, the Afghan government recently, after achieving independence, announced the implementation of a series of programs for education, health, and economic development in various parts of the country, which opened new horizons of progress in all areas of the country and gave the Afghan nation the good news of a happy and prosperous future.

In this process, regarding the need to spread knowledge and light among the people for the expansion of education, special measures were taken to improve education through discussions with officials of the Ministry of Education. Although there were some difficulties in establishing this educational center at the beginning, gradually, as a result of efforts to make people understand the importance of education, the people showed interest in education.
In this regard, with the help of the local people, the work of building this educational center proceeded very rapidly. In this educational center, not only were facilities provided for the education of the new generation, but special courses were also arranged for the education of adults. With the opening of this educational center, a new change occurred in the educational level of the region, and the people of the region understood the value of education for the better future of their children.
2654.left: In this series, the government also promised assistance, and steps were taken to provide special books and teaching materials for this education center. This was the beginning of a new era that played a very major role in the development of the Charsadda region. Today, the people of Charsadda continue their efforts for the advancement of life in the light of knowledge due to the blessings of this education center. This educational center has now become a hub of knowledge for the people of the region, which has become an example not only for this area but also for the people of other regions. This work showed that if there is unity and agreement among the people for a good cause, then all kinds of problems can be solved, and the path of education is the best way for the development of society.

A part of the National Congress:
Some time ago, a delegation of the Indian National Congress went to England. This delegation was sent by the Congress to draw the attention of the British people and the British government to the issues of India. An important member of this delegation was Maulana Muhammad Ali, who expressed the demands of the people of India with great courage in his speeches. There is no doubt that his trip was a major step for India's freedom and brought about a great change in the public opinion of England. Although the British government did not pay much attention to their proposals at first, the unity and efforts of Indian Muslims and Hindus caused a tremor of fear in the hearts of the British government. This meant that the people of India were now ready to make any sacrifice to obtain their rights and had adopted a strong stance against British colonialism.

2658.right:
The fleeting world

It is a new and clear statement that in this mortal world, no one remains forever, and everyone who has come here must one day leave this place; this truth is evident to all. Humans make many efforts during their lives in this world; some are in search of wealth and property, while others spend their days and nights striving to acquire knowledge and wisdom. But the truth is that all the joys and sorrows of this worldly life are short-lived, and none of them remain with a person. We must understand the true nature of this world and strive for what is beneficial for the life of the hereafter. This earth and these heavens will one day change, and it will only be the grace and mercy of God (J) that a person will encounter. Therefore, it is necessary that in this short-term life, we do such deeds that cause the pleasure of God (J) and become provisions for the eternal life of the hereafter, because much of this world is hollow and futile.

Author: The reminder of this writing is to keep yourself from attaching your heart to the love of the world and to rely only on God (J).
2658.left: And know about the affairs of the world that this is a place of trial, not a place of residence. Anyone who understands this will never be proud of the wealth and possessions of the world. Our ancestors also lived in this world, and today only their names remain. It is necessary for us to take a lesson from the people of the past and prepare for the future. Everything in life that we see is for a fixed period, and with the end of this period, all these things will head towards destruction. Therefore, we say do not be deceived by the colors of the world and turn your attention towards the eternal life. God Almighty has mentioned many times in His book that this world is a game and a pastime, and the real life is the life of the hereafter, which never ends. For anyone who understands this, the difficulties of the world seem easy to them, and they spend their lives with patience. This world is like a traveler's inn where one spends a few nights and then goes to another place. So, in this journey of the world, collect good provisions and seek the pleasure of God Almighty in your deeds, for this is the path to success.

2659.right: Like in the past, India has been in a state over the last few years where the question has arisen in the heart of every Indian citizen as to why India is caught in the trap of so many hardships and sufferings.
2659.left: In the past, India was famous as a great paradise on earth due to its prosperity, but with the passage of time, the lives of its people have faced a major crisis due to the oppression and tyranny of foreign powers and the rulers of the time. Today, when we talk about the situation in India, the question arises in our minds: will the fate of the people of India remain the same? The answer to this question lies in the fact that the people of India must find self-belief and gird their loins to win their freedom. Currently, movements are beginning in India that have the power to set fire to the roots of colonialism. According to political scientists, the awakening of the people of India is a great lesson for all freedom-loving nations of the world. If India finds salvation from these hardships, it will be a new chapter in the history of the entire world. India is the homeland of people who have always fought for the truth and even now do not hesitate to sacrifice their lives in the path of seeking the truth.

Oppressive and autocratic governments claim political rights while their oppressed subjects are under their feet. It is a lesson for everyone that those who claim human rights themselves follow the path of oppressive and autocratic governments regarding God's people by their own choice, and human rights are under their feet. There is a huge difference between the implementation of every word of the government on one side and the cries of the heart of the poor and miserable nation on the other. It is because of the ruthlessness of the times that upon hearing the name of human rights, a sigh of pain escapes the mouth of every conscious human being, because these oppressive governments do not leave anyone in their path for their own rights and have trampled the rights of the entire nation under their feet. Although they have taken upon themselves the duty of justice and fairness for themselves, they have no shame regarding trampling the heads and rights of the people. Those times have also passed when, by the order of a king, there was no concern in taking people's heads, and under the name of justice, the way was paved for the killing of every innocent human being. And in the current era, even under these oppressive governments, no such action is taken regarding the rights of the general public that would stop their oppression and coercion. They are ready for every kind of oppression and coercion, and every word of their government smells of oppression and tyranny, and they have no other work except trampling the rights of the people. Amir Nawaz Khan Jalia is such a sacred man in the path of gaining freedom that he has spared no effort in the entire Pashtunkhwa to awaken his nation. According to him, for the freedom of his homeland, the question in every Pashtun's mind was how to save ourselves from British colonialism. 2681.right:
Revolutionary Reform
Today, when the government takes some anger from the people through force and oppression, no one doubts that this is an injustice. However, as to how this is a way of blocking the path of freedom, in reality, people understand that this is not blocking the path of freedom. Yet, in this action of the government, many people who have had long-standing enmity with the government view every step of the government as an act of oppression. In this matter, there is much that people do not understand regarding the purpose of the government's policy. Through those people sitting in the government, it appears that the government itself has a hand in fueling the fire of this enmity. Regarding this action of the government, people are of two types: one that opposes every step of the government, and another that supports every step of the government. However, there are very few people among them who view the government's actions with fairness. There are also people among them who, for the sake of their own interests, are associated with the government and make every effort to defame the government among the people. For this reason, people view the government's actions with suspicion, and because of this, an atmosphere of distrust has been created between the government and the people, from which only the opponents of the government benefit, and in this way, no path remains for the reform of the government.

Independence as a helper and by nature
Independence is a necessary condition for the establishment of truth, justice, and fairness, because in the absence of independence, hoping for the end of an era of oppression and coercion is useless. The fact that it is necessary for a specific class to rise above their interests within a nation to achieve independence means that there should not be people in the government who trample on the interests of the general public for their own gain. This is because the unity of the entire nation is necessary to remove all kinds of obstacles in the path of independence, and such unity is only possible when there are people in the government who understand the pain of the public and work day and night for the welfare of the public. The fact that the path of a nation's progress has been blocked due to some people in the government infringing on the rights of the people to fulfill their own interests, in such circumstances, there is a need for the awakening of a nation to achieve independence. This awakening lies in people becoming aware of their rights and opposing every step that becomes an obstacle to their freedom.

Pashtun identity
The Pashtun identity has been known as a servant of the oppressors for centuries.
This is a sign of the centuries of service and the slavery of the Pashtun nation in the field of others, and a sign of the heat of the Pashtun nation's field of honor, but today the Pashtun is himself in a web of oppression.
In the beginning, the Pashtun identity has done things to achieve the interests of some that have become a cause of shame for their own nation.
In this era of honor and the slavery of service, the Pashtun nation is in this bad state due to the weak policy of some leaders and the slavery of outsiders; if the Pashtun nation wants to start a new phase for its own honor, then it must abandon the wrong policies of its leaders and seek to start a new work for the service of its own nation.
Because in the current time, there is a need for such unity and agreement among the Pashtun nation that paves the way for liberation from the slavery of outsiders, and this is possible by awakening the honor of the Pashtun identity, and once again a step should be taken towards repeating the history of the Pashtun nation.

2689.right: At that time, through the efforts of the Minister of Education, the esteemed Shams al-Ulama Mawlawi Sahib Ahmad Jan Khel, along with other scholars and officials of the Press Department, a decision was made to publish a reputable scientific journal to promote education across the country. For this purpose, with the assistance of a group of the country's prominent scholars and writers, the work of compiling the first issue of this scientific journal began. The contents of the first issue included articles on the country's history, the state of education, and other important scientific and cultural issues. Furthermore, the publication of this journal opened a new path for spreading knowledge and learning among the people of Afghanistan, and the level of awareness regarding the importance of science and knowledge among the public was increased.
2689.left: This educational initiative was warmly welcomed by many scholars and writers of that time, and articles were written about this scientific and cultural step in various newspapers and publications. With the publication of the first issues of this periodical, a new chapter was opened in Afghanistan's education, and new ways of learning in the field of science and literature were provided for the country's young generation. In the path of this publication's progress, the country's Ministry of Education and the Department of Press promised all kinds of assistance and support, and necessary measures were taken to further strengthen this publication. The series of printing and distributing this scientific and cultural publication continued over the years and played an unforgettable role in the dissemination of education across the country.

Once again, I sincerely apologize to my readers for being absent from the series of my subject. It has been over four years since this small magazine named "Pashtun" was published in the land of Pashtunkhwa for the service of the Pashto language. During this period, many such events have taken place that have become the cause of many hearts melting. Among them is this heart-wrenching event, which fills the booklet of the story of the change in the past and present life of the Pashtun. Every page of this booklet is filled with such pains and sufferings that waves of astonishment rise in the human heart. This Pashtunkhwa, which is sitting on a mat of grief today, would one day be dancing in an atmosphere of happiness for the pride of itself and its nation. But alas, due to the oppressors of the time, these beautiful flowers were turned to dust in the wind of autumn. My purpose in writing is that this Pashtunkhwa of ours is facing such misfortunes that are beyond description. Despite all this, we, Pashtunkhwa, are standing in the field until the end of life in every aspect to preserve our culture and our history. Even though we are facing many difficulties due to the oppression and force of enemies, still, the passion of love and faith in our hearts for the promotion of Pashto has not diminished. While writing the first page of this magazine, I thought a lot about how to save Pashtunkhwa from this catastrophe. My only purpose is to inform our Pashtuns about their history and their culture, because a nation that forgets its history faces extinction. Seeing every issue of this magazine will make the hearts of the Pashtun nation beat, and a new spirit of unity and agreement will be born among them. My purpose in publishing this magazine is to awaken the Pashtuns and light the lamp of knowledge and wisdom in their hearts, so that they may become aware of their rights and protect themselves from the oppression of the tyrant. For the development of the Pashto language, I will hold the pen in my hand until the end and will fight for my nation from the heart, because this is my first and last step on the path of the welfare of Pashtunkhwa. No matter how many hardships come in this path, I will not give up my purpose, and I will make every kind of sacrifice to defend the rights of my nation. My message to every youth of Pashtunkhwa is that let us break the sword of discord with the hand of unity and intensify our efforts for the elevation of the Pashto language, so that this sacred land of ours may be freed from all kinds of slavery and we may live in the world as proud Pashtuns. It is my hope that this "Pashtun" magazine will become a cause of knowledge and light for the Pashtuns and will create the courage to speak the truth in their hearts. Pashtun is written in letters of bravery on every page of history, and it is my effort that this history shines even more on the path of light. In the end, I request all Pashtuns to consider this "Pashtun" magazine as their own family magazine and help me in its distribution, so that our series of spreading knowledge of the Pashto language may continue like this. By the grace of Allah Almighty and the companionship of the Pashtuns, I will be successful in this path and will perform the service of my nation from the heart.
2690.left: There is no doubt that many people understand why the Pashtun magazine is being published, but their question is why this work was started at this time? My answer is that this was the demand of the time; there is no better tool than the pen to end the misery of the Pashtuns. When I decided to start the Pashtun magazine, many people told me that this is a difficult task and there will be many obstacles in its way, but I took this step with trust in Allah, and today we are witnesses to its success. I know that due to the lack of knowledge and awareness among our Pashtuns, there are many such problems that require a lot of time to solve, but this magazine is a small step towards spreading that light. In every page of this magazine, I have written about the life, culture, history, and problems of the Pashtuns, so that our Pashtun youth may become aware of the past and present state of their nation. I want our Pashtuns to understand who they are and what their position is in the world. There are many people who are unaware of their history; for them, this magazine has the status of a school. I am proud that through this magazine, I have paved a small way to serve Pashto. It is my hope from all Pashtun brothers that they do not neglect reading the articles of this magazine and support me in its distribution, because the development of the Pashto language is the duty of every Pashtun, and we must continue our efforts for the elevation of our language. The unity of our Pashtuns is the only way to defeat all enemies, so let us work together for the progress of our nation in the light of knowledge and awareness and find our place in the world as proud Pashtuns.

2691.right: During the rule of the Nawab in India, who was a very great man of justice and fairness, a man came to the Nawab's court during the time of a very powerful and learned person's trial and cried out, demanding his rights from the Nawab. After hearing the man's plea, the Nawab asked him for a three-day grace period for the sake of justice and fairness. On the third day, which was the day of the decision regarding the man's rights according to the Nawab's promise, the Nawab was sitting in his court with his courtiers when suddenly another man came to the Nawab's court and said to the Nawab with great politeness, "O just Nawab! I have a very urgent matter." The Nawab asked the man with great politeness and respect, "What is your business?" The man said that he had a very important matter and that he needed a learned and wise person for his task. At the man's request, the Nawab went out of his court with him and was gone for a long time in search of the man's task. After a long time had passed, the Nawab returned to his court and apologized to the man, saying, "Because of my departure and the delay I caused for this task, I regret the decision I had made in favor of that man." The courtiers asked the Nawab, "O Nawab! Why did you regret your decision?" The Nawab said, "When I went with that man, I realized that he had asked me for justice on behalf of an oppressor, and in this matter, an obstacle was created in the path of my fairness and justice." At that time, the Nawab changed his decision regarding the man's rights and made his ruling with fairness.
2691.left:
Nawab Sahib was very happy with this decision of his, and all the courtiers praised Nawab Sahib's justice. During his time of justice, Nawab Sahib was always in search of everyone's rights and did not commit injustice against anyone. In that era, the fame of Nawab Sahib's justice spread everywhere, and people from all places would come to Nawab Sahib's court for their rights. Another story of Nawab Sahib's life is that once Nawab Sahib was on a journey with one of his very close friends; in the middle of the road, they saw a poor man who was very much affected by hunger and thirst. Upon seeing that poor man, Nawab Sahib helped him with his own horse and arranged food and water for that poor man. Nawab Sahib helped that poor man so much that the poor man was freed from his troubles. After this act, Nawab Sahib continued his journey with his friend. From this story, we learn the lesson that a ruler should perform his duties with justice and fairness and should help every poor and needy person in removing their troubles. Truly, this story of Nawab Sahib is a great lesson for every ruler.

With respect
Magazine Management

2692.right:
When the news of Bacha Khan's death caused waves of sorrow to rise in everyone's hearts, and as a result, freedom protests and struggles began among the people in every corner of the country... everyone was thinking about what this freedom would be and what it would be for? Groups of young people emerged among the country's freedom seekers and decided to raise their voices against the atrocities of colonialism. They said that if people like Bacha Khan sacrificed their lives for the country's freedom, then why should we remain silent? In this sequence, numerous meetings were held in Kabul and other regions, and the spirit of freedom among the people became even stronger. This was a time when foreign interference in the country's affairs and the atrocities of their puppets were unbearable. People shouted for independence with one voice and raised the slogan of unity for this sacred goal. Everywhere there was talk of the demand for freedom, and this was the beginning of a new transformation that will always be remembered in the history of the country.

During this process, the names of a number of those who had made efforts for the country's freedom are very prominent. They proved not only through their pens but also through their actions that the children of this land are ready for any kind of sacrifice to break the chains of slavery. This was the beginning of such a national uprising that laid the foundations for the country's freedom.
2692.left:
August 24

Since everyone is feeling something in their hearts regarding the passing of Bacha Khan these days, some important commentaries have been published in this issue of our journal. In the current situation of the country, where the demand for freedom and efforts for national unity are ongoing among the people with great intensity, it is essential that the thoughts and struggles of heroes like Bacha Khan serve as a lesson for the future generation of the country. We have shed light on some aspects of his life here and have attempted to clarify the goals of his struggle. Throughout his life, he made tireless efforts for the independence of the country and the prosperity of the people. The news of his passing is a great loss not only for the country but for everyone who walks the path of freedom and justice. This journal, being published at such a sensitive time, is an important step for public awareness and strengthening the national spirit. We hope that the readers of this journal will think deeply about the country's situation and play their part in building the nation.

In the year 1299 SH, the first discussion of this kind began in the Kabul Literary Association: what should be done for the path of Pashto? So, a meeting was held in the Kabul Literary Association in which many discussions took place regarding the development of Pashto. A very important and interesting piece of news was that a dictionary should be written for the Pashto language, but this dictionary should be in Pashto, not in Persian or any other language, because it was very important for the Pashto language that the words of this language be explained in Pashto itself. Many scholars of the country participated in this meeting and everyone gave their opinion; this was a very important step taken for the development of the Pashto language. In this meeting, it was decided regarding the writing of the Pashto dictionary that this work must be done with great precision, because there are many words in Pashto whose meanings are not correctly known, and the precise meanings of these words must be written in this dictionary. This was a task that has been written in golden letters on the pages of history for the Pashto language. In this meeting, many other discussions were also held for the progress of the Pashto language, and a committee was also appointed for this progress.
2694.left:
Regarding the activities of the Literary Association, the following points are worth noting:
A) The work of writing a dictionary for the Pashto language was started.
B) The work of printing books for the teaching of the Pashto language was accelerated.

The efforts of the Literary Association in the field of the Pashto language are commendable, because with these efforts a new chapter was opened in the history of the Pashto language. Although there were many difficulties for this work at that time, still, thanks to the efforts of the scholars, this work was accomplished successfully. This was a task that played a very important role in the development of the Pashto language and laid a strong foundation for this language. With these efforts of the Literary Association, many facilities were provided in the field of reading and writing the Pashto language, and many works were carried out in the field of Pashto literature. Thanks to these efforts, today we can read many books in the Pashto language and benefit from the rich literature of this language.

(Rabi' al-Awwal)

2695.right:
Politics Letter
In recent days, a decree was issued by Kabul that was viewed with great respect by the people, which is that from now on, the opinions and advice of the people must be utilized in all affairs of the country. This is a very good step and is considered an important move for the country's progress.
The government's efforts in the path of protecting people's rights are commendable, but there is still a need for much more work. The leaders of the government must understand that the will of the nation is the only path for the survival and progress of any society. If the government can manage its affairs with the help of the nation, then paths will be paved for solving the country's problems, and enemies will fail in achieving their evil goals.
In conclusion, we must say that the unity and solidarity of all citizens is a condition for the prosperity of the country, and it is the government's duty to create transparency in its actions in order to gain the people's trust.
2695.left:
In this regard, it must also be added that freedom of the press is very important for the awakening of a society. If pens are free, then the demands of the people will reach the ears of the government. Through the press, people can express their problems and suggest solutions to the government for reforms.
It is also worth mentioning that the rule of law must be the same for everyone. If the law is applied to one person and not to another, then distrust will be created in society. The government must not make any distinction in the implementation of justice.
Regarding the future of the country, we are hopeful that this process of progress will continue as it is and that harmony among the people will be further strengthened. We believe that the participation of every Afghan is an inseparable part of the country's development and everyone should be given the opportunity to work in this path.

2696.right:
Kabul incidents in Peshawar
In Peshawar, when news of incidents such as the Kabul robberies or other reports published in favor of the Afghan government emerged, it caused a great deal of noise and uproar in Peshawar. People created various stories about it, and rumors spread throughout the markets. However, no official statement had been issued by the government regarding these incidents, nor had any verified information about any event reached the public. At that time, a number of well-informed individuals and political experts in Peshawar spread various stories from their own mouths regarding these situations, which in reality had no foundation. Among the news that was spread about these incidents was that the Afghan government was in secret contact with certain foreign powers and wanted to interfere in the affairs of Peshawar. These reports were published at a time when efforts were underway for reconciliation between the Afghan government and the British Indian government, and a series of negotiations had begun to establish peace between the two countries. Meanwhile, a number of people in Peshawar who had ties to the British intelligence network played an active role in spreading these reports in order to pave the way for damaging relations between Afghanistan and the British and to create an atmosphere of distrust between the two sides. While such news was spreading in the markets of Peshawar, there were also some individuals in the Kabul court who were opposed to strengthening friendly relations with the British and wanted to strain the relations between the two countries by spreading such news.

When the Nawab Sahib saw this, he asked him, "If you are going to such great trouble, why don't you sell them to me?" The merchant said, "Very well, you take them." Then the Nawab Sahib made an offer, the Hindu said this, the Nawab Sahib said no to that, the merchant said no to the Nawab Sahib, and the Nawab Sahib said, "Tomorrow these judges will make a decision." The merchant agreed. The Nawab Sahib got ready and sat in the carriage, and the judges began their work. The price of one item was set by the judges at twenty rupees. 2709.right:
With the advice of my fingers, I issued such an order.
For a long time, it has been my heart's desire to do something for my nation and to bring them some benefit, because our society is currently in a very backward state. This desire of my heart was increasing day by day until I finally started the work of publishing this Pashto magazine. I hope that this aspiration of my heart will be fulfilled in this way, that all my Afghan brothers will benefit from it, and that this effort of mine will shine like a light in their minds, and I will be very happy with this.
The purpose of publishing this magazine is only the development of the Pashto language and the preservation of Pashto culture, and I want to provide knowledge to my fellow Afghans through this magazine and make them familiar with their history and culture.
This magazine will be published every two weeks and will contain various writings, such as articles by scholars, reminders of historical events, information about Pashto literature, and others that will play a role in enlightening the minds of my Afghan brothers. I hope that all Afghans will help me in this path and will send their writings and advice for the publication of this magazine.
In the end, I thank all those people who have helped me in this work, and may God reward them.
I am carrying out the affairs of publishing the magazine with great love and sincerity, and I hope that this magazine will become a good tool for serving the Pashto language and literature, and in the future, this magazine will expand further and make much progress.
Note: This magazine has been started for a specific purpose, which is the development of the Pashto language and literature, and I request anyone who has something to say in this regard to send it so that this joint work of ours may have a good result.
2709.left:
In this magazine, in every issue, along with the writings of scholars, there will also be information about historical events, new ways will be sought for the development of the Pashto language, and work will also be done for the unity of the Pashtuns.
We want to strive through this magazine to build a society in which the light of knowledge and wisdom is spread, and our Afghan brothers think about their future and take steps towards progress.
All of you who read this magazine, it is hoped that you will share your opinions and suggestions with us so that we can make this magazine even better and tailor it to the needs of the people.
In this path, our goal is service, and we are not looking for any kind of material gain. Our only goal is for our language and culture to remain alive and for our Afghans to become familiar with science and knowledge.
Your support is very important to us, and our doors are open for any kind of help and advice.
In the end, I once again thank all those who have helped us in this work, and I hope that this magazine will be useful for all Afghans.
Administration
