Among those from the era of Ghazi Amir Habibullah Khan who had the permission to speak with great courage regarding the deterioration of the country's situation at that time, one was a high-ranking official in the court of the then-King of Afghanistan, who had presented his views on the state of the country in such a way that no trace of fear or dread could be seen in them. Regarding the internal situation of the country and the poverty and destitution of the people, he writes:

In reality, there has been a noticeable change in the level of knowledge and education of our country's people, and to raise the standard of living for the people, it is necessary that serious measures be taken to promote modern education and new learning in the country. Because due to illiteracy and the lack of education, many people in the country are facing a situation where no hope can be held for the future. Furthermore, regarding the economic situation of the country, it can be said that poverty and hardship are widespread among the people, and without the attention of government officials, solving this problem seems impossible.

According to this writer, the only way for the country's progress is to introduce new reforms and establish justice, and the administration of affairs must be carried forward by considering the will and demands of the people.
2926.left:
In the end, for the prosperity of the country and the well-being of the people, he has demanded the establishment of a system in which the rights of all citizens are protected and the rule of law is the same for everyone. He writes:

“If we want to compete with other nations and find a place for ourselves in the world, we must not spare any effort in reforming the internal affairs of our country. The rule of law, the strengthening of justice, and raising the level of public education are the fundamental tasks that we need for the country's progress. Without this, any other type of action will only be a waste of time and will not bring any positive change to the fate of the country.”

These writings of the author present a clear picture of the social and political situation of that time, which points to the spirit of desire for change among the country's intellectuals.

2934.right:
14 April 1920
Pashtun
Although the inhabitants of the great Khyber Pass are Pashtuns by origin and lineage, their lifestyle is distinct from that of many other Pashtuns. If one turns the pages of history regarding the people of the Khyber Pass, it becomes clear that they have lived within the framework of their tribal customs for many centuries. The Jirga system is very strong among them, and for the resolution of any dispute, the decision of the elders holds the status of law. The people of the Khyber Pass are generally known for their hospitality; if someone visits their home, they serve them to the best of their ability. The Pashto language on their tongues is very sweet and unique in its flavor. If one looks at other aspects of their culture and life, there is no doubt about their bravery and courage. They are always ready to defend their land and stand until death in protecting their honor. For the progress of the Pashtun, there is a need for the light of knowledge in their lives; if they are given the opportunity for education, they can do great things for their nation and homeland. In my opinion, the merits of their social life are worthy of being extended to other parts of Pashtunkhwa. It is the duty of all Pashtuns to take the hands of their fellow brothers and pave the way for unity. May God grant that our Pashtun brothers are always successful in their lives and keep the name of their nation high.

Regarding the desire to publish the first issue of "Pashtun" and the establishment of a general society for Pashtuns on the occasion of the New Year, the details were provided as follows:

1- With the publication of the first issue of Pashtun this year, there is a need for the formation of a society in Pashtunkhwa in which all the leaders of the region work for the progress of the Pashtun nation.

2- The goal of this society is to create a common strategy for unity in the cultural, economic, and political fields of the Pashtun nation.

3- In this meeting, it was collectively decided that a national Jirga should be called for the people of Pashtunkhwa, and joint decisions should be made for the welfare of the nation.

4- The participants of the meeting emphasized that new schools and educational institutions should be opened for the education and training of the people of Pashtunkhwa, and special attention should be paid to the development of the Pashto language.

5- Along with this, the appointment of a committee was mentioned, which would work to hear the problems of the people in different regions of Pashtunkhwa.

6- At the end of this meeting, it was also decided that financial aid should be collected to publish a newspaper that would raise the voice of the Pashtun nation.

8 - A temporary committee was appointed for the aforementioned Jirga, whose responsibility is to take steps for the Jirga's policy and the selection of members.

9 - In the end, a promise was made by all participants that they would dedicate all their energy to the unity and progress of the nation and would work for the advancement of the Pashtun.

Azadi, the voice of independence and the demand for rights:
The Azadi publication conveys the voice of oppressed and subjugated people to the world with complete honesty and truthfulness. Our path is one, and that is the path of Islamic unity and the country's freedom. We fight against oppression through our pens, and we hope to improve the social and political state of society in the light of truth and reality. 2943.right: Regarding the civilization of Muslims in the past, their knowledge, and many other things about them, we know that these people had surpassed other nations of the world in every art and every science. At a time when many nations of the modern world were spending their nights in the dark shadows of ignorance, the followers of this blessed religion of Islam, through their scientific achievements, laid the foundation for the civilization and scientific progress of the modern world, which even today, people of many countries of the world remember and take pride in. For the sake of this scientific and civilizational progress, and for those who seek information in this regard, we have started this series so that our nation can find information about their ancestors and their scientific achievements.
2943.left: So this is why we started this series, so that we can learn about our history and our nation, learn about their achievements for ourselves, and make progress in this path. In the same way, keeping in mind that we must know our history, the purpose of starting this series is to share information about our civilization with our people and thus contribute to the progress of our nation. The goal of our effort is that by once again acquiring our scientific and civilizational heritage, we may find our place on the world stage. And we hope that this series will be useful for the knowledge and mental development of our people. (Concluded in the previous issue)

It is a fact that the progress of the country is impossible without education, so we must make tireless efforts in this path.

2946.right:
Question?

What have I done that I have become so distressed by my enemies that I have no idea what to do? I submit this request to the owner of Sitara-e-Afghan: for the sake of God, show me a way to salvation. I can no longer endure the oppression and tyranny of my enemies; what should I do?

Answer:

The answer to your above question:

1- Do not be proud before your enemies, because it is very necessary to use patience and tolerance in the face of the enemy's deceit and trickery.

2- Do not be proud before your enemies, and in the face of your enemies, use such strategy and prudence, both secretly and openly, that they are left behind in their pursuit of you. In the face of any kind of their oppression and tyranny, find such patience and steadfastness within yourself that you are not broken by any of their cruelties. In this calamity and difficulty of yours, trust in your Lord and seek refuge in the court of God from the evil of your enemies. Pray to God for deliverance from their evil so that God may grant you salvation from the oppression of your enemies, bring blessings into your affairs, and keep you safe from the evil of your enemies.
2946.left:
Question?

I am very troubled because of my friends. Among my own friends, there are people who have friendship and companionship with me, but secretly they wish for my bad and are engaged in all kinds of measures for my destruction and ruin. So, what should I do against such people to get rid of them?

Answer:

This is the answer to your question:

1- Be very careful in choosing your friends and companions, do not trust everyone, and in your friendship, join with those who use truthfulness and loyalty and are honest in their friendship.

2- If you suspect such people among your friends, then keep yourself secretly away from them, do not share your secrets with them, act with great caution and precision in your dealings with them, and choose a path in your relationships with them so that they cannot cause you harm.

In these days, the hearts of all the people of Afghanistan, by the grace and mercy of God, are filled with concern for the oppression of the Muslims of India, and they are praying for their success. Therefore, on behalf of the people of Afghanistan, the following petition has been written for the leaders of the Muslims of India with the intention of sympathy, and we hope that they become aware of it and that our sincerity becomes known to them.

A petition of sympathy from the people of Afghanistan in the service of the oppressed Muslims of India
On behalf of all the Muslims of Afghanistan, we offer our respects and sympathy to the leaders of the Muslims of India and their tireless efforts. We understand that you are facing difficult circumstances, and your struggle for the truth is commendable. Our prayers are with you, and we hope that God (SWT) makes your efforts successful and removes all obstacles before you. Your sacrifices for your religion and homeland are a source of pride for every Muslim. As Afghans, we stand by your side and share in your pain. This is a solidarity that forms a strong bond between us both in the light of the holy religion of Islam.

2949.right:
Ethics

Now again in this article, for the sake of advice and lessons, I am writing a few points below; I hope you will keep these points in mind:

1- Always interact with everyone with a gentle temperament and good manners, because the owner of good manners is respected everywhere.
2- Respect your elders and teachers greatly, because the secret to success in life is hidden in their prayers and advice.
3- Choose the path of honesty and truthfulness in every task, because Allah (Jalla Jalaluhu) loves the truthful and the trustworthy.
4- Do not be lazy in prayer, because prayer is the pillar of religion and protects a person from sins.
5- Value your time greatly, and do not waste your time on useless talk and activities, because time is a sword; if you do not strike with it, it will strike you.
6- Help your other friends in good deeds, and forbid them from bad deeds.
7- Protect yourself from bad friends, because the company of bad friends ruins a person's character.
8- Always strive in the pursuit of knowledge, because knowledge is the torch of human life.
9- Have love for your homeland and your people, and always be ready to serve them.
10- Start every task with planning and thought, so that you do not face regret.

Author: Shah Alam Khan

1322 Hijri Qamari
2949.left:
In addition to this, the following points are also very important:

1- Serving one's parents is everyone's duty, and in their pleasure lies the pleasure of Allah.
2- Helping the poor and needy financially and personally is a high rank of humanity.
3- Strictly refrain from telling lies, because lying is the mother of all evils.
4- Refraining from backbiting and speaking ill of others is a trait of a believer.
5- In every situation, use patience and tolerance, and be content with Allah's will in times of hardship.
6- Keeping your home and environment clean is a part of faith.
7- Use gentleness in speech and firm determination in action.
8- Do not transgress anyone's rights, and deliver everyone's right to its owner.
9- Acquiring knowledge is mandatory for every Muslim man and woman.
10- Always struggle against your own self, so that you may remain safe from the whispers of Satan.

In the end, I pray to Almighty God that He grants us all the ability to become possessors of good morals, and aligns our lives in the light of the blessed religion of Islam. Amen.

2951.right:
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
Preface:
In previous issues, we had made a brief note regarding the start of this series, and in its continuation, we had also discussed the country's contemporary cultural and literary movements in another section. In this series, we have tried to shed light on those aspects of the country's contemporary history that may be on the verge of being forgotten with the passage of time, or that may have been discussed by certain circles in a way that, instead of facts, they have the color of myths and imaginations. This effort of ours, which we have considered in this approach for the sake of the country's national interests and uncovering historical truths, has caused us to draw the attention of our readers to some valuable writings and documented events of this stage of our language and literature. In this series, we have also mentioned the writings and works of a number of the country's scholars and cultural figures who have continued their actions for the growth and development of the Pashto language and literature. Our hope is that this series can serve as a reliable source for those young people and researchers who want to understand their country's contemporary history, culture, and literature accurately. This series, which is presented to readers in a new format with each issue, attempts to shed light on the country's past events and its cultural values in a truthful manner. We look forward to the opinions, suggestions, and criticisms of all our scholars, researchers, and language enthusiasts in this path, so that they may help in the strengthening and quality of this series. We recognize this task that we have undertaken as a great responsibility and hope that with the passage of time, we will not fail in this path of serving our language. Finally, we thank all those who cooperate with us in this regard and strive to enrich this work by presenting their writings and research.

By the grace and favor of Allah Almighty, due to the negligence of Muslims in their own religious and worldly affairs, they had fallen into pits of destruction and ruin. For their reform and welfare, a series of establishing madrasas for Islamic sciences and worldly arts, printing books, and launching newspapers has begun in every direction, which is a source of joy and hope for every zealous Muslim who loves the truth. However, along with this, it is also a matter of great regret that in our country, there is much carelessness regarding the correctness of language and the authenticity of vocabulary for printing books. Because the words written in our newspapers and books are very far from and altered from their original forms, it is necessary—in order for the authenticity of the language and the correctness of the vocabulary to remain forever—that for every book being printed, a person should be appointed who is knowledgeable about the principles of language and the rules of vocabulary, and who examines its words and phrases with precision, so that the path of the present people may align with the path of those of the past, and the spread of incorrect words may be prevented. Because the corruption of a language is a major cause of the corruption of a nation, it is necessary that great attention and thought be given to this matter, and for every new writing, a standard dictionary of language rules should be prepared so that it is easy for readers to read and fully understand its meaning, because without the correctness of language, there is no benefit in compiling books for science and art.
For the sciences that have been prescribed for the youth to learn, it is very essential to first learn the correctness of the language in order to understand their meaning and purpose, and then to strive to learn every science in its light is a great path for them. Therefore, it is necessary that an effort be started in the form of an organized group for the reform of the language, and a permanent column be dedicated in newspapers and journals for the correction of vocabulary.
This is a very necessary matter for a nation that is seeking a path for its own civilization, because the preservation of language and culture serves as a shield for the survival of a free nation.
(From a special article for 'Afghan')

It is said that there was a leading, powerful, and high-ranking person in this country who acted as an intermediary between the people and the government. This person strove with great compassion to defend the rights of the country's people, yet at the same time, he continued his efforts to ensure the government received full obedience and loyalty from the people. This person possessed great fame and credibility, and whenever any problem or disagreement arose in the country, the people would turn to him, and he would resolve the issue using his wisdom and tact. He had spent most of his life in the service of the nation and its people, and he was viewed in the hearts of the people as a compassionate and loyal leader. He was a man who had earned great respect due to his excellence and tact; all people acknowledged him with esteem and trusted his advice and decisions. This continued for a long time until his life came to an end.

In recent times, when changes occurred in world conditions and many people became proponents of new thoughts and perspectives, disagreements also arose regarding this person's methods and ideas. Some people criticized his approach, saying that his method was not in line with the demands of the present time. However, in contrast, there were also many people who supported his approach and spoke with respect about his past services. This disagreement emerged among the people in the form of a debate that continued for a long time, and along with this, different opinions were expressed regarding his personality. Some said that the result of his services should not be forgotten and his memory should be preserved forever, while others demanded a change in his approach.

In the life of a Pashtun (by himself)

Let us read these following words and sentences about the life of a Pashtun carefully:

A Pashtun is so deeply immersed in the love of his homeland in his life, just as fish are immersed in water; the Pashtun has become so selfless in his love for the homeland that he has paid no attention at all to his other life affairs. In this path, the Pashtun has endured such hardships that their equal would not be found in the history of the world. The Pashtun loves his elders just as a son loves his father; the Pashtun is himself a nation that is famous throughout the world for its bravery and honor. Compared to other nations of the world, the Pashtun shines in the field of honor and bravery just as stars shine in the dark night. The Pashtun is ready to make every sacrifice for the prosperity and happiness of his nation; there is such a force and power in the existence of a Pashtun that he stands like a mountain against the enemy. The Pashtun remains steadfast until death in the protection of his religion and culture and never bows his head before oppression and tyranny. The Pashtun believes that the purpose of life is the pleasure of God and the support of the oppressed; the Pashtun understands the value of every moment of his life and strives to spend his life in the path of goodness and brotherhood. The Pashtun has recorded such achievements in the pages of his history that will remain alive forever.

The path of a Pashtun's life is like a bright star that shows the path of truth in the darkness of oppression. Who will tell the story of the burning and pain of a Pashtun's heart? The life of a Pashtun is like a garden whose flowers are colored with the colors of faith and Islam. He acts as a shield not only for his own nation but for all the oppressed. A Pashtun is a nation that has recorded its name with pride in every phase of history. The scent of honor comes from every moment of his life, and signs of sacrifice are seen in his every step. Throughout his life, a Pashtun has supported truth and justice; he has never remained silent before a tyrant and has fought for his rights to the point of death. The Ministry's decision on the writing
Regarding the administrative affairs of this issue of Pashtun, the efforts of the editor of Pashtun newspaper, and the government's decisions concerning the printing and publishing of Pashtun newspaper that were taken into consideration, it was decided by the Ministry that Pashtun newspaper must continue its activities within the framework of the law and must fully comply with the country's laws regarding its publications.
The Ministry has explicitly stated in this regard that Pashtun newspaper has the potential to play a constructive role in disseminating information and knowledge for its readers in the country, but it must exercise extreme caution in the selection of its publications and should not publish anything that is detrimental to national unity and the stability of the country.
Furthermore, the Ministry has stated that the owner of the Pashtun newspaper's license and its officials must organize their affairs in accordance with this government decision, and if any sign of violation of the law is observed in the future, the government will be compelled to take necessary steps according to the law.
It is also stated in this announcement by the Ministry that Pashtun newspaper is an important tool for educating the people and for the cultural development of the country, and it should strive to express the truth and realities during the course of its activities.
This decision by the Ministry is considered a new phase for Pashtun newspaper, and they are requested to make beneficial use of this opportunity and work for the interests of the country's people.

2983.right:
June 1, 1946

Afghan

(Introduction)

A new and bright phase is beginning in the history of Afghanistan. This phase came at a time when the talk of freedom and progress was on everyone's tongue in the balance of nations' lives. The changes that have occurred in our country over the past few years are indicative of the fact that our people have chosen a path of a new life for their future. This is, in reality, the result of those struggles that our ancestors waged for the honor and pride of their country. Now it is our duty to follow this path with strong determination and action.

The political and economic changes that have taken place in our country in recent years have resulted in a great tremor in the thoughts of the people. These thoughts demand a new order, an order in which the light of justice, equality, and freedom is spread. Every citizen of our nation today is waiting for a new dawn, a dawn that announces the end of dark nights and the melody of a new life is heard everywhere. The Afghan nation no longer needs anyone to determine its destiny, because the blood of sacrifice and courage flows in the veins of this nation.
2983.left:
There are many obstacles in this path, but the determination of our nation has the ability to break all kinds of obstacles. Progress in the field of education, innovations in the sectors of industry and agriculture, and the protection of rights within the framework of justice are what constitute our priorities. It is a fact that our country, along with possessing natural resources, also has capital in the form of brave youth. These very youth are the architects of this nation's future.

It is the duty of our journalists and writers to publish these demands and aspirations of the nation in a sacred manner. History will record our today's efforts in its pages. If our steps are strong, then the destination of success is not far. This journey demands patience, tolerance, and unity. We must never fall prey to despair, because the light of hope has the power to break any kind of darkness.

We pray for the success of the Afghan nation and hope that our country finds its place in the ranks of the world's developed nations. It is the national and moral duty of every Afghan to play their role in the reconstruction of the country.

(A. Kh. Editorial of the publication)

If seeing is, in reality, a spectacle of power in the palace of creation to display the grandeur of man, it is human nature to show one's perfection before others, and also to praise the perfection of others upon seeing it. When sitting in a gathering, everyone tries to show their perfection according to their ability, but when a gathering is colored with humility and politeness alongside perfection, that gathering is distinguished from others. The gathering of the wise is overflowing with their knowledge and wisdom, and the gathering of the ignorant is a display of their ignorance. Just as there are flowers of different colors in a garden, likewise there are humans with different temperaments in a gathering, but it is the work of the wise to treat everyone according to their temperament. If someone looks with arrogance and pride, it is everyone's duty to stop them, but in a soft language and in such a way that a path of understanding is found to their heart. And in a gathering of perfection and knowledge, the consideration of politeness and ethics must be maintained for the sake of mutual respect, because the essence of knowledge and wisdom lies in maintaining politeness, and it is a sign of the wise to use politeness and respect with everyone.

2985.right: At this time, a very noteworthy matter regarding Eastern affairs emerged in London, which is that a party has appeared in Britain that advocates for the freedom of India. They are opponents of Britain's policy regarding Eastern affairs and they say that Britain's policy regarding the East is full of mistakes. If these people were to join the British government, it is possible that a change could occur in the policy regarding Eastern affairs, or at the very least, a light of new thinking could emerge in British policy. This matter caught the attention of many people in India and a new hope was born in their hearts. In any case, we must be very cautious about this matter and must understand that in politics, it takes a long time for such things to become reality, and often the result of such things is not as we expect. In any case, this is a matter that is a great hope for those seeking India's freedom, and we must keep an eye on the progress of this matter. Britain's policy regarding India is at a very delicate stage, and we must proceed with our affairs very carefully. As a nation, we must unite for our freedom and must fight firmly for our goals.
2985.left: Urgent Government: A piece of news that is about to reach the provisional government of India, concerning the policies of the ministers and the policies of the British. According to the ministers, the demand for freedom in India is a reality that no one can hide or suppress by force. Although the British are trying to silence this voice, they have not succeeded. Another aspect of the ministers' council is that they are fighting for the rights of the people of India at an international level. They have established relations with various countries of the world in order to gain international support for India's independence. The provisional government has announced that they will fight for the rights of the people of India until their last breath and will never bow their heads before colonialism. According to the ministers, the freedom of India is the right of every Indian citizen, and they will make every sacrifice to achieve this right. Their determination has breathed new life into the people of India and has further illuminated the path of their struggle for freedom.

Do you know that this way of learning, which is called modern education, has become the cause of humanity's destruction and the decline of morals? Does this new education, in the name of civilization, not sow the seeds of such a poisonous and dangerous thought in human brains that it causes the destruction of their human and moral feelings?

In reality, the education of our current era is a dark dungeon of imitation and pointless following of others, in which the soul and thought of the new generation have been imprisoned. Through this education, we have not only lost our national values but have also become slaves to foreigners in our own home. Instead of cultivating a free and thoughtful human being, this education creates a creature that neither cares for itself nor has the ability to worry about the future of its nation. They are only in pursuit of memorizing those books that are written in a very useless and dry manner and do not sow any kind of true knowledge in the minds of the students.

We must wake up from this negligence and adopt a path of education that aligns with our culture, language, and national history. If we want to regain our lost greatness once again, it is necessary that instead of the current material and soulless education, we establish an educational system that plays a constructive role in building a person's character and sows the love of truth and reality in their inner self.

If we think about the principles of past education, we will understand that at that time a specific method was used for education. In it, students were trained under the supervision of a teacher, which was of great importance for the strengthening of their minds and the expansion of their thinking. In order for us to brighten our future, we must understand well that it is necessary to use methods for education that have a greater spirit of morality, patriotism, and human love. In order for us to save ourselves from this threat of education, we must start work in all our educational institutions for a new thought and a new curriculum, in which there is no place for the imitation of the West instead of Islamic and national values.

Question: Do Muslim sects have the right to call Muslims by the name of Muslims? If they hold a belief about another Muslim that he is a disbeliever, then what is the ruling on it?
Answer: In the Book of Allah (SWT) and the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (PBUH), there are very clear instructions regarding the excommunication (takfir) of Muslims, their killing, or creating division among Muslims and their rights. Therefore, anyone who speaks about a Muslim in a way that excludes him from the circle of Islam is, in reality, violating the rulings of Sharia and attempting to sow discord among Muslims. It is the responsibility of Muslims to adopt a path of brotherhood and love toward one another and to protect themselves from the words of such instigators of discord.
3011.left:
Question: What is your opinion regarding the revival of the Islamic Caliphate concerning the Muslims of India? Is it beneficial for the Muslims, or does it create new problems among the Muslims?
Answer: Our opinion regarding the subject of the revival of the Caliphate concerning the Muslims of India is that every group, in accordance with its own conditions and situation, must strive to implement the rulings of Islam. In Islamic history, the concept of the Caliphate was for the sake of unity and preserving the cohesion of the Islamic Ummah, not for creating new divisions among Muslims. Therefore, the Muslims of India should conduct their affairs while considering their own circumstances and conditions, and work for the unity of the Muslims.

Adultery and the Adulterer
Recently, the question has arisen in the minds of some people: what is the punishment for an adulterer?
Answer: In Islamic Sharia, very strict and firm laws have been established for adultery.
1- If the adulterer is married (muhsan), the punishment is stoning (to be pelted with stones).
2- If the adulterer is not married (ghair muhsan), the punishment is one hundred lashes.
3- How many witnesses are needed to prove adultery?
Answer: To prove adultery, four just and truthful witnesses are necessary who have seen this act with their own eyes.
4- If someone falsely accuses another of adultery, what is their punishment?
Answer: The punishment for Qadhf (falsely accusing someone) is eighty lashes, and until the accuser proves their claim to be true, their testimony will not be accepted again.
5- Do you have any recommendations for the prevention of adultery?
Answer: For the prevention of adultery, first, the role of the family is very important; second, the moral education of society; and third, the strict implementation of the law.

Among these groups, there are some who have used the name of religion to deceive people and for their own personal interests. 3024.right:
Question: In the proof of a claim that a claimant makes for a right and the defendant denies it, what proof is incumbent upon the claimant in Sharia?
Answer: According to Sharia, there are two types of proof for the claimant: one by way of testimony and the other by way of admission. If the claimant brings two just witnesses to prove their claim, then despite the defendant's denial, the claimant's claim will be proven before the judge. If the claimant cannot bring witnesses, then an oath will be demanded from the defendant. If the defendant takes the oath, the claimant's claim is void, and if they do not take the oath, the claimant's claim is proven, because refusing to take an oath is equivalent to an admission.
Question: If a person demands money from another person and the defendant refuses to pay, in what situation will the judge demand an oath from the defendant?
Answer: When the claimant cannot bring witnesses to prove their claim, the judge, according to the ruling of Sharia, tells the defendant to either bring witnesses or take an oath. If they take the oath, the claimant's claim is terminated, and if they refuse to take the oath, then after their refusal, it is necessary for the judge to rule in favor of the claimant and order the defendant to pay the right, because taking an oath is a great responsibility for the defendant, and after the refusal, the claimant's right is proven.
3024.left:
Question: If a man claims the property of another man and the defendant denies being in possession of that property, is it Sharia-compliant for the man who denies possession of that property to take an oath or not?
Answer: Yes, it is Sharia-compliant for the defendant to take an oath in the case where the plaintiff has no witnesses, because the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) has said, "The oath is upon the one who denies," meaning the oath is the responsibility of the person who denies. If the defendant takes an oath at the time of denial, there is no order for him to pay the property; however, it is incumbent upon him to fear Allah Almighty, and if the right truly belongs to the plaintiff, he should hand over the property to the plaintiff, because taking a false oath carries a very severe punishment for the hereafter.
Question: If a man has no proof to establish his right and demands an oath from the defendant, is this an act contrary to Sharia?
Answer: No, this is not contrary to Sharia; rather, in the case where there is no proof, it is the right of the plaintiff to demand an oath from the defendant. If the defendant takes the oath, the claim is dismissed, and if he does not take it, the right of the plaintiff is established. This is a great path of Sharia justice so that people's rights are not lost, and this is the demand of fairness.

3028.right: In issue 124, an article titled "Islam and Freedom" was published. This article became a subject of objection and questioning by a number of people. Their objection was that the author of the article did not properly understand the rulings of Islam and the concept of freedom, and had made statements that are in conflict with the spirit of Islam. The author had called for certain reforms in this article, but in their view, these reforms constitute interference in religious affairs. In the same issue, there were also some comments regarding the government's policies. This writing is, in general, an example of the intellectual currents of that period, which attempted to find a balance between religion and modernity. In this regard, the government's position was that religious scholars should be consulted so that a path could be chosen in societal affairs that would both preserve Islamic values and allow for progress in accordance with the demands of the time.
3028.left: In the continuation of this discussion, it is stated that freedom of expression and freedom of the press must be within the framework of the law. In the opinion of many people, there is a need for reforms in the holy religion of Islam, but these reforms must be carried out in the light of the principles of Islamic Sharia. This article also refers to those who, due to ignorance, offer incorrect interpretations of religious issues. In the end, it is requested that for the progress of the country, we should look for a constructive policy so that no conflict arises between the people's faith and the needs of the new era. These contents show the first stage of a deep discussion on the pages of the journal of that time, which later created widespread reactions in society.

Year 1, Issue 12 - 13

The month of Waga (September)

When I was busy looking through the Kabul newspapers of the month of Waga this year, my eyes fell upon this article while reading an issue of (Aman-e-Afghan), which had expressed its heart's pains in the path of serving the homeland with great sincerity and clear language as follows:

For the awake and intelligent youth of our homeland, the field of service to the country is vast. One of them is to strive in awakening the people of the homeland. Because the children of this country are still unaware of their life rights and have remained far from the light of knowledge and wisdom. So, if our youth choose this path, it will be a great step for the progress and prosperity of the country.

Furthermore, it was stated in this article that there is a need for unity and agreement among Afghans. If we want to compete with the developed nations of the world, we must avoid differences among ourselves and, by supporting one another, take steps toward the development of the country.
3029.left:
Question:

Is it permissible for a Muslim to befriend a non-Muslim or to partner with them in business? Given that the teachings of our religion recommend great caution in dealings with non-believers.

Answer:

Islam, as a religion that has come for the prosperity of humanity, emphasizes justice and fairness among humans. If friendship or business with a non-Muslim is within the framework of Islamic Sharia and the interests of Muslims are protected therein, then there is no prohibition in Islam for this.

However, a Muslim must be very wise in their dealings and should not take steps that bring their faith and the principles of their religion into question. Especially with those who seek to be hostile to Islam, one must deal with complete caution and with the advice of scholars.

In conclusion, we must say that the beginning and end of every task should be for the pleasure of Allah Almighty, so that there may be blessings in this work and it may become a cause for good in both worlds.

On behalf of the coordinator, at the service of all.

The year 1338 AH

The main axis of this progress lies in the awakening of the people and their cooperation. The children of the country must understand that their contribution to the development of their country is the most important. These efforts of the government are not just on paper, but are applicable in the practical field. In order for our country to compete with other countries of the world, there must be a great emphasis on modern sciences and technical education. Even in the face of any kind of difficulties on this path, we must use patience and perseverance, because the existence of obstacles at the beginning of any great work is a natural matter. We must take lessons from the past pages of our history and lay foundations for the future generation that will be the cause of their honor and pride. This national will and determination are what can fully help in filling any shortcomings of our dear country. With the hope that as a result of all these measures, our country will reach the high levels of progress in the light of science and art and stand in the ranks of the developed nations of the world.

3031.right: In this Pashtunistan, where efforts to spread knowledge are currently underway, the need for the attention of scholars for the development of the Pashto language is felt very strongly. The Pashto language, which is a symbol of pride for the Pashtun nation with its ancient civilization, demands scientific and literary growth in accordance with the requirements of the new era. Pashtun literary societies must take steps in this direction so that our young generation becomes aware of the sacred values of their mother tongue. We must not forget that the life of a language depends on the expansion of writings in it and the efforts of scholars. Therefore, it is necessary for every Pashtun family to play their part in this and teach their children to learn Pashto. This is the reason why, in the past, we had some shortcomings in preserving our linguistic heritage, but with the new light of education, the hope has emerged that a new phase will begin for the development of the Pashto language. Every Pashtun who loves their nation should take their full part in this sacred purpose.
3031.left: For those who aspire to innovate in their languages, this task is considered a national duty. If we look, other nations of the world have also reached their goals through the development of their languages. We, too, must introduce Pashto to the world as an advanced language by publishing the scientific works of our scholars and expanding their writings. It is the demand of the time that a curriculum for the Pashto language be arranged at the school and university levels that aligns with the needs of today. Likewise, the use of the Pashto language in the media will greatly help in making the general public understand the importance of the language. We believe that the formation of a united nation is impossible without a strong language. It is hoped that for the purpose of Pashtun unity, these scientific efforts will be further accelerated and our future generation will take steps toward a bright and developed Pashtunkhwa. (End)

The experience of the past few years has shown us that with the blessing of unity, every kind of hardship can be easily ended. It is the effort of the country's enemies to sow discord among us and block our progress through this path, but our wise nation must protect itself from these conspiracies and work with full loyalty and sincerity with its leaders.

The demand of this time is also that we strengthen unity, brotherhood, and the spirit of collective work everywhere, because with the help of this path, we can stand against any kind of problem and bring more pride to our country.

In the end, we pray to God for the honor and pride of this country. It is hoped that these steps will be completed successfully, and for this, the cooperation of all our people is a condition. 3033.right:
Copying regarding the newspaper

When we were also asked the question regarding whether it is permissible to copy a newspaper or not? Then in answer to this question, we say: If the newspaper owner has prohibited the copying of their newspaper, then copying it without their permission is not permissible from a Sharia perspective. Because the newspaper owner has incurred expenses on it and the right to its profit belongs solely to them. And if someone copies it against their will, then that is an infringement (excess) on their right. And consuming a Muslim's right is not permissible. However, if the newspaper owner themselves has given permission to copy, then there is no harm in it. And apart from this, if the newspaper is copied for a necessity in which there is a benefit for the general Muslims, then even then, according to the Sharia principles, there is room for it in the view of some scholars. But still, it is necessary to be cautious and to protect the right of the newspaper owner.

Subject: Copying the Afghan newspaper
3033.left:
And in the same way, regarding these articles and news of the newspaper, we can also say that the owner of the newspaper has worked very hard to publish it and has invested capital for its arrangement and management. So, if someone publishes its articles elsewhere without his permission, then this is a waste of his rights. And in Islam, seizing someone else's hard work and benefiting from it without permission is not a good deed. Therefore, it is the duty of every Muslim to respect the rights of the newspaper and to observe the Sharia rulings in the matter of copying it. If the newspaper owner is agreeable to having its news copied elsewhere, then there is no problem. And if he is not satisfied with this, then copying it or using its material is not permissible according to Sharia. It is necessary for the newspaper owner to write "Copyright Reserved" or other such phrases in his newspapers so that people are aware regarding its copying. And in this way, everyone's rights will be protected and we will also be saved from disputes.

(Amin Atal)

3034.right:
Issue 11
The account of a magazine by the name of "Pashtun"
A magazine by the name of "Pashtun," which is published from Kabul, is an important source for the development of the Pashto language and the education of Pashtuns. This magazine is a great testament to the efforts made by scholars and writers in the field of Pashto literature and culture.

In this magazine, very useful content has been included for the growth of both new and old Pashto literature. Likewise, many important writings regarding the unity of Pashtuns and the advancement of their civilization can be seen. This magazine is a light of knowledge and a better life for its readers.

We hope that the publication series of this magazine continues in this way, so that it may perform its services well for the mental growth of our dear compatriots and the development of the Pashto language. In every issue of this magazine, content regarding the history, literature, and national identity of Pashtuns is published that every Pashtun needs.

Pashtun
The word Pashtun contains a spirit of solidarity and unity among the people of Pashtunkhwa that shines clearly in every era of our history's pages; it is the spirit of unity and consensus that has created a sense of pain and joy in the existence of the Pashtun as if they were one body. Pashtuns are not just speakers of one language, but a living nation that has sacrificed their lives throughout history in the protection of their land, honor, and dignity. When we look at the past events of the Pashtun national life, it appears to us that this nation is unmatched in the fields of hospitality, loyalty, bravery, and knowledge. By the pen of Mr. Shamsuddin
O Afghan youth! When will you awaken? When will you think about the prosperity and well-being of yourself and your homeland? When will you stand in the ranks of other nations of the world in the light of knowledge and art? Think a little about what your ancestors did in the world through the power of knowledge? It was through the blessing of knowledge that they carried the flag of Islam to the corners of the world and took their place at the pinnacle of honor. What has happened to you today? Why are you lying in negligence? Why are you struggling in the dark shadows of ignorance? Why do you not take steps toward the improvement and progress of your homeland and people? Do you know that knowledge is the key to everything? If there is no knowledge, there is no honor. If there is no knowledge, there is no joy in life. So let us gird our loins to acquire knowledge, save our homeland from the dark shadows of misery, and take steps toward a new life.

Do we not have the right to live in honor and peace like others? Of course, we do. But this right is not obtained by sitting idle and being thoughtless. This right is obtained through knowledge, understanding, unity, and consensus. Let us fulfill our responsibility toward the prosperity of our country by making a resolve today. Let us light the candles of knowledge in every home and play our part in eliminating the shadows of ignorance. Only in this way can the path to the salvation and pride of our homeland and people be found.

What kind of men are considered in terms of law? In this way, first, regarding the duty of human beings, this duty is determined for humans by means of law. That every individual is recognized by their right and by means of the law, and if they remain within the limits of the law, then as a human being, they fulfill this duty. But if someone transgresses the law, then they are not a human but rather like a disorder, and the law has also set certain restrictions for such people.

Now, if someone asks whether this is a matter determined by law regarding human duty, or in other words, if the law truly recognizes a human as a human by means of a duty and their right, then in this case, what is the decision regarding the duty of humans? In response, we can say that the law, by means of this duty, not only shows humans a way of life but is also an essential thing for the protection of their rights, and in this way, the law plays an important role in every aspect of human life. And if the law is implemented by means of a society, then such an order will be created in the life of the society that will protect the right of every human and everyone will live their life within the framework of the law.

In reality, the law is something that lays the foundation of justice and fairness in human life. If someone violates this law, they are attempting to disrupt the peace and tranquility of society. And in this case, the law takes strict and punishable measures against such people, so that others may learn a lesson from it and the peace of society remains preserved. Thus, the law is not just something regarding human duty, but is a fundamental component for the protection of the entire system of human life.

Time
Time does not remain in one state.
Life is the name of changes; sometimes it is one thing and sometimes another. A person must understand that with the passage of time, circumstances also change. In the changing of times, there are paths to progress if one understands them and aligns their life with the demands of the time.

3122.right:
---- 14 ----
Good education and its benefits
O brothers of faith! Indeed, when we reflect on the pursuit of knowledge, there are many sciences that, due to ignorance, become a cause of destruction and ruin for humanity. However, knowledge is such a gift from God that it distinguishes and elevates man above other creatures. Through knowledge, human intellect and thought are developed and expanded, and the path to success and perfection in life's affairs is revealed. In today's era, when we consider the importance of education, it is clear to everyone that education is one of the essential needs for every human being. Education transforms a person's morals, character, and way of interacting with others toward improvement. Because of knowledge, a person can distinguish between truth and falsehood and can easily make decisions between right and wrong in various aspects of their life. Education is the foundation of a nation's progress and prosperity, and it is a ladder by which one can reach the destinations of development and success. Through knowledge, new thoughts enter the human mind, and new ways and methods are found to solve life's problems. Therefore, in order for us to strive to build a society for our lives that is filled with peace, tranquility, and progress, it is necessary for us to equip our children with knowledge and bring the light of education to them.

3123.right:
What shall we do about this?
Education is not just like other studies; rather, education is a tool that is a fundamental and irreplaceable path for progress and development on a global scale. In the current era, education is the only means for the prosperity of a nation and the defense of their rights. Due to the lack of education in our society, we are facing immense problems in many areas, but for the young generation, obtaining education is a complex and difficult stage. There is a need for public awareness in society regarding the value and necessity of education. We must create an environment where education is accessible to everyone, and no one remains deprived of the light of knowledge. The cooperation of every member of society is necessary for the promotion of education. If we want to be owners of a prosperous future, we must remove the obstacles in the path of education and put all our efforts into this field. Education is not limited to books and schools; rather, it is a process that directs human thought and actions toward the truth. If we look at the pages of history, we will see that every nation that has paid attention to education has succeeded and its name has remained throughout history.

3180.right:
On September 24, 1920, the Pashtun newspaper

News of the publication of Pashtun newspaper in Kabul

With the announcement of the start of the publication of the Pashtun newspaper in Kabul, many of our nation's esteemed and scholarly individuals welcomed this newspaper with their writings and opinions. Regarding the policy of our newspaper, and the determination we have for the awakening of the Pashtun nation and their cultural development, many such writings have been received from the country's writers that are considered a great hope for the country's progress. We respectfully thank our dear readers for sending us their valuable opinions. This newspaper of ours will not just be a place for publishing news, but a special arena for spreading the message of Pashto literature and Pashtun unity. We hope that all Pashtuns will use their pens in this path to protect their language and culture and give further strength to this scientific and national movement of ours. Our goal is to light the lamps of knowledge in every home and keep the spirit of unity and brotherhood alive in the hearts of the Pashtun nation. In the previous issues of this newspaper, the contents that have been published have clarified the ways and means for the welfare and progress of the nation. In the end, we hope that all compatriots will help us by sending their advice and writings, because with the power of the nation's pen, we can brighten the future of our country.

3181.right:
In life
I was looking for a lasting piece on the opinions and views of scholars regarding the struggle of life, but when I research the life circumstances and works of many people in this path, I always realize that this work, like a great history of life, is worth mentioning as an important history for society. Thinking about the lives and works of such people is truly of great value for the development of human thought. I want to think about creating a place regarding the life circumstances of such people so that all people can benefit from it; this work is considered a very great service to society, and by understanding their life circumstances, we can find a good path for our own work in the future, because the lives of scholars and experienced people are truly like a ship that finds its way through storms in the ocean of life and reaches its destination.

An important purpose of human life is to serve others. There are many such people who have spent their entire lives in this path to solve the problems of the people of society and show them the way to a better life. Such people are highly respected in society, and their memories remain forever. Thinking about the lives of such people gives a person the courage to also do things for others during their own life that cause the progress of society. Truly, the real meaning of life is that a person spends their life in the service of others and brings positive change to their lives.
3181.left: The more we understand the philosophy of life, the more our awareness of the great goals and intentions of our life increases. In this path, the opinions of scholars and thinkers are very valuable, because they have deep contact with every aspect of life and, based on their experiences, provide guidance that is useful for everyone's life. In order for us to understand the beauty of life and its deep meanings, it is necessary to reflect on the writings and words of such people. An important lesson of life is that a human should stand firm against all kinds of problems and never give up on their goal. It is a sign of a wise person that they learn a new lesson from every event in life. In any case, courage and patience are very important for taking steps on the path of life, and those who possess these qualities are always successful in their lives.

Introduction
Look! It has been several months since I wrote a few lines under the name of "Faryad" (Cry) with the intention of sharing them with my brothers, but alas, except for a few Pashto enthusiasts who understood the pain of my heart from the bottom of their hearts, no one else bothered to take a single step for the sake of Pashto. To tell the truth, in that writing, I had mentioned the shortcomings of the Pashto language and a few ways for its development, but unfortunately, the series of indifference from our own elders and writers towards this helpless and powerless language of Pashto reached such a point that now there is no room left for patience and endurance in the narrowness of my heart. I do not want to cry out for the rights of Pashto in front of such insensitive people anymore.

Brothers! I write with drops of my heart's blood for the survival of the Pashto language and I seek your attention.
3183.left:
In the end, I humbly request all Pashto enthusiasts to gird their loins to take a new and constructive step for the service of their language and to show readiness to endure all kinds of difficulties and problems in this path, because the future of the Pashto language lies in this unity and in making joint efforts. Finally, for all those who have taken a new and sincere step for the literary and cultural service of Pashto in this scattered state, while hoping for a great success, I pray for their prosperity in the language of my pen.

(Abdul Ghaffar)

3186.right:
Question:
What are the rules for the beauty of words and meanings, and for the harmony of meter and rhyme in Pashto ghazal?
In the Pashto language, it is essential to give full consideration to the meter and rhyme of the poem in order to compose a ghazal. Given its antiquity, the Pashto ghazal is very sweet and fluent. Just as the ghazal is a good medium for expressing emotions in other languages, it holds the same status in Pashto. For those who wish to write ghazals in Pashto, it is necessary to acquire full proficiency in the fields of prosody (Aruz) and rhyme (Qawafi). For the fluency of a Pashto ghazal, it is also necessary that words be used in their proper place and that words be chosen that find a place in the listener's heart. In every hemistich of a ghazal, it is necessary to emphasize the continuity of meaning and the elevation of thought. If we look at the history of the Pashto ghazal, many great poets have greatly developed it, and following their style can prove very beneficial for a new poet. In composing poetry, while maintaining a balance between exaggeration and a natural style, one should speak in a way that reflects the sweetness of the Pashto language and its culture.

If this effort of ours plants the seed of love for the homeland in even one person's heart, then the reward for this toil of ours will be complete. In this newspaper, along with domestic and foreign news, information regarding scientific, historical, and social issues will also be published. It is hoped that with the support of our valued readers, this series will continue as such and will continue its work for the prosperity of the homeland and the awakening of the people.

3198.right:
Education and fiction

There is no doubt that the layers of truth carry deep psychological knowledge within them, and although it is a major flaw in the modern trend of fiction writing that keeps the human heart engaged in a kind of aimless fantasy, it must still be said that fiction is a portrait of those interesting stories of life that are full of flavor and lessons, because the light of truth sometimes shines in such a narrow space of imagination that a person cannot separate it from himself in any way. When a person with a pen in hand puts his thoughts on paper, he tries to fulfill human desires with the help of those words that he has seen with closed eyes in dreams and has used in every step taken to gain knowledge and wisdom in the field of life. So, in this context, fiction is a bridge that leads a person to the highest levels of intellectual development.
3198.left: In addition to this, it must be said that if a story is about a subject that finds a place in people's hearts in the form of true knowledge and experience, then it can become the greatest tool for the progress of society, because the human mind is very quickly influenced by hearing and reading stories, and this plays a major role in the development of their thinking. When we look at the stories of past times, it appears to us that the images of various aspects of life have been drawn in them with great precision. This is not only a means of passing time, but also a foundation for the development of human knowledge and insight. In the end, we must say that the writing of fiction has the status of an art, in which the choice of every sentence and every word reveals the depth of the author's thought.

3199.right:
In previous issues, we published a short article regarding good and evil, and in its continuation, we have presented a series of further points in the path of affirming good and negating evil, in light of other indications emphasized from the perspective of rational and transmitted sciences regarding these two contradictory forces of good and evil.

It seems that throughout human history, there have been many discussions among philosophers, sages, and religious scholars regarding these two contradictory forces; some of them believe that from the very beginning, two contradictory forces of good and evil existed in the foundation of the world's structure, which have crystallized in humans over the passage of time.

On the other hand, followers of the school of Islamic mysticism and Sufism believe that the principle of the creation of the universe is based on good, and evil is merely the absence of good. Just as darkness is the absence of light, evil is also a state of distance from good, and humans, by possessing free will, can choose the path of good or evil.

In the history of humanity, many people have passed who have taken steps in the path of goodness and virtue that have lit lamps of light for society. These individuals, who have dedicated themselves to the path of truth and reality, always remain alive in the pages of history.

It is necessary for all of us to strive in spreading good and protect ourselves from evil, so that we may become a cause for the pleasure of God (SWT) and the well-being of society.

The beginning of a great and major event in world history
The beginning of the World War is mentioned in the context of efforts by world powers to divide the world and establish a new world order. On one side, the coalition of England, France, and Russia (Allied Powers), and on the other side, Germany and the Ottoman Caliphate (Central Powers), were engaged in war to divide the world and secure their interests. In this context, discussions have been held regarding the situation of the Islamic world and the weakness of the Ottoman Caliphate. The conspiracies of England and other colonial powers against the Ottoman Caliphate and their efforts to change the map of the world are mentioned. This article presents a historical perspective of its time regarding the atrocities of colonialism, the looting of Muslim lands, and the efforts to create a new political atmosphere on a global scale.

During the First World War, the goal of England and its allies was not only to defeat Germany, but the control of the resources of the Eastern world and the dismantling of the Islamic Caliphate were also among their main plans. The hidden face of their colonial goals is revealed in the British encouragement of the Arab revolt. This article is considered a deep look at the role of the British and other powers in the field of world politics as an important part of historical events, which was presented to readers in the magazine published at that time.
3264.left:
According to the British policy, another part of dividing the world is that they wanted to create differences among the regions of the Middle East, especially among Islamic countries, and destroy their unity. The (Sykes-Picot) agreement between England and France is one of those secrets that played a major role in changing the map of the region. According to this agreement, the Ottoman Caliphate was divided among themselves, and each colonial power made plans to expand its influence in the region.

In this article, there are also references to the resistance of the people of the region and anti-colonial efforts. Although the conditions of that time were very difficult, signs of awakening were still seen among the Muslims. The author believes that the unity of Muslims and the struggle for their rights is the only way against this oppression and aggression of colonialism.

This historical text is a picture of the efforts in 1920, when the intellectuals of that time wanted to raise people's awareness about colonial policies and encourage them to think about their future.

On the path of freedom

After the creation of this section for the knowledge and awakening of the people of our Pakhtunkhwa, the need for a major series for its development was felt. One of its major goals was to awaken the nation and for them to recognize their rights and the enemy's conspiracies. By starting this series, we have performed a great service to our nation, so for this reason, we have taken a step on the path of a great struggle for the unity of our people and the attainment of independence, so that we may free our nation from the colonial grip and show them the way to live a prosperous life. On this path, we are facing many difficult problems, but with God's help and the support of our people, God willing, we will be successful.
3271.left: On this path, we are moving towards a struggle whose result is the building of a new Afghanistan; in this struggle, the participation of every Pashtun brother is essential, wherever they may be in the country, they must participate in this struggle with full courage and love so that the foundation of a bright and free future can be laid for the next generation. Although the path of this struggle is difficult, with the help of God (SWT) and the unity of the people, we will reach the destination of success. Sacrifice for the freedom of one's land is the duty of every Muslim and every Pashtun; this path is the path of truth, and the path of truth never fails. We hope that this small step of ours will become a cause for the awakening of the entire nation and play its role in the prosperity of our homeland.

Flattering foreigners and trusting their words can be the cause of our nation's destruction. So, let us once again work for the prosperity of Afghanistan through our unity and make our homeland shine on the world stage.

A question letter to Daki Baba

Babaji! First Issue

Friends, it is known that a thief does not refrain from trying. So, if we do not strive in the path of truth against oppression and tyranny in the affairs of life, we will lose our honor and rights.

You must be well aware of the theft and calamity that has befallen us. Some of you have thought that, like other forces and oppression from the court, others will not commit acts of oppression. But this thought and thinking of yours is wrong. Do not tie anyone else's hands and feet to yourself, and do not be happy thinking that you have done a favor to someone. Oppression against people is not always the same. If someone oppresses you today, tomorrow they will burn in the fire of oppression against someone else. So, in this path, join hands with everyone through your own hard work, because there is only one way to end oppression, and that is unity.

Today and tomorrow, it is the demand of the people that I teach you the lesson of independence and unity. Remember this: the honor and dignity of every nation in the world has been raised because of their independence and unity. Those who are bound in the chains of slavery live like animals. So, instead of living in slavery, it is better to sacrifice for your life and honor.

I tell you to also understand that a king of this land, whoever he may be, will demand much from you in protecting your rights and the nation. Therefore, this means that every citizen of the country has a right, but there are also people among them who are involved in these oppressions just like others. Instead of the honor and dignity of their nation, they look at their own interests and gains. So, to protect the independence and honor of the nation's citizens, you must join hands in unity and fight to obtain your rights against every kind of oppressor. For there to be peace and prosperity in the country in the future, you must take steps in unity for the honor of yourself and your homeland and raise your voice for your rights against the oppression of the oppressor.

3309.right:
Appreciation Letter

In the name of Mahatma Gandhi, the honorary president of the Indian National Congress and leader of the national movement

Mr. Gandhi! Ever since our freedom movement has taken steps toward unity and coordination with India's freedom movement, we have been supporters of every step on this great path to independence. In the solidarity between the Muslims of India and the freedom fighters, we see signs of the defeat of colonialism. In the light of your leadership, India has emerged as a force capable of shaking the foundations of the world's colonial powers. This letter of appreciation from our nation's leaders is intended to express our full sympathy with India's independence movement. We consider the freedom of India an essential step for the stability of our region and the restoration of the rights of the people. May God lead the Indian nation to its goals under your leadership.
3309.left: In this section, we appreciate the efforts that have been made for unity between the Muslims and the Hindu nation of India. The anti-colonial struggle is the common goal of all, and in this path, we value your sincerity and sacrifice. We believe that the sun of India's freedom will shine very soon and will be a message of awakening for all Asian nations. With respect, from the supporter of your struggle, the center of the Indian freedom seekers' movement.

In order to break the firm and bloody grip of British colonialism, after many efforts and endeavors to form a joint front with this powerful national party of India (Congress) and to create a true arm against the enemy of these oppressed people for the national liberation politics of the people of India, in search of a new style of policy with the participation of the Indian National Congress for the start of national politics by the educated and conscious class of the people of Pashtunkhwa, when a special national struggle was launched by the Congress against the British government in India for the freedom of the people of India, in the course of these struggles for their success and to raise the demands and voice of the Indian and Pashtun nations, national uprisings of the people began across India for the attainment of independence in the course of reforms against the British government; despite the British government's suppression of atrocities and their very harsh hostile behavior toward the people, the Pashtun nation's demand for independence and the thirst of the people of Pashtunkhwa for freedom to end the British government's rule and establish their own specific national government was greater than ever before.

3323.right: In previous issues, I had received very interesting writings by Pashtun youth about Islamic history in a very good manner, but as a Muslim, I had a very necessary task along with other Muslims of India, in which I had dedicated myself from beginning to end to this history of Hindus and Muslims; however, in this, I wrote this one part in such a way that I could write my own specific view regarding the history of Indian Muslims, but for the people of Pashtunkhwa, this is a very great and important service regarding Indian Muslims, and it is a historical fact that at the time of the spread of Islam in India, a belief emerged among Muslims against the beliefs of Hindus that had a very great effect on the preaching of the religion of Islam among the Hindus; however, among the Indian Muslims, regarding the effects that Hindus had on Islam, they showed themselves in such a way as if they were working very rapidly on the preaching of the religion of Islam, but in reality, at the time of the spread of Islam among the Hindus, there were also many such people among the Muslims who, in order to do such things among themselves, had many such people who would work together with the Hindus in this, and in this, they would do many such things regarding the preaching of their religion that brought about very great changes regarding the preaching of the religion of Islam.
3323.left: Thus, when the foundation stone of Islamic rule was laid in India, a new environment was created between Hindus and Muslims in which a new chapter of cultural and social relations was opened between the two nations. Although these relations were sometimes subject to tension, the efforts of scholars and Sufis to bring them closer proved to be very important in the history of this region. It was these scholars and Sufis who spread the message of unity and brotherhood among Hindus and Muslims, and in this way, they paved the way for tolerance and understanding instead of hostility between Hindus and Muslims. Therefore, we can say that the history of Indian Muslims is not just a mention of wars, but it also contains those brilliant achievements of science, art, and mutual respect, the greatest lesson of which for today is the lesson of tolerance and unity.

3329.right: The first point of England's enmity in India is that the empire of India is in the hands of the British, but due to their oppression and the existence of their rule, the hearts of the people in India are filled against them. They are striving to gain their freedom and save themselves from the clutches of British colonialism. Furthermore, the people's hatred regarding England's actions in India and the start of national movements to end their rule indicate that England's reign in this region is heading toward decline. These movements are not only for political changes but also for the preservation of religious and cultural identity. The unity between India's Muslims and Hindus is a major threat to the British, because by dividing them, the British had maintained their power, but now the people have realized who their true enemy is and how they can fight for their rights.
3329.left: The uprising of the people of India is a reaction against the colonial policies of the British. Wherever there are signs of British rule, voices of public dissatisfaction are heard. Alongside this, the reaction of Afghans regarding British interference and their colonial policies in Afghanistan is also an important part of history. The British have always tried to interfere in the affairs of the region and increase their influence, but the sacrifices of the Afghans and their spirit of seeking freedom have remained a major obstacle to these sinister goals of the British. This article reveals the truths written in the pages of history regarding British colonialism and shows how the people of India and Afghanistan have struggled for a common goal to eliminate British rule.
