3343.right:
Pashtun
First Issue 1920
An important and necessary address!

O my brothers and sisters of the homeland! Listen to these few lines of mine from the depths of my heart with the ears of your heart and reflect upon them.

Today, we are in such a dark shadow of slavery that in this darkness, we have no path to walk on our own feet. The sword of British oppression hangs over our heads, and no sign of independence is visible in our homeland. Many nations have passed on the face of the earth who were in such darkness, but through their unity, their courage, and by standing firmly on their faith, they ended these shadows and once again became worthy of living in the light of independence.

Today, as I address you, it is based on the love for my homeland and the painful feelings of my heart. This is the voice of my heart that a lamp of independence should be lit in the heart of every Pashtun that will never be extinguished again. The blood that flowed in the veins of our ancestors was the blood of freedom. They wrote the history of independence with their swords, and today it is our duty to keep their history alive.
3343.left:
There is no place for slavery in our religion. Islam teaches us the lesson of freedom and winning our own rights. Today, the demand of the time is that we must equip ourselves with the weapon of education and knowledge, because independence is not possible without knowledge. Knowledge is a light that breaks every kind of chain of slavery.

Youth of my homeland! You must move forward in the field of knowledge for the progress of your country. End the discord among yourselves and work for one goal as a single Pashtun. Read your history and value your national identity.

In the end, I say to you all that let us join hands in unity and struggle to build such a Pakhtunkhwa where the head of every Pashtun is held high. May God grant us all the ability to recognize our rights and put blessings in our unity.

Your brother

3344.right:
Editorial: We are publishing this article by "Abdul Hai Habibi," which is from a 1920 magazine, for the benefit of our readers. We have taken this action at the request of many individuals. We know that this is a great treasure for Pashto literature, as it shows the level of the language and the author's thought at that time. By publishing this article, we want to familiarize the new generation with their history and literature.

Abdul Hai Habibi

This is the thirst of a youth that was searching for literature with great passion. At that time, we were in many endeavors to find ways to spread education and knowledge. The social conditions of that time were such that many paths were closed for a young person. As someone who always had the passion to serve the homeland in my heart, I understood the difficulties of this path. With great love, we started efforts for the development of the Pashto language to awaken our people. Our goal was that this language should not remain only a spoken language, but also find its place in the field of pen and literature.
3344.left: In the end, due to the efforts of the scholars of this society, we were able to take a step forward in this field. This was a great achievement that was considered a miracle under the conditions of that time. The youth showed great interest in writing Pashto, and this in itself became the reason for us to become even more motivated. The names of those who made sacrifices in this path will never be forgotten. This was the work of patriots, which is recorded in golden letters on the pages of history. We hope that it will remain as a torch for the future generation so that they may protect their language and literature.

3345.right:
First Issue                                                    August 1920

Peshawar

O thousands of thousands of people of India!

What shall we do? What shall we do? What shall we do?

In the series of the cry of the tormented soul of the Pashtun!

In the series of the cry of the tormented heart of Pashtunkhwa!

In the series of the martyrdom of the youth of my homeland!
In the series of the drops of the heart's blood!

Recently, I saw something in Pashto newspapers and magazines that struck my heart with blows of sorrow. Why have the brave youth of my homeland, who drank the cups of red blood to attain independence and recorded feats of bravery in the pages of history, become so misguided today? Why have the heroes of my land, who stood like mountains against the tyranny of the British, become entangled in the conspiracies of outsiders today?

O youth of Pashtunkhwa! You are the nation that has never bowed its head throughout history. Your ancestors made such sacrifices for freedom that the world praises them today. Have you forgotten that the honor of this land was preserved by your blood? Was the path of your education and consciousness meant for you to submit to the slavery of outsiders today?

My cry is to those youth who have held the flag of Pashtun honor and pride in their hands. Wake up! Know yourselves! Work for the prosperity and well-being of this land with your own hands. With unity and solidarity, stop those seditions that have been created to divide you. If you are negligent today, then tomorrow regret will be your share and history will never forgive you. Let us once again adopt the path of independence and progress in the light of the glorious history of our ancestors.

First, the editorial

We can say with certainty that this day is a day of great happiness for Pashto, because our national leaders have long had the hope that for the development of a common language for Pashtuns and the spread of knowledge, we should have a center, and through this center, we can reach all our national and scientific goals, and serve all our Pashtun brothers through this language. And today, by the grace of God, this long-held hope of ours has reached the stage of completion, and by laying the foundation of this center, we have taken steps for a goal without which the progress and happiness of any nation is impossible, and by laying the foundation of this center, we have placed our steps on the path of sincerity for such unity.

Now we call upon all our Pashtun brothers, especially those who have stepped into the field of science, to provide their full support in making this center successful, and for this national purpose, they should not hesitate to serve in any way through their pens and by awakening their Pashtun brothers through their pens, and they should put all their efforts into this national work, because the progress and happiness of our entire nation is hidden in the success of this center, and it is the duty and obligation of every Pashtun to participate in it according to their ability, to cooperate in every way for the development of this center, and to make their efforts for the unity of this center.

We can say with great confidence that if all our Pashtun brothers join their steps in this national work, then in a very short time we will be able to provide great services to our nation through this center, and through this center our national unity will be further strengthened, and for our future generation, a foundation of science and knowledge will be laid from which our future generation will benefit greatly, and through this center, much work will be done for the development of our language and literature, and the doors of this center will always be open for new writings and new literature of our language, and for everyone who wants to serve in this field, the opportunity to spread their knowledge and literature will be provided through this center, and in this way, the path for the development of our language will be paved, and we will raise our heads high among other nations of the world, and after this first step, we will take even bigger steps, and by the grace of God, we will be successful in the path of this national work.

In the end, we thank from the bottom of our hearts all those who have helped with their hearts in laying the foundation of this center, and we pray to Almighty God for their reward and merit, and we hope that they will continue their support in the development of this national center in the future, and for this work, they will spread the message of unity and agreement among all their Pashtun brothers, and they will offer their prayers in the court of Almighty God for the success of this center, and we pray to Almighty God for the glory of this center, and in the end, we pray for the success of all and ask for the strength to remain steadfast in our work.

At that time, in a house in the middle of Kabul city, there lived a widow who had a young son who was very capable in life's affairs; he would strive hard to serve his mother and provide for himself. In Kabul, there was also another young man at that time who was famous in society due to his special rank and status; his name was on everyone's lips, and his actions were also spoken of favorably.
One day, this young man saw the widow's son while he was busy working; he was very impressed by his work and his character, and he befriended him.
The foundation of a pure friendship was laid between the two, and they would participate in each other's sorrows and joys.
In the difficult circumstances of life, they would help one another and would consult each other in every matter.
At that time, a change occurred in the country's situation, and a new chapter began in everyone's life.
But these two friends maintained the sincerity of their friendship and remained by each other's side in all kinds of conditions.
In the history of that time, this friendship of theirs remained as an example.
This story teaches us that true friendship is higher than any kind of material gain, and the role of a loyal friend in the life of a good person is very important.

With the passage of time, their friendship became even stronger and set a good example for a larger society.
Today, if we look at their lives, we see how they found a place in the hearts of society through their morals.
The story of their lives serves as a guide for everyone who is looking for success in life.
In the end, we must say that their actions have remained recorded in the pages of history forever and will be a source of lesson and inspiration for generations.
In every stage of life, their sincerity and integrity are worthy of praise, and we too must learn a lesson from their lives.

Question:- If a person makes an intention to fast for the month of Ramadan in one month, and then another month comes within that same month in which he also makes an intention to fast, are these intentions valid or not?
Answer:- The intention to fast for the month of Ramadan is valid in every month, but if the intention for another month's fast is made at a time when the intention for the month of Ramadan has already been made, then all these intentions are valid, because the fast of each month is a specific act of worship for that month and every act of worship requires its own specific intention.
Question:- If someone makes an intention to fast during the month of Ramadan and then later changes their intention during the month of Ramadan, what will be the status of their fast?
Answer:- The intention to fast during the month of Ramadan is valid by making it once, and if someone changes their intention, it has no effect on their fast, because the intention for the fast is sufficient at the beginning of the month.

In the early days of the reign of Afghan King Mohammad Nadir Khan in 1338 AH, it was decided during a gathering of several literate people in Kabul city to launch a weekly publication named (Afghan). Whenever reasons for some disagreements arose between government officials and those responsible for this publication, a ban was imposed on the publication of this weekly by the government authorities.
First: The reason for the closure of the publication was that reports were published by the publication's staff regarding the corruption of certain government officials and the appointment of incompetent individuals across the country, which were not in the interest of the government officials of the time. For this reason, the government of the time decided to close the publication to prevent its distribution.
Second: Another reason behind the arrest of the publication's officials and the harsh measures taken against them was that reports were published by the publication's staff reflecting the problems and complaints of the people in various regions of the country, which caused dissatisfaction and reactions among the people against the government's rule. This was why the government officials issued an order to stop the activities of this publication, which led to the arrest of the publication's officials. Thus, the activity of this publication was stopped at a sensitive time when people were looking for true information about their country, but with the measures taken by the government, the voice of this publication was completely silenced.

3490.right:
Appeal

It has been the rule of all the nations of the world that whenever special circumstances have arisen in a nation, country, or homeland, everyone has felt the delicacy of the time according to those circumstances. They have left their own work and have prioritized collective national work. When we reflect on the conditions of our country, it becomes clear that we are facing a matter of life and death in such a strange era for this country. I say to the whole nation generally, and to the national workers specifically, that you should feel the delicacy of the time and gather at one center to build the future of your nation. It is a matter of great regret that our workers are still busy with disputes and bickering, and in the struggle, one idea or another is being debated. It should be remembered that nations have always progressed when a group of selfless people has emerged among them who serve their nation solely for the sake of God. It is my firm belief that the severe hardship we are facing is only because we have cast aside all common interests and benefits in order to pursue our own selfish interests. I have decided that after Ramadan, I will gather all the workers at the center, consult with them, and then we will begin collective work. Therefore, those who wish to work with me at the center should send me their names during Ramadan.

(Abdul Ghaffar)

3508.right:
First page



The first message of the Islamic world

Armi year 1920, corresponding to the first of Shawwal al-Mukarram

Pashtunor published the "First Message" through the national sentiment of Pashtunkhwa and the pens of its brave youth. This message is the voice of the hearts of all Muslims of the world, especially the Muslims of India, which they have raised against British imperialism. This message is to expose the atrocities of colonialism and their ruthless actions, so that the world may know that the Muslims of India are not only fighting for independence, but are also committed to the unity and honor of the Islamic world.

In this message, light has been shed on many points: First, the sufferings of the Muslims of India and the series of atrocities against them, which have now reached their limit. Second, the declaration of support by the Muslims of India regarding the independence of Afghanistan. We believe that the independence of Afghanistan is the path to success and honor for all Muslims. Third, support for the Khilafat movement and readiness to make any sacrifice in this path.

We clearly state that this message of ours is not at anyone's direction, but is our own decision for independence and national interests. We will not remain silent in the face of these atrocities by the British government, but will continue the struggle for our rights. The voice of the hearts of the Muslims of India is that they must unite to achieve independence. Our goal is not only to break the chains of colonialism, but also to fight for the unity of the Islamic world. This message is the interpreter of the aspirations of the Muslims of India, and we will fight until we have achieved our independence.

3509.right: We have no answer regarding the Afghans' demand to obtain the right to vote, which they had made to the Indian government in this regard to secure their rights; however, if something is to be said about this action of the Indian government, it would be: what policy did the Indian government adopt regarding Afghans after the establishment of this new system of the Afghan government? For example: regarding the issue of the borders and what they have done concerning the rights of our nation, when we examine this matter, we have nothing but regret regarding the policy that the Indian government adopted on the issue of Afghanistan's borders, because this government was in conflict with the interests of the people of Afghanistan for the sake of its own interests, and it did not refrain from any kind of effort for its own benefit. Now, when we think about the current policy of the Indian government regarding this issue, a new path comes before us, and before thinking about this new path in any way, signs of doubt and suspicion are seen regarding the Indian government's policy toward Afghans, and if one were to ask about the current efforts of the Indian government to resolve this issue, we must say that this matter should be discussed with the officials of the Indian government, because no specific or credible step has been taken by the Indian government officials to resolve this issue, nor is there any sign visible regarding the Indian government's policy on this matter in light of which it could be said that the Indian government has achieved any success in this path.
3509.left: In conclusion, regarding how the Indian government has treated the interests of the Afghan nation concerning the issue of Afghanistan's borders, it must be said that the Indian government, in accordance with its colonial policy, has always tried to sow discord among Afghans and prevent their unity. This policy led to an atmosphere of mistrust between the people of the two countries, and as a result of this discord, the Indian government's approach toward the people of Afghanistan turned into a situation that was unacceptable to the people. Because the Indian government was seeking its own colonial interests, it never viewed the border issue through the lens of justice and fairness, and it always attempted to interfere in Afghanistan's internal affairs under one pretext or another. This action has caused the anger of Afghans, and the reaction of Afghans to this type of policy by the Indian government demonstrates that the Afghan nation will never submit to this type of colonial policy of the Indian government. They will fight to the last limit to protect the territorial integrity and independence of their country, and they will not shy away from any sacrifice in the path of this struggle. This type of unjust policy by the Indian government has caused an atmosphere of hatred and resentment to prevail instead of the establishment of friendly relations between the two neighboring countries, and to eliminate this atmosphere, the Indian government must change its policy and respect the rights of the Afghan nation.

3510.right:
Which is the path to liberation from the claws of colonial oppression, the series of sacrifices by many patriotic Muslims continues on this path.

[Towards Freedom]

Question: What is the ruling regarding women's education from the perspective of Islam? Do women have the right to education in Islam or not?
Answer: From the perspective of the blessed religion of Islam, seeking knowledge is mandatory for every Muslim man and woman. There is no restriction in Islam regarding women's education; rather, in numerous Hadiths and Prophetic instructions, emphasis has been placed on seeking knowledge. The great Prophet of Islam, Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH), has stated that the pursuit of knowledge is incumbent upon every Muslim. Therefore, the right of women to education is protected in Islam, and no one can deprive them of this right. In the early days of Islam, there were many women who achieved great feats in the field of knowledge and contributed to the progress of society.
Question: What is the concept of social justice from the perspective of Islam?
Answer: The concept of social justice in Islam is very broad. Justice is one of the important pillars of Islam. Allah Almighty has commanded justice in the Holy Quran. Justice is not only in the court, but it is necessary to establish justice in all matters, from the framework of the family to society. Islam is against class discrimination and emphasizes equality among all human beings. In Islamic law, there is no difference between the ruler and the ruled. Whoever has a right, it must be given to them, and no one's right should be violated.
3514.left:
Question: What is your opinion regarding civilization?
Answer: Civilization is a stage in which a nation progresses in the fields of science, art, technology, and ethics. Civilization is not just material progress, but also moral elevation. Islam also supports civilization and encourages people toward science, thought, and innovation. A civilization that is beneficial for humanity and helps in maintaining the boundaries of ethics and humanity is, from the perspective of Islam, worthy of praise.
Question: What is your message regarding today's world?
Answer: My message to the people of the world is to choose peace and brotherhood. Today's world is burning in the fire of conflicts and miseries. The only way to emerge from these crises is to understand each other's rights, respect others, and adopt just policies. Islam is a religion of peace and emphasizes love and cooperation among humans. It is hoped that the future of the world will be bright based on justice and ethics.

When this news was published in the newspapers, many discussions began regarding its authenticity. This matter was on everyone's lips, and everyone was commenting according to their own opinion, because it was a major threat to the country's security. This was not a matter that could be easily ignored; rather, it was a cause for concern for every informed person and well-wisher of the country.
At this time, media officials and opinion leaders presented their respective views on this subject. Some said it was a conspiracy, and others said it was a sign of the government's weakness. But in reality, this matter was much deeper than what could be summarized in just a few sentences.
In light of this, a kind of distrust emerged among the people, because the distance between the government and the public was increasing day by day. This distrust caused people to become victims of disagreement among themselves as well. Many people formed their own groups in their areas to protect themselves, which led to even more chaos.
In these circumstances, in order to maintain the unity of the country, there was a need to work on a strategy that all people could rally behind, but unfortunately, no one was found to shoulder this heavy burden.

This threat caused him to be forced to leave the village for some time.
The situation in the village is deteriorating day by day, and hatred among the people toward one another is increasing. Those who used to live together in brotherhood are now caught up in enmity and malice. The cause of this situation is not only political differences, but the weakening of cultural and social relations has also contributed to it.
In my opinion, if we want to change this situation, we must have tolerance for one another and solve our problems through dialogue. A society can never be built through force and coercion alone. It is necessary for the village elders to gather and find a permanent solution to this problem; otherwise, this fire will consume the entire village in its flames, and then there will be no time left for regret.

In this series, a decision made by a judge of the Republic's judiciary was declared contrary to the judge's decision by the Kabul Ministry of Justice, and they declared the judge's decision null and void. In this decision, the Kabul Ministry of Justice stated that the judge had not made the decision based on Sharia and had acted against the country's laws. By issuing this order, the Kabul Ministry of Justice ordered the formation of another court and appointed a team of new judges to re-examine the case. The new judges' decision regarding the case was very different from the previous decision and was in accordance with the country's laws.

Regarding this incident, the Kabul Ministry of Justice, by issuing a statement to inform the public, stated that in all courts of the country, judges' decisions must be based on Sharia and law, and no judge has the right to make a decision based on their own will. At the end of this order, the Kabul Ministry of Justice issued a new guideline for all judges, stating that they must act in accordance with the country's laws and Sharia principles for court decisions.

In this guideline, it was stated that every judge must be very careful in performing their duties and use all their efforts to protect the rights of the country's people. Also, at the end of this guideline, it was stated that if any judge makes a decision contrary to the country's laws and Sharia principles, strict legal steps will be taken against them.
3519.left:
This action by the country's Ministry of Justice became a cause for public joy and greatly helped in increasing trust regarding justice among the people. Furthermore, through this action, the rights of the people were protected within the framework of the country's laws, and a major step was taken in the establishment of justice.

By observing the people's reactions regarding the case, the Ministry of Justice was able to begin a new phase in the establishment of justice and create a new sense of trust among the people for the provision of justice. Furthermore, through this action, the Kabul Ministry of Justice created a new model for the provision of justice in other regions of the country and took steps toward initiating a new policy for the establishment of justice and fairness in all courts.

In conclusion, the Kabul Ministry of Justice, in order to remove the people's doubts, stated once again in its announcement that justice is the most essential element for the country's progress and that without justice, no country can progress. At the end of this announcement, the Kabul Ministry of Justice requested the people to cooperate with the country's government for the establishment of justice and to play their part in implementing the country's laws and the principles of Sharia. As a result of this cooperation, the path was paved for strengthening the country's judicial system, and a new phase began for the protection of the people's rights.

In the economic dealings of the Ghilji people, it was like this:

At this stage, the goods of all merchants on the trade routes that entered Afghanistan through the Ghilji region—and the routes coming to Afghanistan from India—were in the hands of the British government due to the Afghan government's control over these routes. According to the laws of this government, taxes were collected from every merchant in proportion to the value of their goods. This tax was collected through agents appointed by the British government, who would deposit all this money into the Indian government treasury for the benefit of the British. In return, they had not taken any steps or made any arrangements for the security of the tribes in that region. While these tribes had been deprived of any kind of assistance from the British government for living in this region since ancient times, they had made their own arrangements for their survival and the security of their region, in which the British government did not interfere. However, these injustices and unfair actions by the British regarding the lives of these tribes became the cause of their awakening. The leaders of these tribes decided to put an end to this British influence and contacted the Afghan government regarding this issue. The Afghan government supported their decision and gave them permission to stop all these illegal activities that the British were carrying out in their region and collecting money for their own government. All these unfair efforts of the British government were brought to a complete halt. With the departure of those British, a new phase began for the affairs of the lives of the tribes in these regions and for their independence, and these tribes were saved from the colonial clutches of the British.

His poetry holds a very high position in the history of Pashto literature. In his poetry, there are concepts that find their way into people's hearts in every era.

One of the important aspects of Rahman Baba's poetry is the simplicity and fluency of his words. The power and influence in his words are the result of his sincerity and love for God. Rahman Baba's poems are not only a great treasure for Pashto literature, but they are also very worthy of appreciation for ethics and humanity.

In Rahman Baba's poems, an image of a poet is presented who was faced with the social and moral problems of his time. From his poems, it appears that he had a great interest in the reform of society. Another aspect of Rahman Baba's work is his spirit of humanism, in which every verse speaks about the value and dignity of human beings.

One of the characteristics of Rahman Baba's poetry is that he has expressed very deep concepts with great simplicity. In his poems, there are lessons of love, loyalty, and submission to the path of God. In the field of Pashto literature, Rahman Baba is a name that will always be remembered with respect. Further research about his life is very necessary for Pashto literature.

3538.right:
Editorial

Laar School

After three consecutive political bans, the magazine "Laar," belonging to the entire Pashtun nation, has been resumed. The outline presented here, reflecting its specific vision and efforts to create a "path" (Laar) for democracy, cannot be changed by any power in the world. When "Laar" was previously refused printing by the public press "Khabantan," the question arose in many circles: what is the reason that while other separate magazines and newspapers are being printed in the printing house, why are such major obstacles being placed in the way of printing "Laar" for the nation? This was a thought that stirred concerns, worries, and doubts in the hearts of the party and all Pashtuns. We, at the house of Bacha Khan, through efforts and in the right direction, believe that in the direction of the new Pakistan, along with the small political, cultural, and civil rights of the Pashtun nation, their guaranteed rights will also be established.

From this sentence, we, personally, along with other Pashto scholars and well-wishers, sent thousands of letters of protest and grievance to the government regarding the banning of the only Pashto magazine, "Laar," and the reasoning behind it?
Hidden in sales and in Lahore, we toured the bungalows of all the elites, and in the end, we were told that "Laar" is a dangerous magazine, so the administration and the name should be abandoned. We were bewildered and confused that...

3539.right:
What is so "dangerous" about the "Lar" magazine that it has become a thorn in the side of the Pashtuns? If those in power are upset that "Lar" acts as a voice for the feelings and sentiments of the Pashtuns, then this is no crime. And if the rulers' objection is regarding the form in which "Lar" chooses to publish its articles and poems, then we cannot provide a remedy, because we do not send this magazine abroad ourselves, nor does any foreigner come to us to buy "Lar." This is a common item for the public; anyone who wishes can buy it. And if someone suspects that "Lar," like others, does not necessarily advocate for government regulations and their agendas—which is contrary to public and democratic sentiments—then the answer is that this is our democratic right and our own choice.

So, just as we faced a three-month delay and restriction on the press, which is a matter that happens to every newspaper and magazine, despite these few issues, we are grateful that the Information Department of Tribal Pakistan approved the request for the "Lar" press. And now "Lar" has been resumed to reach the destination of the Pashtun caravan. We express our gratitude to Sardar Abdur Rashid Khan, the Federal Minister of Information, and all other individuals who helped us in reopening "Lar."

It is true that all those circumstances that had arisen in the hearts of the people some time ago, and now if those lies and evils had not been created from the first day, the readers of "Lar" would not have been deprived for three months.

In the end, we also thank all those well-wishers who exerted pressure on the government to resume "Lar" and sent their support.

For the readers of the sorrowful news:-
A few days ago in Lahore, the Pashtun party, the Khudai Khidmatgar, merged with the "National Party," and in the opinion of many, this is such a great merger that no power in the world can stop it or break it.

3540.right:

It seems that this mark, which until now remained with Bacha Khan and every Pashtun, has also been fulfilled by the movements of the Sindhis, Baloch, and Punjabis. This pain has increased for us Pashtuns due to our own actions. This number is as Khushal Khattak said; with the help of our own intentions, until yesterday we considered Punjab a country, and today a very large group of Pakistan, especially Punjab, remains an independent Pakistan. We are supporters; Bacha Khan and his fellow companions spent their lives for the eternal life of the Pashtuns, and their blood has been shed. And how can it be that this blood goes to waste, and such a nation is taken that we move backward instead of forward? Pashtuns will not rest in Bacha Khan's path until they reach their goal and aspiration, and in this regard, they have always expressed their concerns.

When Aristotle, the father of literary criticism, said that art is imitation, he did not mean that the status of an artist is merely that of a camera, which captures whatever it sees or whatever it prides itself on. This critical sense expresses itself in these ways, in color and form, and this is why all art and literary criticism revolve around these two methods of color and form. This color and form is what Aristotle calls "formalism," and this same color and form is what Plato refers to as useless and baseless. In such methods of color and form, there is the aforementioned excess of good, which is what we call the purpose of art. Now, we must see whether purpose is necessary for art or not, and we will discuss it. For Aristotle, we will once again go to Aristotle's definition of art, and we will discuss it. Art, rather, as I have stated, is that quality of human imagination and emotions, used for the expression of a specific truth or impression and to convey the intensity of the effect of this quality onto the audience; just as my God is a means and a medium, so too is this art a medium for expressing a purpose in an organized manner. That art is not the purpose but merely a means or tool, and now the question is for what purpose should this tool be used, meaning what is the purpose of art, or what should it be?
Aristophanes, the famous Greek [playwright] and later in his own method of training, in "The Frogs," asks this question through the character of the high [god] to "Euripides."
"Right. Tell me on what grounds a great poet is worthy of praise; in Greek criticism, this question and its answer hold great importance, because consciously, Euripides reveals the importance of the poet," says Euripides.

3551.left:
According to the theory of Euripides, the purpose of art is to improve the people, which provides great help to the nation. In the light of this theory, Plato has criticized poets, because he says that whenever poets cannot fulfill this purpose, they are not worthy of living in his state.
After Plato, Longinus discussed the purpose of art. He says that an artist is not a preacher who gives sermons to the people; the purpose of art is only beauty and the happiness obtained after revealing it. Longinus has turned Plato's purpose around. Aristotle, a student of Plato, disagrees with his teacher; he has added the principle of happiness or pleasure to these discussions and calls this the purpose of art. He considers the theories of Longinus and Plato to be bitter medicine, and says that to achieve Plato's purpose, Longinus's principles are very necessary. After them, in every era, critics have created debates among themselves due to their connection with these things. John Ruskin, Oscar Wilde, and in the modern era, T.S. Eliot are three great critics of these theories. The Roman period is connected to the Platonic-Aristotelian school, and the later period is connected to Longinus's ideas.
Marxist-Leninist criticism is the evolutionary form of Euripides' criticism. Marx and Lenin consider art to be for the masses and count the revolution and the establishment and consolidation of a classless society as its purpose. This is also the same "improving the people" that Euripides considers the purpose of art.

However, Marx and Lenin have added to this that they do not accept the spontaneous artist as a preacher of goodness in good things or good deeds, but rather consider it a necessary means for the propagation of collective goodness. Moreover, Euripides lacked class consciousness, or rather, at that time, there was no war between classes, as Marx and Lenin state in their discourse regarding the capitalist and feudal society of the bourgeoisie and the proletariat, where there was a war between different classes, and it still exists. The foundation of Marxist-Leninist criticism is on class consciousness. In the light of this criticism, the purpose of art has been determined as to how the means of art can be used to awaken the oppressed class.

However, reading this book makes it seem as if this example of poetry was also hidden in the chest like a precious gem, and this new literature of the new era that is on its way can very easily be compared with this ancient poetry.

This is a new face of Pashto poetry, while the value of such works in the love of new Pashto literature is very high. Every sentence, every verse, and every poem collected in this book represents the deep thought of a knowledge that we can see even with closed eyes. This book contains features that open a new page in the history of Pashto literature, and everyone who loves literature should have this source of knowledge in their library.
3604.left:
As much as there are words of knowledge and wisdom in this, it is a great house of advice and lessons for every rational and intelligent person.

The manuscripts that have been discovered by Pashto literature scholars recently show that the scope of Pashto literature is very vast. The discussions in this book regarding the conditions of that era and the thoughts and opinions of the people of that time further increase the value of this book. There is no doubt that our past writers and poets were very familiar with the social conditions and life's problems of their time and have left deep traces of this in their works.

This book is in fact a treasure that can prove to be very useful for scholars of Pashto literature. The printing and publication of this book is a major step in the service of Pashto literature, which we must appreciate and strive to promote.

In the end, we thank the publisher of this book for performing this great service to literature, and we hope that they will continue this series in the same way.

3605.right: Finally, by the grace of God and His help, this magazine came out of the press and reached the hands of friends. I had a great desire in my heart to use the thoughts of scholars and the writings of authors for the publication of the first issue of this magazine, but unfortunately, due to a number of reasons that I had, I was forced to write it myself for the first time and use my own effort so that it could reach my countrymen. However, despite all these difficulties, I tried my best to use scientific, literary, and historical materials in it so that it would be useful for our readers. I know that this is the first step and it may have many shortcomings, but I hope that my respected readers will appreciate this small service of mine, and in future issues, I will be able to use the writings of other scholars and writers so that this magazine becomes even richer and more useful for the readers.
3605.left: As I have stepped out for this work like a servant, I hope from those people who are masters of knowledge and the pen, that if they see any shortcomings in this path, they should send their opinions with an open mind for the purpose of reform in my path of service. Because there are difficulties at the beginning of every task and I am not an exception to this rule. I have started this work with the intention of serving my homeland and my people, and I will not hesitate to make any kind of sacrifice in this path. It is hoped that this service of mine will be acceptable to the people, and with their encouragement, I will be able to do more work for my homeland and people and further strengthen my steps in the path of spreading knowledge and light. In the end, I thank all those who have helped me in publishing this magazine, and I hope that I will continue to benefit from their support in the future so that we can move this path forward properly and become capable of serving our homeland.

3606.right: In the end, amidst the intensity of the rain, that young girl tied the buds of fragrant flowers in her shawl and headed towards home in two or three minutes; there were signs of such peace and satisfaction on her face that the signs of hopelessness and sorrow seen at other times were no longer visible. With her shawl, she looked as if she were full of joy like the other village girls, and there was a light of happiness on her face. The flower buds on her head looked like signs of the scent of spring and the hopes and desires of her heart. They shone in her hair like sunbeams in raindrops. This girl, who had been facing her family's problems and the harsh conditions of life, had forgotten her sorrows in this pleasant atmosphere of rain today. A peace had come over her mind that was a sign of the disappearance of every sorrow and pain in her life. When she reached home, her mother was very happy to see her, and a rain of prayers began to fall from her lips; this was the sweetest moment of her life, which was a sign of the end of all her troubles.
3606.left: But in this phase of her youth, there were also signs that she felt that the difficulties and sorrows on the path of life were all part of life's experiences, which were necessary for the growth and strengthening of her personality. When she was lovingly and joyfully watering her flowers in the courtyard of her home, the feeling of happiness and satisfaction in her heart was reflected in the color of each flower. In her mind, there was a picture of the future of life that held the light of hope and happiness, in which signs of progress and success could be seen at every step of her life. In this journey of life, she was not alone, but was living a life in the shadow of her family's love and support that proved to be a remedy for every sorrow and pain, and at every step of her life, the grace and blessing of Allah Almighty accompanied her path, which had made her life like a beautiful and colorful story.

It is necessary that every citizen of the country fulfills their responsibility with full honesty in the implementation and success of these reforms.

3609.right:
In the first place, we mention the new movement for the freedom of Pashtunkhwa, which in reality originates from the great national and freedom-seeking achievements of the late Aman Khan, who at that time strengthened the anti-colonial and freedom-loving spirit in the hearts of Afghans. This movement was not just for one region, but a new message of hope for all of Pashtunkhwa, which removed obstacles on the path to freedom. At that time, the unity of the people against the colonialists and their sacrifices were a golden chapter of history that will never be forgotten. In the light of the late Aman Khan's politics and his thoughts, a great caravan of our nation was moving towards freedom, and this caravan is still in search of its destination.

Furthermore, in this regard, it is necessary to mention those heroes who paid the price for this nation's freedom with their lives. Their sacrifices were not just for them, but they lit a torch for future generations. Their struggle against colonialism was a clear distinction between truth and falsehood, which our history has recorded with pride. We must understand that the path to freedom is not easy, and for this, there is always a need to make sacrifices, just as our ancestors walked this path with great courage.
3609.left:
First (1): Regarding the printing of this publication, it must be said that this is a sign of the beginning of another important era for Pashtunkhwa. The goal of this publication is the awareness of the people and the protection of their national rights, so that people become informed about their rights and raise their voices against the oppressions of colonialism.

Second (2): In the course of publishing this publication, we have tried to highlight the problems and challenges that exist in society. Along with this, efforts are also underway in the field of literature and culture to work for the development of the Pashto language.

Third (3): For the progress of this publication, the cooperation of every patriotic Afghan is necessary. We hope that everyone will help to move this national caravan forward to the best of their ability.

Fourth (4): In this issue, we have mentioned those who have played an important role in the history of Pashtunkhwa. Their lives and paths are an excellent guide for today's youth.

Fifth (5): In the end, we must say that this publication has been printed in response to a national demand. We hope that the support of the people will be the cause of further strengthening this caravan. With God's help, we will defend the rights of our nation until the end of the path of freedom.

Question: What work does this man do for his people?
Answer: This man makes great efforts for his people to provide them with education and brings books and educational materials for them from India.
Question: Why does this man bring books from India for Afghanistan?
Answer: Because in this man's opinion, there is a need for knowledge in Afghanistan, and people should understand knowledge and serve their country.
Question: Is this man happy with his work?
Answer: Yes, this man is very happy with his work and does not feel any kind of fatigue in the path of serving his homeland.
Question: What does this man encourage other people to do?
Answer: This man encourages other people to also strive for knowledge and take steps for the progress of their homeland.
Question: What kind of life does this man live in Afghanistan?
Answer: This man is content with a simple life in Afghanistan and tries to dedicate his entire life to the service of his nation.
Question: How does this man behave with the people of his homeland?
Answer: This man behaves very gently and kindly with the people of his homeland and views them with respect.

In this regard, first and foremost, it is necessary that a scientific center be opened for the progress and development of the Pashto language. The Pashto language is currently passing through a stage where there is a need to uncover its hidden treasures and literature in the field of art and literature, as is the case with many languages of the world. I have discussed this matter very carefully with the people of this place and some Pashto writers, and they are also of the opinion that establishing a Pashto academy in Peshawar is very necessary. With this, not only will Pashto literature develop, but a strong foundation will also be laid for the preservation of Pashtun history and culture. In my opinion, this is a very important and good step by the government, which should be carried forward with full sincerity. I am ready for any kind of cooperation in this regard.
3640.left: In this regard, I must clarify that a specific strategy should be used for the development of the Pashto language, so that Pashto literature can be recognized at an international level. I am convinced that if coordination is established between the government and Pashto scholars, we will very soon see a major change in Pashto literature. Likewise, encouraging new Pashto writers is also very necessary, so that they can work to enrich the Pashto language through their creations. Peshawar is a major center of Pashtun knowledge and literature, and it is the right of this city that such a center for the Pashto language be built here that becomes a source of pride for the Pashtuns.

3649.right:
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

The truth is that the cause of the emergence of war and conflict among the followers of Islam is not disagreement within the holy religion of Islam, but rather the ignorance of Muslims regarding the true facts of the Islamic faith. If Muslims were aware of the truths of their religion, they would always live in an atmosphere of brotherhood and love instead of shedding each other's blood. Because the blessed religion of Islam has brought a message of peace and tranquility for all people and has forbidden all kinds of senseless wars and discord, but the current situation shows that people have moved away from the original teachings of their religion. Due to the lack of knowledge, people have been divided into different groups, and each group thinks that they are on the truth and others are on falsehood, while Islam is a religion of unity. If we want to solve this problem, we must take steps towards knowledge and understanding and, with the help of religious scholars, familiarize ourselves with the true spirit of Islam, so that an atmosphere of peace and brotherhood may once again prevail in the Islamic world. In fact, the cause of all these problems is the incorrect interpretation and explanation of the religion that has been created by some people in different times, and this has caused a distance to arise between the true teachings of Islam and people to stand against each other, while the holy religion of Islam has not allowed violence and the killing of innocent people anywhere, but has recommended justice and fairness in all matters.
3649.left: It is for this reason that today, voices of discord and misery are rising from every side in the Islamic world, and this situation is a cause for concern for those who love the true religion of Islam. We must understand that Islam is a religion of mercy for all and has come to build love and brotherhood among humans, not for division and separation. Anyone who wants to bring change in Islam must first focus on reforming themselves and their society, because reform begins with the individual and then reaches the society. We must align our lives in the light of the Holy Quran and the Seerah of the Prophet (PBUH) and stand firmly against those who choose the path of violence in the name of religion. It is the duty of every Muslim to take a step on the path of truth and reality and not remain silent in the face of falsehood. In conclusion, we must say that the only way for the progress of Islam and the unity of Muslims is the pursuit of knowledge and the acceptance of one another, so that, as in the past, the banner of Islam may once again be raised throughout the world as a symbol of unity and honor, and the love of Islam may become alive and strong in people's hearts, just like its roots. This is a great responsibility placed upon the shoulders of every Muslim, and by fulfilling it, we will achieve success in this world and the hereafter. 3651.right:
Question: When some people say, "The purpose of human creation is the worship of God," what does this mean?
Answer: The purpose of human creation is the worship of God; this statement means that man was created in this world for the recognition of God and for His servitude. If one reflects on this, the holy religion of Islam also emphasizes that human life should be spent in seeking the pleasure of God. Thus, it is necessary for man to observe the commandments of Allah Almighty in all his deeds and to step forward on His path. In the light of Islam, human life is a great trust, which must be kept with complete integrity. The worship of God is not only in performing prayers and fasting, but all those affairs in which there is the pleasure of Allah Almighty are considered worship. For example, acquiring knowledge, helping others, speaking the truth, and making efforts for the progress of society, all these are a part of the worship of God.
In the religion of Islam, the concept of worship is very broad. It is not limited only to places of worship, but establishing justice and fairness in social life also falls under the scope of worship. When a person keeps the fear of God in mind while performing his duties, then every action of his takes the form of worship. In this way, all aspects of human life are connected to worship.
3651.left:
The concept of worship is very essential in human life, because it helps in shaping a person's morals and character. When a person realizes that every action of theirs is under God's observation, they refrain from bad deeds. This is the reason why Islam has assigned a high status to worship in human life. This is not just for an individual, but a fundamental principle for the reform of the entire society. If all humans in the world understand that the purpose of their life is not just materialism, but the pleasure of God, then peace and tranquility will come to the world. From the perspective of Islam, worship is like a light for a person that illuminates the path of their life. In this way, a person becomes closer to their Creator and succeeds in both worlds.
In short, we can say that the purpose of human creation lies in the worship of God, and this worship, in a broad sense, is manifested in implementing the commandments of Allah Almighty and in good treatment of His creation. Whenever a person aligns their life with these principles, they achieve the true purpose of their existence. This is the only way to human success.

3652.right:
In this way, there are very precise and profound reasons for the correspondence and similarity between the compilation of this paragraph and the sermon of the Hazrat (peace be upon him), which a person of precise vision can easily understand. And these reasons are as follows:
1. There is such a unity and union in the concept of these two expressions (the expression of the compilation and the expression of the sermon) that if looked at precisely, it becomes clear that both are complementary and complete to each other.
2. In the use of words, a kind of harmony and uniformity is seen between the two, which indicates the choice of words by a great scholar and jurist.
3. A great deal of similarity is also seen in the method of expressing concepts, for example, the statements of both regarding the creation of man, which complement each other.
In any case, this similarity and correspondence between the compilation and the sermon is an indication that this sermon was spoken by the Hazrat (peace be upon him) himself, and the compiler has also benefited from his knowledge and eloquence.
And the fact that some people doubt the attribution of this sermon is the result of their academic weakness and failure to understand the facts, because such arguments have no validity in the face of historical evidence and the statements of the great scholars of Islam.
In short, this sermon is a living example of the perfection of the Hazrat (peace be upon him) and his high scientific and spiritual status, which shines like a bright lamp in the field of Islamic sciences to this day.
3652.left:
And in this way, this series of academic discussions regarding the compilation of the sermon of the Hazrat (peace be upon him) leads us to the conclusion that this sermon is not only authentic but also a fundamental part of Islamic thought.
The fact that there is talk of the influences of Arabic and other languages in the words of the sermon is itself an indication of how much exchange and interaction existed between languages during the period of the spread of Islam.
And then the eloquence of the Hazrat (peace be upon him) that is evident in this sermon is an excellent proof of the fluency of the Arabs of that time and the loftiness of Islamic knowledge.
In conclusion, we must say that studying the speeches of the Hazrat (peace be upon him) is not only for historical information but is a necessary requirement for self-cultivation and increasing religious insight.
And this balance between the compilation and the sermon, which was the subject of our research, proves that Islamic texts have been compiled according to an organized and coherent system, which has the ability to answer all kinds of doubts and suspicions.
The purpose of this academic effort is only to clarify the facts, so that full confidence and belief regarding the Islamic heritage can be created for the future generation, and this sermon is a golden example for achieving this very goal.

3654.right:
Just as we mentioned the signs of God's power and the truth of the universe in the previous chapters, now in this chapter we will understand how this entire cosmic system is running in an organized manner and what is the wisdom of its Creator in it? First, that nothing has happened by its own will, but has been created by the hand of a great Creator. Every star, every planet, and every particle moves by His command.

The signs of this power are also clearly visible in the human existence. He has organized the structure of the human body, the flow of blood, the heartbeat, and the functioning of the brain in such a way that it is amazing. If we reflect on each of these, we will understand the greatness and wisdom of that great Creator. He has not only created this universe, but has also provided everything according to the need for their survival. The facilities of food and drink for living beings on earth are signs of His mercy.
3654.left:
Likewise, every being in this universe is obligated to work by the special command of God Almighty in search of its place and for the continuation of its life. The growth of trees on earth, the flow of rivers, and the falling of rain are all part of His grand system. If we want to change anything in this entire system, it is not possible, because everything is under a specific law.

The conclusion is that by observing this universe and the creatures within it, man must understand that all of this has one Creator and Owner. He is the One who is the guardian of the order and discipline of this universe. We must follow His commandments in gratitude to Him and reflect on the signs of His power. This is the path of knowledge and wisdom for man to attain the happiness of this world and the hereafter by spending his life in accordance with God's will.

In this state, I saw a man with a very beautiful and radiant face come and sit next to God Almighty on that throne. And with such a soft and sweet tone that hearing it would bring a kind of peace and tranquility to every human heart, he would plead in the court of God Almighty for the forgiveness of everyone's sins. 3658.right:
Part Four

Question: What is the ruling on mentioning the name of the Prophet (peace be upon him) in the grave during burial, including attending the funeral?
Answer: Mentioning the name of the Prophet (peace be upon him) in the grave during the funeral is an innovation (bid'ah) and impermissible, because there is no evidence for this in Sharia.
Question: What is the ruling on placing flowers on top of a deceased person's grave?
Answer: Placing flowers or other items on a deceased person's grave has no basis in the blessed religion of Islam; therefore, this act is also unacceptable.
Question: What is the ruling on building high frames or domes over graves?
Answer: Building domes or any such structures over graves for which there is no Sharia-based necessity is an act contrary to Islamic Sharia, and this is forbidden.
Question: What is the ruling for those who go to visit graves and light candles on them or offer vows (nazrana) around the graves?
Answer: Lighting candles on graves and offering vows there is, from the perspective of Sharia, a path to shirk (polytheism) and leading people astray, and one must strictly refrain from this act.
3658.left:
Question: What is the ruling on reciting the Holy Quran while burying the deceased?
Answer: Reciting the Holy Quran at the time of burying the deceased, such as while standing at the grave, has no basis in Sharia, and this act is not endorsed in Islamic law.
Question: What is the ruling on providing food in the name of charity for the deceased or holding large gatherings in memory of the dead?
Answer: Performing such acts in the name of charity for the deceased, which have not been recommended in Islamic Sharia, is an innovation (bid'ah) and an act that is not approved from a Sharia perspective.
Question: What is the ruling on writing on graves or placing stones to mark a grave?
Answer: The Sharia rulings regarding placing stones to mark graves or writing the name of the deceased are very strict; it appears from the Hadiths of the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) that marking graves extensively is not in accordance with Islamic principles.
Question: What is the ruling on writing verses of the Holy Quran on top of the graves of the deceased?
Answer: Writing verses of the Holy Quran on graves in a place where they might be disrespected or stepped upon by people is in no way permissible in the blessed religion of Islam.

These issues were compiled according to the fatwa of the scholars of the Darul Uloom of Kabul.

3663.right:
Ramadan and Shakro

Nowroz Khan called out to Ramadan saying: Brother! This is the month of Ramadan, may God accept it from all of us. Ramadan said: Yes, may God grant us the ability to perform the worships of this month. Nowroz Khan said: Ramadan Khan! I have a request, let us do something in this month that is beneficial for both the people and the religion. Ramadan said: That is a very good initiative, I want the same. Nowroz Khan said: Then come, let us make some arrangements for the poor. Let us do something so that people become aware of each other's condition in this month and help according to their means in this path. Ramadan accepted happily and said: This is a very good idea, let us talk to the people and invite them to do good deeds. They started this work and encouraged many people to help others in this month. Many people participated in this path and such things were done that increased love and brotherhood among the people. It seemed that this Ramadan was very different compared to others and people were truly doing things for the sake of God's pleasure.
3663.left:
That in this path is the pleasure of God, this matter spread among the people and it seemed that this month of Ramadan became a month of blessings for the people. People shared in each other's grief and such deeds were done that no one had seen before. Nawroz Khan was very happy with this work of Ramadan and said: Look, Ramadan Khan! These are the hearts of the people that gather in charitable works. Ramadan said with a smile: Yes, this is a sign of faith and people know how much reward there is in spending in the way of God.

Nawroz Khan and Ramadan were both happy that they were able to accomplish some good deeds. They thanked the people and prayed for them that God may accept their intention. With the end of this month, people congratulated each other and felt that they had received a great grace from God.

This story has remained as a lesson for people for centuries and has shown them that in this holy month, the greatest worship is love for the servants and helping them.

3668.right:
Book

The shore of study!
O heart, you who sit in seclusion and are immersed in your books, do you know what these are? These are signs of the knowledge and wisdom of people from past eras. In these pages are contained the words of those who lived long before us. This is the voice of their hearts and a portrait of the flights of their thoughts. These books are not just paper, but signs of the evolution of the human soul.

The book is the gateway to knowledge. In it is the knowledge of everything, whether it be of religion or the world, whether of the past or the future. In our civilization, the book was viewed with great respect. Our scholars and writers would be busy for nights on end moving their pens, so that they could leave their knowledge for future generations.

Today as we look, everything in this world is in a state of change, but the book is still the most reliable source for acquiring knowledge. If we want to take steps on the path to the elevation of our nation, then we must strengthen the habit of reading.
3668.left:
The new generation must understand that a book is a torch for the path of life. A book gives a person the ability to think, shows the difference between truth and falsehood, and points out ways for the progress of society.

But it is a pity that nowadays some people have moved away from books. Instead of reading books, they spend their time on useless activities. This is a great loss. If we want to regain our position in the field of knowledge once again, we must look at books with respect and make them our companions.

If we talk about the pleasure of reading, then by reading a book, a person is freed from the constraints of time and travels towards another world. This is a journey that has no end, because the world of knowledge is vast and endless.

In conclusion, I recommend to our youth to make the book your guide. Read the book, think about it, and build your life in its light. A book gives you what nothing else can, and that is the peace of the heart and mind.

3669.right:
When the light of "Asia's" life spread to the East, the other people of the world were so fast asleep while watching this light that they did not understand at all what was happening around them. At the time of the spreading of this light, a new spirit was born in the world, which invited all humans to new ways of life and brought people lying in the darkness of ignorance to such a place in the field of knowledge and wisdom that they were written in golden lines forever on the pages of history.

The history of the origin of writing:

When humans learned to use language to express their feelings and thoughts, they very soon found a way to write these thoughts on paper. There are various theories about the origin of writing, but the most reliable one is that writing first began in the form of pictures, and later, with the passage of time, it turned into signs and letters.

Are these letters that we use now the invention of any specific person? No, this is the result of the continuous efforts of humanity. By looking at the writings of ancient people, we know that every nation created special signs for writing according to its needs. In particular, the art of writing played a very important role in the development of civilizations.
3669.left:
Ultimately, printing books paved a new way for their distribution, which resulted in a great revolution in the field of spreading knowledge and wisdom. The knowledge that had hitherto been hidden in manuscripts now reached the hands of the common people.

In the present time, the value of books is greater than ever before. For the progress of our society, it is necessary to popularize the culture of reading, because reading is the only way to expand human thought and increase knowledge.

For this, there is a need for the progress of science and art, so that this passion is created in our youth.
That they serve this homeland themselves, possess a spirit of sacrifice for their nation, and take such steps in the field of knowledge that they become capable of competing with other nations of the world.
Choose such a path for "freedom" that, as a result, a change comes in the condition of the nation, the darkness of ignorance ends, the light of knowledge spreads, and our youth adopt such a course of action that becomes the cause of the country's prosperity and progress.
So that this nation becomes proud and happy in the face of the world. The taste of freedom lies in serving oneself and the nation in the light of knowledge and art.
Furthermore, take such measures and steps for this that a passion for love of the homeland is created in the heart of every individual, and a path to a new life is paved for this nation.
Insha'Allah.

should serve, and if they do such things in the name of "freedom" that cause harm to the homeland, then this is not beneficial for freedom, but rather a path to destruction.

3671.right: For this reason, I also stopped talking to him, and with great humility, I said to him, "Brother! Seeing my condition, for God's sake, have mercy on me and do not speak of these hardships and worries, which only make the dark night of my life even darker." When I said this, he also began to weep and said in his own words: "Brother! In this desert of life, I too am weary under the burden of sorrows and difficulties, and this dark night that you see, I am also searching within it." This was another painful story of two hearts coming together, meeting each other in this arena of life. He was immersed in the stories of his own life, and I was immersed in the sorrows of mine. This was not the time for such talk, nor was there a solution to such problems. He, like me, was trapped in the hands of his destiny, and the more he tried to escape, the more he became entangled in this dark snare. He, like me, was a traveler searching for his destination, but he had lost the signs of the path. In this long journey of life, he too was searching for his hopes and aspirations, but all those hopes had been lost in the shadows of time. In the dark nights of this desert, he was like a star scattered across the skirt of the sky, searching for light. He began the story of his life thus: "I was once in a garden of happiness and laughter, but in these harsh winds of life, all the flowers of my life withered, and now I am wandering in this desert of sorrows. This time is so merciless that it values no one's tears, nor does it care about the pains of the heart. Everyone is weighed on the scale of their own sorrow, and no one notices the pain of another." At this, he fell silent for a moment, and it seemed as if there was a great storm in his heart, but he lacked the strength to express it. I looked at him too and said in my heart: "O God! What dark stage of life is this, where everyone is searching within their own pain and cannot find a way to salvation."
3671.left: In this dark night, by the light of the stars, I saw myself, hanging even lower under the burden of sorrows. I placed the story of this weary traveler on the scale of my heart, and I kept company with his pain alongside my own sorrow. We were both in search of light in this boundless desert of life, but the hand of fate acted in such a way that neither of us reached our destination. He was in search of the happiness of life, and I was in search of my own peace. This dark night continued for a long time, and we sat in silence beside each other, like two ships lost in the middle of a storm. Every time a gust of wind came, the pains of our hearts were renewed. He said again: "Brother! In this journey of life, we have found nothing but these sorrows and weariness." I also admitted in my heart that he was telling the truth, because the whole story of our lives is like these dark nights. At that moment, the signs of morning appeared on the horizon, and the first rays of light spread over the body of the dark night. These rays of light were a sign of a new hope, but our hearts were still drowned in the darkness of past sorrows. We both stood up and continued on our journey, but with every step, the memories of this night's sorrows remained in our hearts. This was an example of life, how one human shares in the pain of another, and how they offer a hand of comfort to each other on this path of life. We parted ways with each other in a state where the burden of our hearts had become even heavier, but according to the bond of humanity, we separated after praying for each other's patience and courage. The story of this night became a part of our lives that will never be forgotten, because this night was a clear proof of pains, hopes, and the endless truths of life.
